import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1_000_000_007L;

    long modPow(long base, long exponent) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exponent >>>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    long modInverse(long value) {
        return modPow(value, MOD - 2);
    }

    void process() {
        long[] factorial = new long[51];
        factorial[0] = 1;
        for (int idx = 1; idx <= 50; idx++) {
            factorial[idx] = (factorial[idx - 1] * idx) % MOD;
        }

        long[][] binomial = new long[51][51];
        for (int row = 0; row <= 50; row++) {
            binomial[row][0] = 1;
            for (int col = 1; col <= row; col++) {
                long denominator = (factorial[col] * factorial[row - col]) % MOD;
                binomial[row][col] = (factorial[row] * modInverse(denominator)) % MOD;
            }
        }

        int totalItems = ni();
        int targetSum = ni();

        int countFifty = 0;
        int countHundred = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalItems; i++) {
            int denom = ni();
            if (denom == 100) countHundred++;
            else countFifty++;
        }

        State[][][] graph = new State[countFifty + 1][countHundred + 1][2];
        for (int f = 0; f <= countFifty; f++) {
            for (int h = 0; h <= countHundred; h++) {
                graph[f][h][0] = new State(f, h, 0);
                graph[f][h][1] = new State(f, h, 1);
            }
        }

        for (int f = 0; f <= countFifty; f++) {
            for (int h = 0; h <= countHundred; h++) {
                int maxFifty = Math.min(targetSum / 50, f);
                int maxHundred = Math.min(targetSum / 100, h);

                for (int hUse = maxHundred; hUse >= 0; hUse--) {
                    int remainingSum = targetSum - (100 * hUse);
                    int maxFiftyUse = Math.min(maxFifty, remainingSum / 50);

                    for (int fUse = maxFiftyUse; fUse >= 0; fUse--) {
                        if (fUse == 0 && hUse == 0) continue;

                        State src = graph[f][h][0];
                        State dst = graph[f - fUse][h - hUse][1];

                        src.transitions.add(dst);
                        dst.transitions.add(src);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        ArrayDeque<State> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        graph[countFifty][countHundred][0].distance = 1;
        graph[countFifty][countHundred][0].paths = 1;
        queue.add(graph[countFifty][countHundred][0]);

        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            State current = queue.poll();

            for (State next : current.transitions) {
                if (next.distance == 0 || next.distance == current.distance + 1) {
                    int availableFifty = current.flag == 0 ? current.fifty : countFifty - current.fifty;
                    int fiftyTransition = Math.abs(current.fifty - next.fifty);
                    long waysFifty = binomial[availableFifty][fiftyTransition];

                    int availableHundred = current.flag == 0 ? current.hundred : countHundred - current.hundred;
                    int hundredTransition = Math.abs(current.hundred - next.hundred);
                    long waysHundred = binomial[availableHundred][hundredTransition];

                    long edgeWays = (waysFifty * waysHundred) % MOD;
                    next.paths = (next.paths + (current.paths * edgeWays) % MOD) % MOD;

                    if (next.distance == 0) {
                        next.distance = current.distance + 1;
                        queue.add(next);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        State finalNode = graph[0][0][1];
        System.out.println((finalNode.distance - 1));
        System.out.println(finalNode.paths);
    }

    static class State {
        int fifty, hundred, flag;
        int distance;
        long paths;
        List<State> transitions = new ArrayList<>();

        State(int f, int h, int fl) {
            fifty = f;
            hundred = h;
            flag = fl;
            distance = 0;
            paths = 0;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().process();
    }

    private BufferedReader input = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

    String readToken() {
        if (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            try {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(input.readLine());
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }
        return tokenizer.nextToken();
    }

    int ni() {
        return Integer.parseInt(readToken());
    }
}

problem_description.description: One day Greg and his friends were walking in the forest. Overall there were n people walking, including Greg. Soon he found himself in front of a river. The guys immediately decided to get across the river. Luckily, there was a boat by the river bank, just where the guys were standing. We know that the boat can hold people with the total weight of at most k kilograms.Greg immediately took a piece of paper and listed there the weights of all people in his group (including himself). It turned out that each person weights either 50 or 100 kilograms. Now Greg wants to know what minimum number of times the boat needs to cross the river to transport the whole group to the other bank. The boat needs at least one person to navigate it from one bank to the other. As the boat crosses the river, it can have any non-zero number of passengers as long as their total weight doesn't exceed k.Also Greg is wondering, how many ways there are to transport everybody to the other side in the minimum number of boat rides. Two ways are considered distinct if during some ride they have distinct sets of people on the boat.Help Greg with this problem.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers n, k (1 ≤ n ≤ 50, 1 ≤ k ≤ 5000) — the number of people, including Greg, and the boat's weight limit. The next line contains n integers — the people's weights. A person's weight is either 50 kilos or 100 kilos. You can consider Greg and his friends indexed in some way.
problem_description.output_spec: In the first line print an integer — the minimum number of rides. If transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, print an integer -1. In the second line print the remainder after dividing the number of ways to transport the people in the minimum number of rides by number 1000000007 (109 + 7). If transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, print integer 0.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test Greg walks alone and consequently, he needs only one ride across the river.In the second test you should follow the plan:  transport two 50 kg. people;  transport one 50 kg. person back;  transport one 100 kg. person;  transport one 50 kg. person back;  transport two 50 kg. people. That totals to 5 rides. Depending on which person to choose at step 2, we can get two distinct ways.

problem_description.description: One day Greg and his friends were walking in the forest. Overall there were n people walking, including Greg. Soon he found himself in front of a river. The guys immediately decided to get across the river. Luckily, there was a boat by the river bank, just where the guys were standing. We know that the boat can hold people with the total weight of at most k kilograms.Greg immediately took a piece of paper and listed there the weights of all people in his group (including himself). It turned out that each person weights either 50 or 100 kilograms. Now Greg wants to know what minimum number of times the boat needs to cross the river to transport the whole group to the other bank. The boat needs at least one person to navigate it from one bank to the other. As the boat crosses the river, it can have any non-zero number of passengers as long as their total weight doesn't exceed k.Also Greg is wondering, how many ways there are to transport everybody to the other side in the minimum number of boat rides. Two ways are considered distinct if during some ride they have distinct sets of people on the boat.Help Greg with this problem.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers n, k (1 ≤ n ≤ 50, 1 ≤ k ≤ 5000) — the number of people, including Greg, and the boat's weight limit. The next line contains n integers — the people's weights. A person's weight is either 50 kilos or 100 kilos. You can consider Greg and his friends indexed in some way.
problem_description.output_spec: In the first line print an integer — the minimum number of rides. If transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, print an integer -1. In the second line print the remainder after dividing the number of ways to transport the people in the minimum number of rides by number 1000000007 (109 + 7). If transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, print integer 0.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test Greg walks alone and consequently, he needs only one ride across the river.In the second test you should follow the plan:  transport two 50 kg. people;  transport one 50 kg. person back;  transport one 100 kg. person;  transport one 50 kg. person back;  transport two 50 kg. people. That totals to 5 rides. Depending on which person to choose at step 2, we can get two distinct ways.

problem_description.description: One day Greg and his friends were walking in the forest. Overall there were n people walking, including Greg. Soon he found himself in front of a river. The guys immediately decided to get across the river. Luckily, there was a boat by the river bank, just where the guys were standing. We know that the boat can hold people with the total weight of at most k kilograms.Greg immediately took a piece of paper and listed there the weights of all people in his group (including himself). It turned out that each person weights either 50 or 100 kilograms. Now Greg wants to know what minimum number of times the boat needs to cross the river to transport the whole group to the other bank. The boat needs at least one person to navigate it from one bank to the other. As the boat crosses the river, it can have any non-zero number of passengers as long as their total weight doesn't exceed k.Also Greg is wondering, how many ways there are to transport everybody to the other side in the minimum number of boat rides. Two ways are considered distinct if during some ride they have distinct sets of people on the boat.Help Greg with this problem.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers n, k (1 ≤ n ≤ 50, 1 ≤ k ≤ 5000) — the number of people, including Greg, and the boat's weight limit. The next line contains n integers — the people's weights. A person's weight is either 50 kilos or 100 kilos. You can consider Greg and his friends indexed in some way.
problem_description.output_spec: In the first line print an integer — the minimum number of rides. If transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, print an integer -1. In the second line print the remainder after dividing the number of ways to transport the people in the minimum number of rides by number 1000000007 (109 + 7). If transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, print integer 0.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test Greg walks alone and consequently, he needs only one ride across the river.In the second test you should follow the plan:  transport two 50 kg. people;  transport one 50 kg. person back;  transport one 100 kg. person;  transport one 50 kg. person back;  transport two 50 kg. people. That totals to 5 rides. Depending on which person to choose at step 2, we can get two distinct ways.

problem_description.description: One day Greg and his friends were walking in the forest. Overall there were n people walking, including Greg. Soon he found himself in front of a river. The guys immediately decided to get across the river. Luckily, there was a boat by the river bank, just where the guys were standing. We know that the boat can hold people with the total weight of at most k kilograms.Greg immediately took a piece of paper and listed there the weights of all people in his group (including himself). It turned out that each person weights either 50 or 100 kilograms. Now Greg wants to know what minimum number of times the boat needs to cross the river to transport the whole group to the other bank. The boat needs at least one person to navigate it from one bank to the other. As the boat crosses the river, it can have any non-zero number of passengers as long as their total weight doesn't exceed k.Also Greg is wondering, how many ways there are to transport everybody to the other side in the minimum number of boat rides. Two ways are considered distinct if during some ride they have distinct sets of people on the boat.Help Greg with this problem.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers n, k (1 ≤ n ≤ 50, 1 ≤ k ≤ 5000) — the number of people, including Greg, and the boat's weight limit. The next line contains n integers — the people's weights. A person's weight is either 50 kilos or 100 kilos. You can consider Greg and his friends indexed in some way.
problem_description.output_spec: In the first line print an integer — the minimum number of rides. If transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, print an integer -1. In the second line print the remainder after dividing the number of ways to transport the people in the minimum number of rides by number 1000000007 (109 + 7). If transporting everyone to the other bank is impossible, print integer 0.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test Greg walks alone and consequently, he needs only one ride across the river.In the second test you should follow the plan:  transport two 50 kg. people;  transport one 50 kg. person back;  transport one 100 kg. person;  transport one 50 kg. person back;  transport two 50 kg. people. That totals to 5 rides. Depending on which person to choose at step 2, we can get two distinct ways.

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][][][] dp;
    static int capacity, fatCount, slimCount;
    static long[][] nCr;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long solve(int remainingFat, int remainingSlim, int remainingTrips, boolean boatOnLeft) {
        if (remainingFat == 0 && remainingSlim == 0 && remainingTrips == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (remainingTrips == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        int boatIndex = boatOnLeft ? 0 : 1;
        if (dp[remainingFat][remainingSlim][remainingTrips][boatIndex] != -1) {
            return dp[remainingFat][remainingSlim][remainingTrips][boatIndex];
        }

        long result = 0;
        if (boatOnLeft) {
            for (int f = 0; f <= remainingFat; f++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= remainingSlim; s++) {
                    if (f + s > 0 && f * 2 + s <= capacity) {
                        long ways = (nCr[remainingFat][f] * nCr[remainingSlim][s]) % MOD;
                        result = (result + (ways * solve(remainingFat - f, remainingSlim - s, remainingTrips - 1, !boatOnLeft)) % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int fatMoved = fatCount - remainingFat;
            int slimMoved = slimCount - remainingSlim;
            for (int f = 0; f <= fatMoved; f++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= slimMoved; s++) {
                    if (f + s > 0 && f * 2 + s <= capacity) {
                        long ways = (nCr[fatMoved][f] * nCr[slimMoved][s]) % MOD;
                        result = (result + (ways * solve(remainingFat + f, remainingSlim + s, remainingTrips - 1, !boatOnLeft)) % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[remainingFat][remainingSlim][remainingTrips][boatIndex] = result;
    }

    static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        capacity = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim()) / 50;

public class Main {
    static long[][][][] memoTable;
    static int boatCap, countFat, countSlim;
    static long[][] nCrTable;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long explore(int fatRemaining, int slimRemaining, int tripsRemaining, boolean isBoatLeft) {
        if (fatRemaining == 0 && slimRemaining == 0 && tripsRemaining == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (tripsRemaining == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        int side = isBoatLeft ? 0 : 1;
        if (memoTable[fatRemaining][slimRemaining][tripsRemaining][side] != -1) {
            return memoTable[fatRemaining][slimRemaining][tripsRemaining][side];
        }

        long total = 0;
        if (isBoatLeft) {
            for (int f = 0; f <= fatRemaining; f++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= slimRemaining; s++) {
                    if (f + s > 0 && 2 * f + s <= boatCap) {
                        long comb = (nCrTable[fatRemaining][f] * nCrTable[slimRemaining][s]) % MOD;
                        total = (total + comb * explore(fatRemaining - f, slimRemaining - s, tripsRemaining - 1, !isBoatLeft)) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int fMoved = countFat - fatRemaining;
            int sMoved = countSlim - slimRemaining;
            for (int f = 0; f <= fMoved; f++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= sMoved; s++) {
                    if (f + s > 0 && 2 * f + s <= boatCap) {
                        long comb = (nCrTable[fMoved][f] * nCrTable[sMoved][s]) % MOD;
                        total = (total + comb * explore(fatRemaining + f, slimRemaining + s, tripsRemaining - 1, !isBoatLeft)) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return memoTable[fatRemaining][slimRemaining][tripsRemaining][side] = total;
    }

    static long modPow(long b, long e, long m) {
        long res = 1;
        b %= m;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = (res * b) % m;
            b = (b * b) % m;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example, it is sufficient to insert a single nucleotide of any type between the two 'T's in the sequence to restore the functionality of the protein.

problem_description.description: You will receive 3 points for solving this problem.Manao is designing the genetic code for a new type of algae to efficiently produce fuel. Specifically, Manao is focusing on a stretch of DNA that encodes one protein. The stretch of DNA is represented by a string containing only the characters 'A', 'T', 'G' and 'C'.Manao has determined that if the stretch of DNA contains a maximal sequence of consecutive identical nucleotides that is of even length, then the protein will be nonfunctional. For example, consider a protein described by DNA string "GTTAAAG". It contains four maximal sequences of consecutive identical nucleotides: "G", "TT", "AAA", and "G". The protein is nonfunctional because sequence "TT" has even length.Manao is trying to obtain a functional protein from the protein he currently has. Manao can insert additional nucleotides into the DNA stretch. Each additional nucleotide is a character from the set {'A', 'T', 'G', 'C'}. Manao wants to determine the minimum number of insertions necessary to make the DNA encode a functional protein.
problem_description.input_spec: The input consists of a single line, containing a string s of length n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100). Each character of s will be from the set {'A', 'T', 'G', 'C'}. This problem doesn't have subproblems. You will get 3 points for the correct submission.
problem_description.output_spec: The program should print on one line a single integer representing the minimum number of 'A', 'T', 'G', 'C' characters that are required to be inserted into the input string in order to make all runs of identical characters have odd length.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example, it is sufficient to insert a single nucleotide of any type between the two 'T's in the sequence to restore the functionality of the protein.

def main():
    sc = sys.stdin
    str_input = sc.readline().strip()

    pos = 0
    c = 0
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, len(str_input)):

        cp = str_input[pos]
        if ch != cp:
            pos = i
            if (c + 1) % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
            c = 0
        else:
            c += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.description: You will receive 3 points for solving this problem.Manao is designing the genetic code for a new type of algae to efficiently produce fuel. Specifically, Manao is focusing on a stretch of DNA that encodes one protein. The stretch of DNA is represented by a string containing only the characters 'A', 'T', 'G' and 'C'.Manao has determined that if the stretch of DNA contains a maximal sequence of consecutive identical nucleotides that is of even length, then the protein will be nonfunctional. For example, consider a protein described by DNA string "GTTAAAG". It contains four maximal sequences of consecutive identical nucleotides: "G", "TT", "AAA", and "G". The protein is nonfunctional because sequence "TT" has even length.Manao is trying to obtain a functional protein from the protein he currently has. Manao can insert additional nucleotides into the DNA stretch. Each additional nucleotide is a character from the set {'A', 'T', 'G', 'C'}. Manao wants to determine the minimum number of insertions necessary to make the DNA encode a functional protein.
problem_description.input_spec: The input consists of a single line, containing a string s of length n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100). Each character of s will be from the set {'A', 'T', 'G', 'C'}. This problem doesn't have subproblems. You will get 3 points for the correct submission.
problem_description.output_spec: The program should print on one line a single integer representing the minimum number of 'A', 'T', 'G', 'C' characters that are required to be inserted into the input string in order to make all runs of identical characters have odd length.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example, it is sufficient to insert a single nucleotide of any type between the two 'T's in the sequence to restore the functionality of the protein.

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

    while i < len(s):

        if length % 2 == 0:

import sys

def process(is_stream, os_stream):
    line = is_stream.readline().rstrip('\n')
    count = 0
    start = 0
    while start < len(line):
        end = start
        current = line[start]
        while end < len(line) and line[end] == current:
            end += 1
        length = end - start
        count += (length + 1) % 2
        start = end
    os_stream.write(str(count) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    process(sys.stdin, sys.stdout)

problem_description.description: Alice and Bob have decided to play the game "Rock, Paper, Scissors". The game consists of several rounds, each round is independent of each other. In each round, both players show one of the following things at the same time: rock, paper or scissors. If both players showed the same things then the round outcome is a draw. Otherwise, the following rules applied:  if one player showed rock and the other one showed scissors, then the player who showed rock is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed scissors and the other one showed paper, then the player who showed scissors is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed paper and the other one showed rock, then the player who showed paper is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser. Alice and Bob decided to play exactly $$$n$$$ rounds of the game described above. Alice decided to show rock $$$a_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$a_2$$$ times and show paper $$$a_3$$$ times. Bob decided to show rock $$$b_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$b_2$$$ times and show paper $$$b_3$$$ times. Though, both Alice and Bob did not choose the sequence in which they show things. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$ and $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.Your task is to find two numbers:  the minimum number of round Alice can win;  the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.

It is guaranteed that $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.
problem_description.output_spec: Print two integers: the minimum and the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example, Alice will not win any rounds if she shows scissors and then paper and Bob shows rock and then scissors. problem_description.description: Alice and Bob have decided to play the game "Rock, Paper, Scissors". The game consists of several rounds, each round is independent of each other. In each round, both players show one of the following things at the same time: rock, paper or scissors. If both players showed the same things then the round outcome is a draw. Otherwise, the following rules applied:  if one player showed rock and the other one showed scissors, then the player who showed rock is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed scissors and the other one showed paper, then the player who showed scissors is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed paper and the other one showed rock, then the player who showed paper is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser. Alice and Bob decided to play exactly $$$n$$$ rounds of the game described above. Alice decided to show rock $$$a_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$a_2$$$ times and show paper $$$a_3$$$ times. Bob decided to show rock $$$b_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$b_2$$$ times and show paper $$$b_3$$$ times. Though, both Alice and Bob did not choose the sequence in which they show things. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$ and $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.Your task is to find two numbers:  the minimum number of round Alice can win;  the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of the input contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^{9}$$$) — the number of rounds. The second line of the input contains three integers $$$a_1, a_2, a_3$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le n$$$) — the number of times Alice will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$. The third line of the input contains three integers $$$b_1, b_2, b_3$$$ ($$$0 \le b_j \le n$$$) — the number of times Bob will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.
problem_description.output_spec: Print two integers: the minimum and the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example, Alice will not win any rounds if she shows scissors and then paper and Bob shows rock and then scissors. In the best outcome, Alice will win one round if she shows paper and then scissors, and Bob shows rock and then scissors.In the second example, Alice will not win any rounds if Bob shows the same things as Alice each round.In the third example, Alice always shows paper and Bob always shows rock so Alice will win all three rounds anyway.

In each round, both players show one of the following things at the same time: rock, paper or scissors. If both players showed the same things then the round outcome is a draw. Otherwise, the following rules applied:  if one player showed rock and the other one showed scissors, then the player who showed rock is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed scissors and the other one showed paper, then the player who showed scissors is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed paper and the other one showed rock, then the player who showed paper is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser. Alice and Bob decided to play exactly $$$n$$$ rounds of the game described above. Alice decided to show rock $$$a_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$a_2$$$ times and show paper $$$a_3$$$ times. Bob decided to show rock $$$b_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$b_2$$$ times and show paper $$$b_3$$$ times. Though, both Alice and Bob did not choose the sequence in which they show things. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$ and $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.Your task is to find two numbers:  the minimum number of round Alice can win;  the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.

The second line of the input contains three integers $$$a_1, a_2, a_3$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le n$$$) — the number of times Alice will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$. The third line of the input contains three integers $$$b_1, b_2, b_3$$$ ($$$0 \le b_j \le n$$$) — the number of times Bob will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.
problem_description.output_spec: Print two integers: the minimum and the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.

    static FastReader s = new FastReader();
    static PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

    private static long[] readLongArray(int n) {
        long[] arr = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = s.nextLong();
        }
        return arr;
    }

    private static int readInt() {
        return s.nextInt();
    }

    static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
    }

    static int binarySearch(List<Long> list, long value, int startIndex) {
        int left = startIndex;
        int right = list.size() - 1;
        int result = list.size();

        while (left <= right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) > value) {
                if (mid == 0 || list.get(mid - 1) <= value) {
                    return mid;
                }
                right = mid - 1;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long calculate(List<Node> nodes, long[] b, int index) {
        if (index == 3) {
            return 0;
        }

        Node current = nodes.get(index);
        int otherIndex = (current.ind - 1 + 3) % 3;

        long transfer1 = Math.min(current.val, b[otherIndex]);
        current.val -= transfer1;
        b[otherIndex] -= transfer1;

        long transfer2 = Math.min(current.val, b[current.ind]);
        current.val -= transfer2;
        b[current.ind] -= transfer2;

        long total1 = current.val + calculate(nodes, b, index + 1);

        current.val += transfer1 + transfer2;
        b[otherIndex] += transfer1;
        b[current.ind] += transfer2;

        current = nodes.get(index);
        transfer1 = Math.min(current.val, b[current.ind]);
        current.val -= transfer1;
        b[current.ind] -= transfer1;

        transfer2 = Math.min(current.val, b[otherIndex]);
        current.val -= transfer2;
        b[otherIndex] -= transfer2;

        long total2 = current.val + calculate(nodes, b, index + 1);

        current.val += transfer1 + transfer2;
        b[current.ind] += transfer1;
        b[otherIndex] += transfer2;

        return Math.min(total1, total2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        int testCases = 1;

            int n = readInt();
            long[] a = readLongArray(3);

        }

    }

        }

        }

        }

                return reader.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                return "";
            }
        }
    }

    static InputReader in = new InputReader();
    static PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(System.out);

    static long[] readLongs(int size) {
        long[] data = new long[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            data[i] = in.readLong();
        }
        return data;
    }

    static int readNumber() {
        return in.readInt();
    }

    static int computeGCD(int x, int y) {
        while (y != 0) {
            int temp = y;
            y = x % y;
            x = temp;
        }
        return x;
    }

    static int findFirstGreater(List<Long> sorted, long target, int start) {
        int low = start;
        int high = sorted.size() - 1;
        int pos = sorted.size();

        while (low <= high) {
            int mid = (low + high) >>> 1;
            if (sorted.get(mid) > target) {
                if (mid == 0 || sorted.get(mid - 1) <= target) {
                    return mid;
                }
                high = mid - 1;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return pos;
    }

    static long process(List<Item> items, long[] buffer, int position) {
        if (position == 3) {
            return 0;
        }

        Item current = items.get(position);
        int alternate = (current.index + 2) % 3;

        long firstMove = Math.min(current.amount, buffer[alternate]);
        current.amount -= firstMove;
        buffer[alternate] -= firstMove;

        long secondMove = Math.min(current.amount, buffer[current.index]);
        current.amount -= secondMove;
        buffer[current.index] -= secondMove;

        long option1 = current.amount + process(items, buffer, position + 1);

        current.amount += firstMove + secondMove;
        buffer[alternate] += firstMove;
        buffer[current.index] += secondMove;

        current = items.get(position);
        firstMove = Math.min(current.amount, buffer[current.index]);
        current.amount -= firstMove;
        buffer[current.index] -= firstMove;

        secondMove = Math.min(current.amount, buffer[alternate]);
        current.amount -= secondMove;
        buffer[alternate] -= secondMove;

        long option2 = current.amount + process(items, buffer, position + 1);

        current.amount += firstMove + secondMove;
        buffer[current.index] += firstMove;
        buffer[alternate] += secondMove;

        return Math.min(option1, option2);
    }

problem_description.description: Alice and Bob have decided to play the game "Rock, Paper, Scissors". The game consists of several rounds, each round is independent of each other. In each round, both players show one of the following things at the same time: rock, paper or scissors. If both players showed the same things then the round outcome is a draw. Otherwise, the following rules applied:  if one player showed rock and the other one showed scissors, then the player who showed rock is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed scissors and the other one showed paper, then the player who showed scissors is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed paper and the other one showed rock, then the player who showed paper is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser. Alice and Bob decided to play exactly $$$n$$$ rounds of the game described above. Alice decided to show rock $$$a_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$a_2$$$ times and show paper $$$a_3$$$ times. Bob decided to show rock $$$b_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$b_2$$$ times and show paper $$$b_3$$$ times. Though, both Alice and Bob did not choose the sequence in which they show things. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$ and $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.Your task is to find two numbers:  the minimum number of round Alice can win;  the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of the input contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^{9}$$$) — the number of rounds. The second line of the input contains three integers $$$a_1, a_2, a_3$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le n$$$) — the number of times Alice will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$. The third line of the input contains three integers $$$b_1, b_2, b_3$$$ ($$$0 \le b_j \le n$$$) — the number of times Bob will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.
problem_description.output_spec: Print two integers: the minimum and the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example, Alice will not win any rounds if she shows scissors and then paper and Bob shows rock and then scissors. In the best outcome, Alice will win one round if she shows paper and then scissors, and Bob shows rock and then scissors.In the second example, Alice will not win any rounds if Bob shows the same things as Alice each round.In the third example, Alice always shows paper and Bob always shows rock so Alice will win all three rounds anyway.

import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    A = [int(data[idx + i]) for i in range(3)]; idx += 3
    B = [int(data[idx + i]) for i in range(3)]; idx += 3

    winCount = 0
    nonWinCount = 0

    for i in range(3):
        winCount += min(A[i], B[(i + 1) % 3])
        possibleDefeat = min(B[i], A[(i + 1) % 3])
        possibleTie = min(B[i], A[i])
        nonWinCount += min(B[i], possibleDefeat + possibleTie)

    print(f"{n - nonWinCount} {winCount}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

problem_description.description: Alice and Bob have decided to play the game "Rock, Paper, Scissors". The game consists of several rounds, each round is independent of each other. In each round, both players show one of the following things at the same time: rock, paper or scissors. If both players showed the same things then the round outcome is a draw. Otherwise, the following rules applied:  if one player showed rock and the other one showed scissors, then the player who showed rock is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed scissors and the other one showed paper, then the player who showed scissors is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed paper and the other one showed rock, then the player who showed paper is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser. Alice and Bob decided to play exactly $$$n$$$ rounds of the game described above. Alice decided to show rock $$$a_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$a_2$$$ times and show paper $$$a_3$$$ times. Bob decided to show rock $$$b_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$b_2$$$ times and show paper $$$b_3$$$ times. Though, both Alice and Bob did not choose the sequence in which they show things. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$ and $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.Your task is to find two numbers:  the minimum number of round Alice can win;  the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of the input contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^{9}$$$) — the number of rounds. The second line of the input contains three integers $$$a_1, a_2, a_3$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le n$$$) — the number of times Alice will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$. The third line of the input contains three integers $$$b_1, b_2, b_3$$$ ($$$0 \le b_j \le n$$$) — the number of times Bob will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.
problem_description.output_spec: Print two integers: the minimum and the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example, Alice will not win any rounds if she shows scissors and then paper and Bob shows rock and then scissors. In the best outcome, Alice will win one round if she shows paper and then scissors, and Bob shows rock and then scissors.In the second example, Alice will not win any rounds if Bob shows the same things as Alice each round.In the third example, Alice always shows paper and Bob always shows rock so Alice will win all three rounds anyway.

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    t = int(data[0])
    index = 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(data[index]); index += 1
        a1 = int(data[index]); index += 1
        a3 = int(data[index]); index += 1
        a2 = int(data[index]); index += 1
        b1 = int(data[index]); index += 1
        b3 = int(data[index]); index += 1
        b2 = int(data[index]); index += 1
        
        min_val = max(a1 - (b2 + b1), 0) + \
                  max(a2 - (b3 + b2), 0) + \
                  max(a3 - (b1 + b3), 0)
        max_val = min(a1, b3) + \
                  min(a2, b1) + \
                  min(a3, b2)
        results.append(f"{min_val} {max_val}")
    
    print("\n".join(results))

if __name__ == "__main__":

problem_description.description: Alice and Bob have decided to play the game "Rock, Paper, Scissors". The game consists of several rounds, each round is independent of each other. In each round, both players show one of the following things at the same time: rock, paper or scissors. If both players showed the same things then the round outcome is a draw. Otherwise, the following rules applied:  if one player showed rock and the other one showed scissors, then the player who showed rock is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed scissors and the other one showed paper, then the player who showed scissors is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser;  if one player showed paper and the other one showed rock, then the player who showed paper is considered the winner and the other one is considered the loser. Alice and Bob decided to play exactly $$$n$$$ rounds of the game described above. Alice decided to show rock $$$a_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$a_2$$$ times and show paper $$$a_3$$$ times. Bob decided to show rock $$$b_1$$$ times, show scissors $$$b_2$$$ times and show paper $$$b_3$$$ times. Though, both Alice and Bob did not choose the sequence in which they show things. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$ and $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.Your task is to find two numbers:  the minimum number of round Alice can win;  the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of the input contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^{9}$$$) — the number of rounds. The second line of the input contains three integers $$$a_1, a_2, a_3$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le n$$$) — the number of times Alice will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 = n$$$. The third line of the input contains three integers $$$b_1, b_2, b_3$$$ ($$$0 \le b_j \le n$$$) — the number of times Bob will show rock, scissors and paper, respectively. It is guaranteed that $$$b_1 + b_2 + b_3 = n$$$.
problem_description.output_spec: Print two integers: the minimum and the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example, Alice will not win any rounds if she shows scissors and then paper and Bob shows rock and then scissors. In the best outcome, Alice will win one round if she shows paper and then scissors, and Bob shows rock and then scissors.In the second example, Alice will not win any rounds if Bob shows the same things as Alice each round.In the third example, Alice always shows paper and Bob always shows rock so Alice will win all three rounds anyway.

problem_description.description: The game of Egg Roulette is played between two players. Initially 2R raw eggs and 2C cooked eggs are placed randomly into a carton. The shells are left on so there is no way to distinguish a raw egg from a cooked egg. One at a time, a player will select an egg, and then smash the egg on his/her forehead. If the egg was cooked, not much happens, but if the egg was raw, it will make quite the mess. This continues until one player has broken R raw eggs, at which point that player is declared the loser and the other player wins.The order in which players take turns can be described as a string of 'A' and 'B' characters, where the i-th character tells which player should choose the i-th egg. Traditionally, players take turns going one after the other. That is, they follow the ordering "ABABAB...". This isn't very fair though, because the second player will win more often than the first. We'd like you to find a better ordering for the players to take their turns. Let's define the unfairness of an ordering as the absolute difference between the first player's win probability and the second player's win probability. We're interested in orderings that minimize the unfairness. We only consider an ordering valid if it contains the same number of 'A's as 'B's.You will also be given a string S of length 2(R + C) containing only 'A', 'B', and '?' characters. An ordering is said to match S if it only differs from S in positions where S contains a '?'. Of the valid orderings that minimize unfairness, how many match S?
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input will contain integers R and C (1 ≤ R, C ≤ 20, R + C ≤ 30). The second line of input will contain the string S of length 2(R + C) consisting only of characters 'A', 'B', '?'.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of valid orderings that minimize unfairness and match S.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test case, the minimum unfairness is 0, and the orderings that achieve it are "ABBA" and "BAAB", neither of which match S. Note that an ordering such as "ABBB" would also have an unfairness of 0, but is invalid because it does not contain the same number of 'A's as 'B's.In the second example, the only matching ordering is "BBAAABABABBA".

import sys
import threading

def main():
    # Read input
    R, C = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    
    # Initialize ch table (binomial coefficients)
    max_n = 2 * (R + C) + 1
    ch = [[0] * max_n for _ in range(max_n)]
    for i in range(max_n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if j == 0 or j == i:
                ch[i][j] = 1
            else:
                ch[i][j] = ch[i-1][j-1] + ch[i-1][j]
    
    # Initial calculation
    x, y = 0, 0
    v1, v2 = R + C, R + C
    while v1 >= R and v2 >= R:
        if x > y:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            y += cur * other
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            x += cur * other
            v2 -= 1
    
    best = abs(x - y)
    
    # Read string
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    # Precompute cntA and cntB
    cntA = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 1)
    cntB = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 1)
    for i in range(2 * (R + C)):
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (1 if str_input[i] == 'A' else 0)
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (1 if str_input[i] == 'B' else 0)
    
    # Memoization cache
    cache = {}
    tried = set()
    
    # DFS function
    def dfs(x_val, y_val, v1_val, v2_val):
        nonlocal best
        diff = abs(x_val - y_val)
        if best <= 1 or diff - ch[v1_val][R] * ch[v2_val][R] >= best:
            return
        if v1_val == R - 1 and v2_val == R - 1:
            if diff < best:
                best = diff
            return
        key = x_val * 10_000 + v1_val * 100 + v2_val
        if key in tried:
            return
        if v1_val >= R:
            cur = ch[v1_val][R] - ch[v1_val - 1][R]
            other = ch[v2_val][R]
            dfs(x_val, y_val + cur * other, v1_val - 1, v2_val)
        if v2_val >= R:
            cur = ch[v2_val][R] - ch[v2_val - 1][R]
            other = ch[v1_val][R]
            dfs(x_val + cur * other, y_val, v1_val, v2_val - 1)
        tried.add(key)
    
    # Solve function
    def solve(x_val, y_val, v1_val, v2_val):
        diff = abs(x_val - y_val)
        if diff - ch[v1_val][R] * ch[v2_val][R] > best:
            return 0
        key = x_val * 10000 + v1_val * 100 + v2_val
        if key in cache:
            return cache[key]
        if v1_val < R or v2_val < R:
            if v1_val >= cntA[v1_val + v2_val] and v2_val >= cntB[v1_val + v2_val]:
                total = v1_val + v2_val
                v1_temp = v1_val - cntA[total]
                v2_temp = v2_val - cntB[total]
                result = ch[v1_temp + v2_temp][v1_temp]
                cache[key] = result
                return result
            cache[key] = 0
            return 0
        ans = 0
        c = str_input[v1_val + v2_val - 1]
        if c != 'B':
            cur = ch[v1_val][R] - ch[v1_val - 1][R]
            other = ch[v2_val][R]
            ans += solve(x_val, y_val + cur * other, v1_val - 1, v2_val)
        if c != 'A':
            cur = ch[v2_val][R] - ch[v2_val - 1][R]
            other = ch[v1_val][R]
            ans += solve(x_val + cur * other, y_val, v1_val, v2_val - 1)
        cache[key] = ans
        return ans
    
    # Run DFS and solve
    dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C)
    ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C)
    print(ans)

# Increase recursion limit and run
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
threading.Thread(target=main).start()

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Variant2 {
  static PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out)));
  int R, C;
  long[][] ch = new long[61][61];
  int[] cntA = new int[61], cntB = new int[61];
  long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
  String str;
  Map<Long, Long> cache = new HashMap<>();
  Set<Long> tried = new HashSet<>();

  public static void main(String[] args) {
    new Variant2().start();
    writer.flush();
  }

  static int readInt() {
    int ans = 0;
    boolean neg = false;
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (c == '-') { start = true; neg = true; continue; }
        else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { start = true; ans = ans * 10 + c - '0'; }
        else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
  }

  static long readLong() {
    long ans = 0;
    boolean neg = false;
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (c == '-') { start = true; neg = true; continue; }
        else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { start = true; ans = ans * 10 + c - '0'; }
        else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
  }

  static String readString() {
    StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (!Character.isWhitespace(c)) { start = true; b.append((char) c); }
        else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return b.toString();
  }

  static int readChars(char[] a, int off) {
    int cnt = 0;
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)) { start = true; a[off + cnt++] = (char) c; }
        else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return cnt;
  }

  void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
    if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
    if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
      if (diff < best) best = diff;
      return;
    }
    long key = v2 + v1 * 100L + x * 10_000L;
    if (tried.contains(key)) return;
    if (v1 >= R) {
      long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v2][R];
      dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 >= R) {
      long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v1][R];
      dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    tried.add(key);
  }

  long solve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
    if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
    long key = v2 + v1 * 100L + x * 10000L;
    Long v = cache.get(key);
    if (v != null) return v;
    if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
      if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
        int sum = v1 + v2;
        v1 -= cntA[sum];
        v2 -= cntB[sum];
        return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
      }
      return 0;
    }
    long ans = 0;
    char c = str.charAt(v1 + v2 - 1);
    if (c != 'B') {
      long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v2][R];
      ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (c != 'A') {
      long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v1][R];
      ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    cache.put(key, ans);
    return ans;
  }

  void start() {
    R = readInt();
    C = readInt();
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (R + C); i++)
      for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++)
        if (j == 0 || j == i) ch[i][j] = 1;
        else ch[i][j] = ch[i - 1][j - 1] + ch[i - 1][j];
    long x = 0, y = 0;
    int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
    while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R)
      if (x > y) {
        long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
        long other = ch[v2][R];
        y += cur * other;
        v1--;
      } else {
        long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
        long other = ch[v1][R];
        x += cur * other;
        v2--;
      }
    best = Math.abs(x - y);
    dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    str = readString();
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
      cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str.charAt(i) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
      cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str.charAt(i) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    writer.println(ans);
  }
}

sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)

def read_int():
    ans = 0
    neg = False
    start = False
    while True:
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
        if not c:
            break
        if c == '-':
            start = True
            neg = True
            continue
        elif c.isdigit():
            start = True
            ans = ans * 10 + ord(c) - ord('0')
        elif start:
            break
    return -ans if neg else ans

def read_long():
    ans = 0
    neg = False
    start = False
    while True:
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
        if not c:
            break
        if c == '-':
            start = True
            neg = True
            continue
        elif c.isdigit():
            start = True
            ans = ans * 10 + ord(c) - ord('0')
        elif start:
            break
    return -ans if neg else ans

def read_string():
    b = []
    start = False
    while True:
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
        if not c:
            break
        if not c.isspace():
            start = True
            b.append(c)
        elif start:
            break
    return ''.join(b)

def main():
    R = read_int()
    C = read_int()
    
    # Initialize ch array (Pascal's triangle)
    max_n = 2 * (R + C) + 1
    ch = [[0] * max_n for _ in range(max_n)]
    for i in range(max_n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if j == 0 or j == i:
                ch[i][j] = 1
            else:
                ch[i][j] = ch[i-1][j-1] + ch[i-1][j]
    
    # Initialize cntA and cntB arrays
    cntA = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 1)
    cntB = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 1)
    
    # Initial calculation for best
    x = 0
    y = 0
    v1 = R + C
    v2 = R + C
    
    while v1 >= R and v2 >= R:
        if x > y:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            y += cur * other
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            x += cur * other
            v2 -= 1
    
    best = abs(x - y)
    
    # Read the string
    str_input = read_string()
    
    # Fill cntA and cntB
    for i in range(2 * (R + C)):
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (1 if str_input[i] == 'A' else 0)
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (1 if str_input[i] == 'B' else 0)
    
    # Memoization cache and tried set
    cache = {}
    tried = set()
    
    def dfs(x_val, y_val, v1_val, v2_val):

        if key in tried:
            return
        
        if v1_val >= R:
            cur = ch[v1_val][R] - ch[v1_val-1][R]
            other = ch[v2_val][R]
            dfs(x_val, y_val + cur * other, v1_val - 1, v2_val)
        
        if v2_val >= R:
            cur = ch[v2_val][R] - ch[v2_val-1][R]
            other = ch[v1_val][R]
            dfs(x_val + cur * other, y_val, v1_val, v2_val - 1)
        
        tried.add(key)
    
    def solve(x_val, y_val, v1_val, v2_val):
        diff = abs(x_val - y_val)
        if diff - ch[v1_val][R] * ch[v2_val][R] > best:
            return 0
        
        key = v2_val + v1_val * 100 + x_val * 10000
        if key in cache:
            return cache[key]
        
        if v1_val < R or v2_val < R:

                v2_temp = v2_val - cntB[total]
                result = ch[v1_temp + v2_temp][v1_temp]
                cache[key] = result
                return result
            cache[key] = 0
            return 0
        
        ans = 0
        c = str_input[v1_val + v2_val - 1]
        if c != 'B':
            cur = ch[v1_val][R] - ch[v1_val-1][R]
            other = ch[v2_val][R]
            ans += solve(x_val, y_val + cur * other, v1_val - 1, v2_val)
        
        if c != 'A':
            cur = ch[v2_val][R] - ch[v2_val-1][R]
            other = ch[v1_val][R]
            ans += solve(x_val + cur * other, y_val, v1_val, v2_val - 1)
        
        cache[key] = ans
        return ans
    
    dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C)
    ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C)

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Variant4 {
  static PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out)));
  int R, C;
  long[][] ch = new long[61][61];
  int[] cntA = new int[61], cntB = new int[61];
  long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
  String str;
  Map<Long, Long> cache = new HashMap<>();
  Set<Long> tried = new HashSet<>();

  public static void main(String[] args) {
    new Variant4().start();
    writer.flush();
  }

  static int readInt() {
    int ans = 0;
    boolean neg = false;
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (c == '-') { start = true; neg = true; continue; }
        else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { start = true; ans = ans * 10 + c - '0'; }
        else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
  }

  static long readLong() {
    long ans = 0;
    boolean neg = false;
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (c == '-') { start = true; neg = true; continue; }
        else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { start = true; ans = ans * 10 + c - '0'; }
        else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
  }

  static String readString() {
    StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (!Character.isWhitespace(c)) { start = true; b.append((char) c); }
        else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return b.toString();
  }

  static int readChars(char[] a, int off) {
    int cnt = 0;
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)) { start = true; a[off + cnt++] = (char) c; }
        else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return cnt;
  }

  void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
    if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
    if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
      if (diff < best) best = diff;
      return;
    }
    long key = (v2 << 20) | (v1 << 10) | (int)(x & 0x3FF);
    if (tried.contains(key)) return;
    if (v1 >= R) {
      long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v2][R];
      dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 >= R) {
      long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v1][R];
      dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    tried.add(key);
  }

  long solve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
    if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
    long key = (v2 << 20) | (v1 << 10) | (int)(x & 0x3FF);
    Long v = cache.get(key);
    if (v != null) return v;
    if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
      if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
        int sum = v1 + v2;
        v1 -= cntA[sum];
        v2 -= cntB[sum];
        return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
      }
      return 0;
    }
    long ans = 0;
    char c = str.charAt(v1 + v2 - 1);
    if (c != 'B') {
      long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v2][R];
      ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (c != 'A') {
      long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v1][R];
      ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    cache.put(key, ans);
    return ans;
  }

  void start() {
    R = readInt();
    C = readInt();
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (R + C); i++)
      for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++)
        if (j == 0 || j == i) ch[i][j] = 1;
        else ch[i][j] = ch[i - 1][j - 1] + ch[i - 1][j];
    long x = 0, y = 0;
    int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
    while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R)
      if (x > y) {
        long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
        long other = ch[v2][R];
        y += cur * other;
        v1--;
      } else {
        long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
        long other = ch[v1][R];
        x += cur * other;
        v2--;
      }
    best = Math.abs(x - y);
    dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    str = readString();
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
      cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str.charAt(i) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
      cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str.charAt(i) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    writer.println(ans);
  }
}

problem_description.description: The game of Egg Roulette is played between two players. Initially 2R raw eggs and 2C cooked eggs are placed randomly into a carton. The shells are left on so there is no way to distinguish a raw egg from a cooked egg. One at a time, a player will select an egg, and then smash the egg on his/her forehead. If the egg was cooked, not much happens, but if the egg was raw, it will make quite the mess. This continues until one player has broken R raw eggs, at which point that player is declared the loser and the other player wins.The order in which players take turns can be described as a string of 'A' and 'B' characters, where the i-th character tells which player should choose the i-th egg. Traditionally, players take turns going one after the other. That is, they follow the ordering "ABABAB...". This isn't very fair though, because the second player will win more often than the first. We'd like you to find a better ordering for the players to take their turns. Let's define the unfairness of an ordering as the absolute difference between the first player's win probability and the second player's win probability. We're interested in orderings that minimize the unfairness. We only consider an ordering valid if it contains the same number of 'A's as 'B's.You will also be given a string S of length 2(R + C) containing only 'A', 'B', and '?' characters. An ordering is said to match S if it only differs from S in positions where S contains a '?'. Of the valid orderings that minimize unfairness, how many match S?
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input will contain integers R and C (1 ≤ R, C ≤ 20, R + C ≤ 30). The second line of input will contain the string S of length 2(R + C) consisting only of characters 'A', 'B', '?'.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of valid orderings that minimize unfairness and match S.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test case, the minimum unfairness is 0, and the orderings that achieve it are "ABBA" and "BAAB", neither of which match S. Note that an ordering such as "ABBB" would also have an unfairness of 0, but is invalid because it does not contain the same number of 'A's as 'B's.In the second example, the only matching ordering is "BBAAABABABBA".

import sys
import weakref

class Test:
    def read_int(self):
        ans = 0
        neg = False
        try:
            start = False
            while True:
                c = sys.stdin.read(1)
                if not c:
                    break
                c = ord(c)
                if c == ord('-'):
                    start = True
                    neg = True
                    continue
                elif ord('0') <= c <= ord('9'):
                    start = True
                    ans = ans * 10 + c - ord('0')
                elif start:
                    break
        except:
            pass
        return -ans if neg else ans

    def __init__(self):
        self.r = 0
        self.c = 0
        self.C = [[0] * 64 for _ in range(64)]
        self.best = float('inf')
        self.cntA = [0] * 64
        self.cntB = [0] * 64
        self.cache = {}
        self.cs = []

    def dfs(self, x, y, v1, v2):
        d = abs(x - y)
        if self.best <= 1 or d - self.C[v1][self.r] * self.C[v2][self.r] >= self.best:
            return
        if v1 == self.r - 1 and v2 == self.r - 1:
            if d < self.best:
                self.best = d
            return
        if v1 >= self.r:
            c1 = self.C[v1][self.r] - self.C[v1-1][self.r]
            s2 = self.C[v2][self.r]
            self.dfs(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 >= self.r:
            s1 = self.C[v1][self.r]
            c2 = self.C[v2][self.r] - self.C[v2-1][self.r]
            self.dfs(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1)

    def solve(self, x, y, v1, v2):
        k = (v1 << 30) ^ (v2 << 15) ^ int(y & 0x7FFF)
        if k in self.cache:
            return self.cache[k]
        v = 0
        d = abs(x - y)
        if d - self.C[v1][self.r] * self.C[v2][self.r] > self.best:
            self.cache[k] = v
            return v
        if v1 < self.r or v2 < self.r:
            sum_v = v1 + v2
            if v1 >= self.cntA[sum_v] and v2 >= self.cntB[sum_v]:
                v1 -= self.cntA[sum_v]
                v2 -= self.cntB[sum_v]
                v = self.C[v1 + v2][v1]
                self.cache[k] = v
                return v
            self.cache[k] = v
            return v
        c = self.cs[v1 + v2 - 1]
        if c != 'B':
            c1 = self.C[v1][self.r] - self.C[v1 - 1][self.r]
            s2 = self.C[v2][self.r]
            v += self.solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2)
        if c != 'A':
            s1 = self.C[v1][self.r]
            c2 = self.C[v2][self.r] - self.C[v2-1][self.r]
            v += self.solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        self.cache[k] = v
        return v

    def start(self):
        data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
        if not data:
            return
        parts = data[0].split()
        self.r = int(parts[0])
        self.c = int(parts[1])
        self.cs = list(data[1])
        
        for i in range(2 * (self.r + self.c) + 1):
            for j in range(2 * (self.r + self.c) + 1):
                if j == 0:
                    self.C[i][j] = 1
                elif i == 0:
                    self.C[i][j] = 0
                else:
                    self.C[i][j] = self.C[i-1][j-1] + self.C[i-1][j]
        
        v1 = self.r + self.c
        v2 = self.r + self.c
        x = 0
        y = 0
        while v1 >= self.r and v2 >= self.r:
            if x > y:
                c1 = self.C[v1][self.r] - self.C[v1 - 1][self.r]
                s2 = self.C[v2][self.r]
                y += c1 * s2
                v1 -= 1
            else:
                s1 = self.C[v1][self.r]
                c2 = self.C[v2][self.r] - self.C[v2-1][self.r]
                x += s1 * c2
                v2 -= 1
        
        self.best = abs(x - y)
        self.dfs(0, 0, self.r + self.c, self.r + self.c)
        
        for i in range(2 * (self.r + self.c)):
            self.cntA[i + 1] = self.cntA[i] + (1 if self.cs[i] == 'A' else 0)
            self.cntB[i + 1] = self.cntB[i] + (1 if self.cs[i] == 'B' else 0)
        
        ans = self.solve(0, 0, self.r + self.c, self.r + self.c)
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test = Test()
    test.start()

problem_description.description: The game of Egg Roulette is played between two players. Initially 2R raw eggs and 2C cooked eggs are placed randomly into a carton. The shells are left on so there is no way to distinguish a raw egg from a cooked egg. One at a time, a player will select an egg, and then smash the egg on his/her forehead. If the egg was cooked, not much happens, but if the egg was raw, it will make quite the mess. This continues until one player has broken R raw eggs, at which point that player is declared the loser and the other player wins.The order in which players take turns can be described as a string of 'A' and 'B' characters, where the i-th character tells which player should choose the i-th egg. Traditionally, players take turns going one after the other. That is, they follow the ordering "ABABAB...". This isn't very fair though, because the second player will win more often than the first. We'd like you to find a better ordering for the players to take their turns. Let's define the unfairness of an ordering as the absolute difference between the first player's win probability and the second player's win probability. We're interested in orderings that minimize the unfairness. We only consider an ordering valid if it contains the same number of 'A's as 'B's.You will also be given a string S of length 2(R + C) containing only 'A', 'B', and '?' characters. An ordering is said to match S if it only differs from S in positions where S contains a '?'. Of the valid orderings that minimize unfairness, how many match S?
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input will contain integers R and C (1 ≤ R, C ≤ 20, R + C ≤ 30). The second line of input will contain the string S of length 2(R + C) consisting only of characters 'A', 'B', '?'.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of valid orderings that minimize unfairness and match S.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test case, the minimum unfairness is 0, and the orderings that achieve it are "ABBA" and "BAAB", neither of which match S. Note that an ordering such as "ABBB" would also have an unfairness of 0, but is invalid because it does not contain the same number of 'A's as 'B's.In the second example, the only matching ordering is "BBAAABABABBA".

import sys
import threading

def main():
    # Read input
    R, C = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    
    # Initialize ch array (binomial coefficients)
    max_n = 2 * (R + C) + 10
    ch = [[0] * max_n for _ in range(max_n)]
    for i in range(max_n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if j == 0 or j == i:
                ch[i][j] = 1
            else:
                ch[i][j] = ch[i-1][j-1] + ch[i-1][j]
    
    # Initialize cntA and cntB arrays
    cntA = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 10)
    cntB = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 10)
    
    # Read string
    str_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    # Calculate initial x and y
    x = 0
    y = 0
    v1 = R + C
    v2 = R + C
    
    while v1 >= R and v2 >= R:
        if x > y:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            y += cur * other
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            x += cur * other
            v2 -= 1
    
    best = abs(x - y)
    
    # Update cntA and cntB
    for i in range(2 * (R + C)):
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (1 if str_line[i] == 'A' else 0)
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (1 if str_line[i] == 'B' else 0)
    
    # Memoization cache
    cache = {}
    tried = set()
    
    # DFS function
    def dfs(x, y, v1, v2):
        nonlocal best
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if best <= 1 or diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best:
            return
        if v1 == R - 1 and v2 == R - 1:
            if diff < best:
                best = diff
            return
        key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2
        if key in tried:
            return
        if v1 >= R:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 >= R:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        tried.add(key)
    
    # Solve function
    def solve(x, y, v1, v2):
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best:
            return 0
        key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2
        if key in cache:
            return cache[key]
        if v1 < R or v2 < R:
            if v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] and v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]:
                sum_val = v1 + v2
                v1_new = v1 - cntA[sum_val]
                v2_new = v2 - cntB[sum_val]
                result = ch[v1_new + v2_new][v1_new]
                cache[key] = result
                return result
            cache[key] = 0
            return 0
        ans = 0
        c = str_line[v1 + v2 - 1]
        if c != 'B':
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if c != 'A':
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        cache[key] = ans
        return ans
    
    # Run DFS
    dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C)
    
    # Calculate answer
    ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C)
    print(ans)

# Increase recursion limit and run
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)

thread.start()
thread.join()

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Variant2 {
  static PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out)));
  int R, C;
  long[][] ch = new long[61][61];
  int[] cntA = new int[61], cntB = new int[61];
  long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
  String str;
  Map<Long, Long> cache = new HashMap<>();
  Set<Long> tried = new HashSet<>();

  public static void main(String[] args) {
    new Variant2().start();
    writer.flush();
  }

  static int readInt() {
    int ans = 0;
    boolean neg = false;
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (c == '-') {
          start = true;
          neg = true;
          continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
          start = true;
          ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
        } else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
  }

  static long readLong() {
    long ans = 0;
    boolean neg = false;
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (c == '-') {
          start = true;
          neg = true;
          continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
          start = true;
          ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
        } else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
  }

  static String readString() {
    StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (!Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
          start = true;
          b.append((char) c);
        } else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return b.toString();
  }

  static int readChars(char[] a, int off) {
    int cnt = 0;
    try {
      boolean start = false;
      for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (!Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
          start = true;
          a[off + cnt++] = (char) c;
        } else if (start) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException e) {}
    return cnt;
  }

  void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
    if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
    if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
      if (diff < best) best = diff;
      return;
    }
    long key = x * 10_000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
    if (tried.contains(key)) return;
    if (v1 >= R) {
      long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v2][R];
      dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 >= R) {
      long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v1][R];
      dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    tried.add(key);
  }

  long solve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
    if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
    long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
    Long v = cache.get(key);
    if (v != null) return v;
    if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
      if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
        int sum = v1 + v2;
        v1 -= cntA[sum];
        v2 -= cntB[sum];
        return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
      }
      return 0;
    }
    long ans = 0;
    char c = str.charAt(v1 + v2 - 1);
    if (c != 'B') {
      long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
      long other = ch[v2][R];
      ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);

    ch = [[0] * max_n for _ in range(max_n)]
    for i in range(max_n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if j == 0 or j == i:
                ch[i][j] = 1
            else:
                ch[i][j] = ch[i-1][j-1] + ch[i-1][j]
    
    # Read the string
    str_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

    cntA = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 1)
    cntB = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 1)
    for i in range(len(str_line)):
        cntA[i+1] = cntA[i] + (1 if str_line[i] == 'A' else 0)
        cntB[i+1] = cntB[i] + (1 if str_line[i] == 'B' else 0)
    
    # Initial calculation
    x, y = 0, 0
    v1, v2 = R + C, R + C
    while v1 >= R and v2 >= R:
        if x > y:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            y += cur * other
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            x += cur * other
            v2 -= 1
    
    best = abs(x - y)
    
    # DFS function
    tried = set()
    def dfs(x_val, y_val, v1_val, v2_val):
        nonlocal best
        diff = abs(x_val - y_val)
        if best <= 1 or diff - ch[v1_val][R] * ch[v2_val][R] >= best:
            return
        if v1_val == R - 1 and v2_val == R - 1:
            if diff < best:
                best = diff
            return
        key = x_val * 10000 + v1_val * 100 + v2_val
        if key in tried:
            return
        if v1_val >= R:
            cur = ch[v1_val][R] - ch[v1_val-1][R]
            other = ch[v2_val][R]
            dfs(x_val, y_val + cur * other, v1_val - 1, v2_val)
        if v2_val >= R:
            cur = ch[v2_val][R] - ch[v2_val-1][R]
            other = ch[v1_val][R]
            dfs(x_val + cur * other, y_val, v1_val, v2_val - 1)
        tried.add(key)
