problem_description.description: The game of Egg Roulette is played between two players. Initially 2R raw eggs and 2C cooked eggs are placed randomly into a carton. The shells are left on so there is no way to distinguish a raw egg from a cooked egg. One at a time, a player will select an egg, and then smash the egg on his/her forehead. If the egg was cooked, not much happens, but if the egg was raw, it will make quite the mess. This continues until one player has broken R raw eggs, at which point that player is declared the loser and the other player wins.The order in which players take turns can be described as a string of 'A' and 'B' characters, where the i-th character tells which player should choose the i-th egg. Traditionally, players take turns going one after the other. That is, they follow the ordering "ABABAB...". This isn't very fair though, because the second player will win more often than the first. We'd like you to find a better ordering for the players to take their turns. Let's define the unfairness of an ordering as the absolute difference between the first player's win probability and the second player's win probability. We're interested in orderings that minimize the unfairness. We only consider an ordering valid if it contains the same number of 'A's as 'B's.You will also be given a string S of length 2(R + C) containing only 'A', 'B', and '?' characters. An ordering is said to match S if it only differs from S in positions where S contains a '?'. Of the valid orderings that minimize unfairness, how many match S?
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input will contain integers R and C (1 ≤ R, C ≤ 20, R + C ≤ 30). The second line of input will contain the string S of length 2(R + C) consisting only of characters 'A', 'B', '?'.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of valid orderings that minimize unfairness and match S.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test case, the minimum unfairness is 0, and the orderings that achieve it are "ABBA" and "BAAB", neither of which match S. Note that an ordering such as "ABBB" would also have an unfairness of 0, but is invalid because it does not contain the same number of 'A's as 'B's.In the second example, the only matching ordering is "BBAAABABABBA".

		public Half(long match, long value) {
			this.match = match;
			this.value = value;
		}

		@Override
		public int compareTo(Half o) {
			return Long.compare(value, o.value);
		}
	}

	boolean nextCombination(int[] a, int n) {
		int k = a.length;
		int ptr = k - 1;
		while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) {
			ptr--;
		}
		if (ptr < 0) {
			return false;
		}
		a[ptr]++;
		for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; i++) {
			a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
		}
		return true;
	}

			} else {

		}

problem_description.description: The game of Egg Roulette is played between two players. Initially 2R raw eggs and 2C cooked eggs are placed randomly into a carton. The shells are left on so there is no way to distinguish a raw egg from a cooked egg. One at a time, a player will select an egg, and then smash the egg on his/her forehead. If the egg was cooked, not much happens, but if the egg was raw, it will make quite the mess. This continues until one player has broken R raw eggs, at which point that player is declared the loser and the other player wins.The order in which players take turns can be described as a string of 'A' and 'B' characters, where the i-th character tells which player should choose the i-th egg. Traditionally, players take turns going one after the other. That is, they follow the ordering "ABABAB...". This isn't very fair though, because the second player will win more often than the first. We'd like you to find a better ordering for the players to take their turns. Let's define the unfairness of an ordering as the absolute difference between the first player's win probability and the second player's win probability. We're interested in orderings that minimize the unfairness. We only consider an ordering valid if it contains the same number of 'A's as 'B's.You will also be given a string S of length 2(R + C) containing only 'A', 'B', and '?' characters. An ordering is said to match S if it only differs from S in positions where S contains a '?'. Of the valid orderings that minimize unfairness, how many match S?
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input will contain integers R and C (1 ≤ R, C ≤ 20, R + C ≤ 30). The second line of input will contain the string S of length 2(R + C) consisting only of characters 'A', 'B', '?'.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of valid orderings that minimize unfairness and match S.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test case, the minimum unfairness is 0, and the orderings that achieve it are "ABBA" and "BAAB", neither of which match S. Note that an ordering such as "ABBB" would also have an unfairness of 0, but is invalid because it does not contain the same number of 'A's as 'B's.In the second example, the only matching ordering is "BBAAABABABBA".

        if v1 == r-1 and v2 == r-1:

import sys
from functools import lru_cache

def main():
    INF = float('inf')
    
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    
    r, c = map(int, data[0].split())
    pattern = data[1].strip()
    
    # Initialize binomial coefficients
    binom = [[0] * 128 for _ in range(128)]
    for i in range(128):
        binom[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            binom[i][j] = binom[i-1][j-1] + binom[i-1][j]
    
    minDiff = INF
    
    # Memoization for countPaths
    memo = {}
    
    # Precompute countA and countB
    countA = [0] * (2 * (r + c) + 2)
    countB = [0] * (2 * (r + c) + 2)
    for i in range(len(pattern)):
        countA[i+1] = countA[i] + (1 if pattern[i] == 'A' else 0)
        countB[i+1] = countB[i] + (1 if pattern[i] == 'B' else 0)
    
    # Initial calculation for minDiff
    p1 = r + c
    p2 = r + c
    left = 0
    right = 0
    while p1 >= r and p2 >= r:
        if left > right:
            diff1 = binom[p1][r] - binom[p1-1][r]
            sum2 = binom[p2][r]
            right += diff1 * sum2
            p1 -= 1
        else:
            sum1 = binom[p1][r]
            diff2 = binom[p2][r] - binom[p2-1][r]
            left += sum1 * diff2
            p2 -= 1
    minDiff = abs(left - right)
    
    # Backtrack function
    def backtrack(A, B, idxA, idxB):
        nonlocal minDiff
        diff = abs(A - B)
        if minDiff <= 1 or diff - binom[idxA][r] * binom[idxB][r] >= minDiff:
            return 0
        if idxA == r - 1 and idxB == r - 1:
            if diff < minDiff:
                minDiff = diff
            return 1
        total = 0
        if idxA >= r:
            diffA = binom[idxA][r] - binom[idxA-1][r]
            sumB = binom[idxB][r]
            total += backtrack(A, B + diffA * sumB, idxA - 1, idxB)
        if idxB >= r:
            sumA = binom[idxA][r]
            diffB = binom[idxB][r] - binom[idxB-1][r]
            total += backtrack(A + sumA * diffB, B, idxA, idxB - 1)
        return total
    
    # Count paths function with memoization
    def countPaths(A, B, idxA, idxB):
        state = ((A << 18) ^ (B << 6) ^ (idxA << 3) ^ idxB)
        if state in memo:
            return memo[state]
        diff = abs(A - B)
        if diff - binom[idxA][r] * binom[idxB][r] > minDiff:
            memo[state] = 0
            return 0
        if idxA == 0 and idxB == 0:
            return 1
        cmd = pattern[idxA + idxB - 1]
        result = 0
        if idxA > 0 and cmd != 'B':
            diffA = binom[idxA][r] - binom[idxA-1][r]
            sumB = binom[idxB][r]
            result += countPaths(A, B + diffA * sumB, idxA - 1, idxB)
        if idxB > 0 and cmd != 'A':
            sumA = binom[idxA][r]
            diffB = binom[idxB][r] - binom[idxB-1][r]
            result += countPaths(A + sumA * diffB, B, idxA, idxB - 1)
        memo[state] = result
        return result
    
    # Run backtrack
    backtrack(0, 0, r + c, r + c)
    
    # Count paths
    paths = countPaths(0, 0, r + c, r + c)
    print(paths)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
import math

class Main:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r = 0
        self.c = 0
        self.binomial = [[0] * 130 for _ in range(130)]
        self.minimalDifference = float('inf')
        self.sequence = []
        self.freqA = [0] * 130
        self.freqB = [0] * 130
        self.memoization = {}

    def precompute(self):
        for i in range(130):
            self.binomial[i][0] = 1
            for j in range(1, i + 1):
                self.binomial[i][j] = self.binomial[i-1][j-1] + self.binomial[i-1][j]

    def search(self, leftVal, rightVal, leftIdx, rightIdx):
        diff = abs(leftVal - rightVal)
        if self.minimalDifference <= 1 or diff - self.binomial[leftIdx][self.r] * self.binomial[rightIdx][self.r] >= self.minimalDifference:
            return 0
        if leftIdx == self.r - 1 and rightIdx == self.r - 1:
            self.minimalDifference = min(self.minimalDifference, diff)
            return 1
        count = 0
        if leftIdx >= self.r:
            deltaL = self.binomial[leftIdx][self.r] - self.binomial[leftIdx-1][self.r]
            sumR = self.binomial[rightIdx][self.r]
            count += self.search(leftVal, rightVal + deltaL * sumR, leftIdx-1, rightIdx)
        if rightIdx >= self.r:
            sumL = self.binomial[leftIdx][self.r]
            deltaR = self.binomial[rightIdx][self.r] - self.binomial[rightIdx-1][self.r]
            count += self.search(leftVal + sumL * deltaR, rightVal, leftIdx, rightIdx-1)
        return count

    def countWays(self, leftVal, rightVal, leftIdx, rightIdx):
        key = (leftVal << 22) ^ (rightVal << 11) ^ (leftIdx << 6) ^ rightIdx
        if key in self.memoization:
            return self.memoization[key]
        diff = abs(leftVal - rightVal)
        if diff - self.binomial[leftIdx][self.r] * self.binomial[rightIdx][self.r] > self.minimalDifference:
            self.memoization[key] = 0
            return 0
        if leftIdx == 0 and rightIdx == 0:
            return 1
        action = self.sequence[leftIdx + rightIdx - 1]
        total = 0
        if leftIdx > 0 and action != 'B':
            deltaL = self.binomial[leftIdx][self.r] - self.binomial[leftIdx-1][self.r]
            sumR = self.binomial[rightIdx][self.r]
            total += self.countWays(leftVal, rightVal + deltaL * sumR, leftIdx-1, rightIdx)
        if rightIdx > 0 and action != 'A':
            sumL = self.binomial[leftIdx][self.r]
            deltaR = self.binomial[rightIdx][self.r] - self.binomial[rightIdx-1][self.r]
            total += self.countWays(leftVal + sumL * deltaR, rightVal, leftIdx, rightIdx-1)
        self.memoization[key] = total
        return total

    def execute(self):
        input_data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
        if not input_data:
            return
        first_line = input_data[0].split()
        self.r = int(first_line[0])
        self.c = int(first_line[1])
        if len(input_data) > 1:
            self.sequence = list(input_data[1])
        else:
            self.sequence = []
        self.precompute()
        pa = self.r + self.c
        pb = self.r + self.c
        l = 0
        rt = 0
        while pa >= self.r and pb >= self.r:
            if l > rt:
                delta = self.binomial[pa][self.r] - self.binomial[pa-1][self.r]
                sum_val = self.binomial[pb][self.r]
                rt += delta * sum_val
                pa -= 1
            else:
                sum_val = self.binomial[pa][self.r]
                delta = self.binomial[pb][self.r] - self.binomial[pb-1][self.r]
                l += sum_val * delta
                pb -= 1
        self.minimalDifference = abs(l - rt)
        self.search(0, 0, self.r + self.c, self.r + self.c)
        for i in range(2 * (self.r + self.c)):
            if i < len(self.sequence):
                self.freqA[i+1] = self.freqA[i] + (1 if self.sequence[i] == 'A' else 0)
                self.freqB[i+1] = self.freqB[i] + (1 if self.sequence[i] == 'B' else 0)
            else:
                self.freqA[i+1] = self.freqA[i]
                self.freqB[i+1] = self.freqB[i]
        result = self.countWays(0, 0, self.r + self.c, self.r + self.c)
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main_instance = Main()
    main_instance.execute()

problem_description.description: The game of Egg Roulette is played between two players. Initially 2R raw eggs and 2C cooked eggs are placed randomly into a carton. The shells are left on so there is no way to distinguish a raw egg from a cooked egg. One at a time, a player will select an egg, and then smash the egg on his/her forehead. If the egg was cooked, not much happens, but if the egg was raw, it will make quite the mess. This continues until one player has broken R raw eggs, at which point that player is declared the loser and the other player wins.The order in which players take turns can be described as a string of 'A' and 'B' characters, where the i-th character tells which player should choose the i-th egg. Traditionally, players take turns going one after the other. That is, they follow the ordering "ABABAB...". This isn't very fair though, because the second player will win more often than the first. We'd like you to find a better ordering for the players to take their turns. Let's define the unfairness of an ordering as the absolute difference between the first player's win probability and the second player's win probability. We're interested in orderings that minimize the unfairness. We only consider an ordering valid if it contains the same number of 'A's as 'B's.You will also be given a string S of length 2(R + C) containing only 'A', 'B', and '?' characters. An ordering is said to match S if it only differs from S in positions where S contains a '?'. Of the valid orderings that minimize unfairness, how many match S?
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input will contain integers R and C (1 ≤ R, C ≤ 20, R + C ≤ 30). The second line of input will contain the string S of length 2(R + C) consisting only of characters 'A', 'B', '?'.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of valid orderings that minimize unfairness and match S.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test case, the minimum unfairness is 0, and the orderings that achieve it are "ABBA" and "BAAB", neither of which match S. Note that an ordering such as "ABBB" would also have an unfairness of 0, but is invalid because it does not contain the same number of 'A's as 'B's.In the second example, the only matching ordering is "BBAAABABABBA".

import sys
import threading

def main():
    # Read input
    R, C = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    
    # Initialize ch (binomial coefficients)
    max_n = 2 * (R + C) + 61
    ch = [[0] * 61 for _ in range(max_n)]
    for i in range(max_n):
        for j in range(min(i, 60) + 1):
            if j == 0 or j == i:
                ch[i][j] = 1
            else:
                ch[i][j] = ch[i-1][j-1] + ch[i-1][j]
    
    # Initial path calculation
    x, y = 0, 0
    v1, v2 = R + C, R + C
    while v1 >= R and v2 >= R:
        if x > y:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            y += cur * other
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            x += cur * other
            v2 -= 1
    
    best = abs(x - y)
    
    # Read string
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    # Precompute cntA and cntB
    cntA = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 1)
    cntB = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 1)
    for i in range(2 * (R + C)):
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (1 if str_input[i] == 'A' else 0)
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (1 if str_input[i] == 'B' else 0)
    
    # Memoization cache
    cache = {}
    
    def solve(x, y, v1, v2):
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best:
            return 0
        key = (x << 7) | (v1 << 4) | v2
        if key in cache:
            return cache[key]
        
        if v1 < R or v2 < R:
            if v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] and v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]:
                sum_val = v1 + v2
                v1_new = v1 - cntA[sum_val]
                v2_new = v2 - cntB[sum_val]
                result = ch[v1_new + v2_new][v1_new]
                cache[key] = result
                return result
            cache[key] = 0
            return 0
        
        ans = 0
        c = str_input[v1 + v2 - 1]
        if c != 'B':
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if c != 'A':
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        
        cache[key] = ans
        return ans
    
    ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C)
    print(ans)

# Increase recursion limit and stack size for deep recursion
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
threading.stack_size(134217728)
thread = threading.Thread(target=main)
thread.start()
thread.join()

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Variant2 {
  static PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out)));
  
  int rows, cols;
  long[][] binom = new long[61][61];
  int[] numA = new int[61], numB = new int[61];
  long minDiff = Long.MAX_VALUE;
  String seq;
  Map<String, Long> memo = new HashMap<>();

  public static void main(String[] args) {
    Variant2 obj = new Variant2();
    obj.run();
    out.flush();
  }

  static int getInteger() {
    int val = 0;
    boolean negative = false;
    try {
      boolean seenDigit = false;
      for (int ch = 0; (ch = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (ch == '-') {
          seenDigit = true;
          negative = true;
          continue;
        } else if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
          seenDigit = true;
          val = val * 10 + ch - '0';
        } else if (seenDigit) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignored) {}
    return negative ? -val : val;
  }

  static long getLong() {
    long val = 0;
    boolean negative = false;
    try {
      boolean seenDigit = false;
      for (int ch = 0; (ch = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (ch == '-') {
          seenDigit = true;
          negative = true;
          continue;
        } else if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
          seenDigit = true;
          val = val * 10 + ch - '0';
        } else if (seenDigit) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignored) {}
    return negative ? -val : val;
  }

  static String getWord() {
    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
    try {
      boolean started = false;
      for (int ch = 0; (ch = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(ch) || ch == '?') {
          started = true;
          sb.append((char) ch);
        } else if (started) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignored) {}
    return sb.toString();
  }

  static int getChars(char[] arr, int offset) {
    int count = 0;
    try {
      boolean started = false;
      for (int ch = 0; (ch = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(ch)) {
          started = true;
          arr[offset + count++] = (char) ch;
        } else if (started) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignored) {}
    return count;
  }

  void explore(long aSum, long bSum, int idx1, int idx2) {
    long diff = Math.abs(aSum - bSum);
    if (minDiff <= 1 || diff - binom[idx1][rows] * binom[idx2][rows] >= minDiff) return;
    if (idx1 == rows - 1 && idx2 == rows - 1) {
      if (diff < minDiff) minDiff = diff;
      return;
    }
    if (idx1 >= rows) {
      long diff1 = binom[idx1][rows] - binom[idx1 - 1][rows];
      long factor = binom[idx2][rows];
      explore(aSum, bSum + diff1 * factor, idx1 - 1, idx2);
    }
    if (idx2 >= rows) {
      long diff2 = binom[idx2][rows] - binom[idx2 - 1][rows];
      long factor = binom[idx1][rows];
      explore(aSum + diff2 * factor, bSum, idx1, idx2 - 1);
    }
  }

  long search(long aSum, long bSum, int idx1, int idx2) {
    long diff = Math.abs(aSum - bSum);
    if (diff - binom[idx1][rows] * binom[idx2][rows] > minDiff) return 0L;
    String key = aSum + "," + idx1 + "," + idx2;
    Long cached = memo.get(key);
    if (cached != null) return cached;
    if (idx1 < rows || idx2 < rows) {
      if (idx1 >= numA[idx1 + idx2] && idx2 >= numB[idx1 + idx2]) {
        int sum = idx1 + idx2;
        idx1 -= numA[sum];
        idx2 -= numB[sum];
        return binom[idx1 + idx2][idx1];
      }
      return 0L;
    }
    long ways = 0L;
    char token = seq.charAt(idx1 + idx2 - 1);
    if (token != 'B') {
      long diff1 = binom[idx1][rows] - binom[idx1 - 1][rows];
      long factor = binom[idx2][rows];
      ways += search(aSum, bSum + diff1 * factor, idx1 - 1, idx2);
    }
    if (token != 'A') {
      long diff2 = binom[idx2][rows] - binom[idx2 - 1][rows];
      long factor = binom[idx1][rows];
      ways += search(aSum + diff2 * factor, bSum, idx1, idx2 - 1);
    }
    memo.put(key, ways);
    return ways;
  }

  void run() {
    rows = getInteger();
    cols = getInteger();
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (rows + cols); i++) {
      for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
        if (j == 0 || j == i) binom[i][j] = 1;
        else binom[i][j] = binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j];
      }
    }
    long left = 0, right = 0;
    int p1 = rows + cols, p2 = rows + cols;
    while (p1 >= rows && p2 >= rows) {
      if (left > right) {
        long diff1 = binom[p1][rows] - binom[p1 - 1][rows];
        long factor = binom[p2][rows];
        right += diff1 * factor;
        p1--;
      } else {
        long diff2 = binom[p2][rows] - binom[p2 - 1][rows];
        long factor = binom[p1][rows];
        left += diff2 * factor;
        p2--;
      }
    }
    minDiff = Math.abs(left - right);
    explore(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
    seq = getWord();
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (rows + cols); i++) {
      numA[i + 1] = numA[i] + (seq.charAt(i) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
      numB[i + 1] = numB[i] + (seq.charAt(i) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    long count = search(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
    out.println(count);
  }
}

public class Variant4 {

  long[][] bin = new long[61][61];
  int[] countA = new int[61], countB = new int[61];
  long minDiff = Long.MAX_VALUE;
  String s;
  Map<Long, Long> table = new HashMap<>();

  public static void main(String[] args) {
    Variant4 app = new Variant4();
    app.execute();
    pw.flush();
  }

  static int parseInt() {
    int x = 0;
    boolean minus = false;
    try {
      boolean digitsStarted = false;
      for (int b = 0; (b = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (b == '-') {
          digitsStarted = true;
          minus = true;
          continue;
        } else if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
          digitsStarted = true;
          x = x * 10 + b - '0';
        } else if (digitsStarted) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignore) {}
    return minus ? -x : x;
  }

  static long parseLong() {
    long x = 0;
    boolean minus = false;
    try {
      boolean digitsStarted = false;
      for (int b = 0; (b = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (b == '-') {
          digitsStarted = true;
          minus = true;

        } else if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
          digitsStarted = true;
          x = x * 10 + b - '0';
        } else if (digitsStarted) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignore) {}
    return minus ? -x : x;
  }

    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
    try {
      boolean tokenStarted = false;
      for (int b = 0; (b = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(b) || b == '?') {
          tokenStarted = true;
          sb.append((char) b);
        } else if (tokenStarted) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignore) {}
    return sb.toString();
  }

  static int parseChars(char[] buf, int offset) {
    int len = 0;
    try {
      boolean tokenStarted = false;
      for (int b = 0; (b = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(b)) {
          tokenStarted = true;
          buf[offset + len++] = (char) b;
        } else if (tokenStarted) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignore) {}
    return len;
  }

  void explore(long left, long right, int i, int j) {
    long diff = Math.abs(left - right);
    if (minDiff <= 1 || diff - bin[i][r] * bin[j][r] >= minDiff) return;
    if (i == r - 1 && j == r - 1) {
      if (diff < minDiff) minDiff = diff;
      return;
    }
    if (i >= r) {
      long diff1 = bin[i][r] - bin[i - 1][r];
      long factor = bin[j][r];
      explore(left, right + diff1 * factor, i - 1, j);
    }
    if (j >= r) {
      long diff2 = bin[j][r] - bin[j - 1][r];
      long factor = bin[i][r];
      explore(left + diff2 * factor, right, i, j - 1);
    }
  }

    int value = 0;

        if (ch == '-') {
          inNumber = true;
          negative = true;
          continue;
        } else if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
          inNumber = true;
          value = value * 10 + ch - '0';
        } else if (inNumber) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignore) {}

  }

  static long nextLongValue() {
    long value = 0;

        } else if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
          inNumber = true;
          value = value * 10 + ch - '0';
        } else if (inNumber) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignore) {}
    return negative ? -value : value;
  }

  static String nextStringValue() {
    StringBuilder buffer = new StringBuilder();
    try {
      boolean inToken = false;
      for (int ch = 0; (ch = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
        if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(ch) || ch == '?') {
          inToken = true;
          buffer.append((char) ch);
        } else if (inToken) break;
      }
    } catch (IOException ignore) {}
    return buffer.toString();
  }

import sys
import threading

def main():
    # Read input
    R, C = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    
    # Initialize ch table (binomial coefficients)
    max_n = 2 * (R + C) + 61
    ch = [[0] * 61 for _ in range(61)]
    for i in range(61):
        for j in range(61):
            if j == 0 or j == i:
                ch[i][j] = 1
            elif j < i:
                ch[i][j] = ch[i-1][j-1] + ch[i-1][j]
    
    # Initialize cntA and cntB arrays
    cntA = [0] * 61
    cntB = [0] * 61
    
    # Read the string
    str_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    # Precompute prefix counts for A and B
    for i in range(len(str_line)):
        cntA[i+1] = cntA[i] + (1 if str_line[i] == 'A' else 0)
        cntB[i+1] = cntB[i] + (1 if str_line[i] == 'B' else 0)
    
    # Initialize best and cache
    best = [float('inf')]
    cache = {}
    
    # First pass to compute initial best value
    x, y = 0, 0
    v1, v2 = R + C, R + C
    while v1 >= R and v2 >= R:
        if x > y:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            y += cur * other
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            x += cur * other
            v2 -= 1
    best[0] = abs(x - y)
    
    # DFS function
    def dfs(x, y, v1, v2):
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if best[0] <= 1 or diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best[0]:
            return
        if v1 == R - 1 and v2 == R - 1:
            if diff < best[0]:
                best[0] = diff
            return
        if v1 >= R:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 >= R:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)
    
    # Solve function with memoization
    def solve(x, y, v1, v2):
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best[0]:
            return 0
        key = (x << 16) + (v1 << 8) + v2
        if key in cache:
            return cache[key]
        if v1 < R or v2 < R:
            if v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] and v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]:
                sum_val = v1 + v2
                v1 -= cntA[sum_val]
                v2 -= cntB[sum_val]
                return ch[v1 + v2][v1]
            return 0
        ans = 0
        c = str_line[v1 + v2 - 1]
        if c != 'B':
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if c != 'A':
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        cache[key] = ans
        return ans
    
    # Run DFS
    dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C)
    
    # Run solve
    ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C)
    print(ans)

# Increase recursion limit and run
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
threading.Thread(target=main).start()

import sys

def main():
    import sys
    sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)
    
    # Fast input reading
    def read_int():
        ans = 0
        neg = False
        start = False
        while True:
            c = sys.stdin.read(1)
            if not c:
                break
            if c == '-':
                start = True
                neg = True
                continue
            elif c.isdigit():
                start = True
                ans = ans * 10 + ord(c) - ord('0')
            elif start:
                break
        return -ans if neg else ans

    def read_long():
        ans = 0
        neg = False
        start = False
        while True:
            c = sys.stdin.read(1)
            if not c:
                break
            if c == '-':
                start = True
                neg = True
                continue
            elif c.isdigit():
                start = True
                ans = ans * 10 + ord(c) - ord('0')
            elif start:
                break
        return -ans if neg else ans

    def read_string():
        b = []
        start = False
        while True:
            c = sys.stdin.read(1)
            if not c:
                break
            if not c.isspace():
                start = True
                b.append(c)
            elif start:
                break
        return ''.join(b)

    # Initialize
    R = read_int()
    C = read_int()
    
    # Precompute binomial coefficients
    max_n = 2 * (R + C) + 60
    ch = [[0] * (max_n + 1) for _ in range(max_n + 1)]
    for i in range(max_n + 1):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if j == 0 or j == i:
                ch[i][j] = 1
            else:
                ch[i][j] = ch[i-1][j-1] + ch[i-1][j]
    
    # Counters for A and B
    cntA = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 10)
    cntB = [0] * (2 * (R + C) + 10)
    
    best = float('inf')
    
    # DFS function
    def dfs(x, y, v1, v2):
        nonlocal best
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if best <= 1 or diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best:
            return
        if v1 == R - 1 and v2 == R - 1:
            if diff < best:
                best = diff
            return
        if v1 >= R:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 >= R:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)
    
    # Solve function with memoization
    cache = {}
    
    def solve(x, y, v1, v2):
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best:
            return 0
        key = (v2 << 20) ^ (v1 << 10) ^ (int(x) & 0x3FF)
        if key in cache:
            return cache[key]
        if v1 < R or v2 < R:
            if v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] and v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]:
                sum_val = v1 + v2
                v1 -= cntA[sum_val]
                v2 -= cntB[sum_val]
                result = ch[v1 + v2][v1]
                cache[key] = result
                return result
            cache[key] = 0
            return 0
        ans = 0
        c = str_input[v1 + v2 - 1]
        if c != 'B':
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if c != 'A':
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        cache[key] = ans
        return ans
    
    # Main logic

    y = 0
    v1 = R + C
    v2 = R + C
    while v1 >= R and v2 >= R:
        if x > y:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            y += cur * other
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            x += cur * other

import sys
import threading

def main():
    R, C = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    
    # Initialize ch array (Pascal's triangle)
    max_n = 2 * (R + C) + 10
    ch = [[0] * max_n for _ in range(max_n)]
    for i in range(max_n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if j == 0 or j == i:
                ch[i][j] = 1
            else:
                ch[i][j] = ch[i-1][j-1] + ch[i-1][j]
    
    # Read string
    str_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    # Initialize cntA and cntB arrays
    max_len = 2 * (R + C) + 10
    cntA = [0] * max_len
    cntB = [0] * max_len
    for i in range(len(str_line)):
        cntA[i+1] = cntA[i] + (1 if str_line[i] == 'A' else 0)
        cntB[i+1] = cntB[i] + (1 if str_line[i] == 'B' else 0)
    
    # Initial calculation
    x, y = 0, 0
    v1, v2 = R + C, R + C
    while v1 >= R and v2 >= R:
        if x > y:
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            y += cur * other
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            x += cur * other
            v2 -= 1
    
    best = abs(x - y)
    
    # Cache for memoization
    cache = {}
    
    def solve(x, y, v1, v2):
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best:
            return 0
        key = (v1 ^ v2 ^ (int(x) & 0xFF)) + ((v1 + v2) << 16)
        if key in cache:
            return cache[key]
        
        if v1 < R or v2 < R:
            if v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] and v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]:
                sum_val = v1 + v2
                v1_new = v1 - cntA[sum_val]
                v2_new = v2 - cntB[sum_val]
                result = ch[v1_new + v2_new][v1_new]
                cache[key] = result
                return result
            cache[key] = 0
            return 0
        
        ans = 0
        c = str_line[v1 + v2 - 1]
        if c != 'B':
            cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1-1][R]
            other = ch[v2][R]
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if c != 'A':
            cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2-1][R]
            other = ch[v1][R]
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        
        cache[key] = ans
        return ans
    
    ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C)
    print(ans)

# Increase recursion limit and stack size for deep recursion
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
threading.stack_size(100000000)

# Run main in a new thread to handle stack size
thread = threading.Thread(target=main)
thread.start()
thread.join()

problem_description.description: The game of Egg Roulette is played between two players. Initially 2R raw eggs and 2C cooked eggs are placed randomly into a carton. The shells are left on so there is no way to distinguish a raw egg from a cooked egg. One at a time, a player will select an egg, and then smash the egg on his/her forehead. If the egg was cooked, not much happens, but if the egg was raw, it will make quite the mess. This continues until one player has broken R raw eggs, at which point that player is declared the loser and the other player wins.The order in which players take turns can be described as a string of 'A' and 'B' characters, where the i-th character tells which player should choose the i-th egg. Traditionally, players take turns going one after the other. That is, they follow the ordering "ABABAB...". This isn't very fair though, because the second player will win more often than the first. We'd like you to find a better ordering for the players to take their turns. Let's define the unfairness of an ordering as the absolute difference between the first player's win probability and the second player's win probability. We're interested in orderings that minimize the unfairness. We only consider an ordering valid if it contains the same number of 'A's as 'B's.You will also be given a string S of length 2(R + C) containing only 'A', 'B', and '?' characters. An ordering is said to match S if it only differs from S in positions where S contains a '?'. Of the valid orderings that minimize unfairness, how many match S?
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input will contain integers R and C (1 ≤ R, C ≤ 20, R + C ≤ 30). The second line of input will contain the string S of length 2(R + C) consisting only of characters 'A', 'B', '?'.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of valid orderings that minimize unfairness and match S.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test case, the minimum unfairness is 0, and the orderings that achieve it are "ABBA" and "BAAB", neither of which match S. Note that an ordering such as "ABBB" would also have an unfairness of 0, but is invalid because it does not contain the same number of 'A's as 'B's.In the second example, the only matching ordering is "BBAAABABABBA".

import sys
import threading

def main():
    def read_int():
        nonlocal line_index, tokens
        while line_index >= len(tokens) or line_index >= len(line_tokens):
            line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
            if not line:
                return None
            line_tokens.clear()
            line_tokens.extend(line.split())
            line_index = 0
        val = int(line_tokens[line_index])
        line_index += 1
        return val

    line_tokens = []
    line_index = 0

    r = read_int()
    c = read_int()
    cs = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

    # Initialize C table
    max_n = 2 * (r + c) + 10
    C = [[0] * max_n for _ in range(max_n)]
    for i in range(max_n):
        for j in range(max_n):
            if j == 0:
                C[i][j] = 1
            elif i == 0:
                C[i][j] = 0
            else:
                C[i][j] = C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]

    # First pass to compute best
    v1 = v2 = r + c
    x = y = 0
    while v1 > 0 and v2 > 0:
        if x > y:
            c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1-1][r]
            s2 = C[v2][r]
            y += c1 * s2
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            s1 = C[v1][r]
            c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r]
            x += s1 * c2
            v2 -= 1
    best = abs(x - y)

    # DFS function
    def dfs(x, y, v1, v2):
        nonlocal best
        d = abs(x - y)
        if best <= 1 or d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= best:
            return
        if v1 == 0 and v2 == 0:
            if d < best:
                best = d
            return
        if v1 > 0:
            c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1-1][r]
            s2 = C[v2][r]
            dfs(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 > 0:
            s1 = C[v1][r]
            c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r]
            dfs(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1)

    dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c)

    # Count A and B
    cntA = [0] * (2 * (r + c) + 1)
    cntB = [0] * (2 * (r + c) + 1)
    for i in range(len(cs)):
        cntA[i+1] = cntA[i] + (1 if cs[i] == 'A' else 0)
        cntB[i+1] = cntB[i] + (1 if cs[i] == 'B' else 0)

    # Memoization cache
    cache = {}

    def solve(x, y, v1, v2):
        k = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2
        if k in cache:
            return cache[k]
        
        d = abs(x - y)
        if d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > best:
            cache[k] = 0
            return 0
        
        if v1 == 0 and v2 == 0:
            return 1
        
        c_char = cs[v1 + v2 - 1]
        res = 0
        if v1 > 0 and c_char != 'B':
            c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1-1][r]
            s2 = C[v2][r]
            res += solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 > 0 and c_char != 'A':
            s1 = C[v1][r]
            c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r]
            res += solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        
        cache[k] = res
        return res

    ans = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c)
    print(ans)

# Increase recursion limit and run
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
threading.Thread(target=main).start()

from collections import OrderedDict

class Test:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r = 0
        self.c = 0
        self.cs = []
        self.C = [[0] * 64 for _ in range(64)]
        self.best = float('inf')
        self.cntA = [0] * 64
        self.cntB = [0] * 64
        self.cache = OrderedDict()
        self.cache_max_size = 100000

    def read_int(self, input_lines, index):
        while index < len(input_lines) and input_lines[index].strip() == "":
            index += 1
        if index >= len(input_lines):
            raise ValueError("No more input")
        parts = input_lines[index].strip().split()
        index += 1
        return int(parts[0]), index

    def dfs(self, x, y, v1, v2):
        d = abs(x - y)
        if self.best <= 1 or d - self.C[v1][self.r] * self.C[v2][self.r] >= self.best:
            return
        if v1 == 0 and v2 == 0:
            if d < self.best:
                self.best = d
            return
        if v1 > 0:
            c1 = self.C[v1][self.r] - self.C[v1-1][self.r]
            s2 = self.C[v2][self.r]
            self.dfs(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 > 0:
            s1 = self.C[v1][self.r]
            c2 = self.C[v2][self.r] - self.C[v2-1][self.r]
            self.dfs(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1)

    def solve(self, x, y, v1, v2):
        k = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2
        if k in self.cache:
            return self.cache[k]
        
        v = 0
        d = abs(x - y)
        if d - self.C[v1][self.r] * self.C[v2][self.r] > self.best:
            self.cache[k] = v
            return v
        
        if v1 == 0 and v2 == 0:
            return 1
        
        c = self.cs[v1 + v2 - 1]
        if v1 > 0 and c != 'B':
            c1 = self.C[v1][self.r] - self.C[v1 - 1][self.r]
            s2 = self.C[v2][self.r]
            v += self.solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2)

            s1 = self.C[v1][self.r]
            c2 = self.C[v2][self.r] - self.C[v2-1][self.r]
            v += self.solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        
        if len(self.cache) >= self.cache_max_size:
            self.cache.popitem(last=False)
        self.cache[k] = v
        return v

    def start(self, input_lines):
        index = 0
        self.r, index = self.read_int(input_lines, index)
        self.c, index = self.read_int(input_lines, index)
        line = input_lines[index].strip()
        index += 1
        self.cs = list(line)
        
        for i in range(2 * (self.r + self.c) + 1):

                if j == 0:
                    self.C[i][j] = 1
                elif i == 0:
                    self.C[i][j] = 0
                else:
                    self.C[i][j] = self.C[i-1][j-1] + self.C[i-1][j]
        
        v1 = self.r + self.c
        v2 = self.r + self.c
        x = 0
        y = 0
        while v1 > 0 and v2 > 0:
            if x > y:
                c1 = self.C[v1][self.r] - self.C[v1 - 1][self.r]
                s2 = self.C[v2][self.r]
                y += c1 * s2
                v1 -= 1
            else:
                s1 = self.C[v1][self.r]
                c2 = self.C[v2][self.r] - self.C[v2-1][self.r]
                x += s1 * c2
                v2 -= 1
        
        self.best = abs(x - y)
        self.dfs(0, 0, self.r + self.c, self.r + self.c)

            self.cntB[i + 1] = self.cntB[i] + (1 if self.cs[i] == 'B' else 0)
        
        ans = self.solve(0, 0, self.r + self.c, self.r + self.c)
        print(ans)

def main():
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    test = Test()
    test.start(input_lines)

import sys
from functools import lru_cache

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    
    r, c = map(int, data[0].split())
    cs = data[1].strip()
    
    # Precompute binomial coefficients C[i][j]
    max_n = 2 * (r + c) + 10
    C = [[0] * max_n for _ in range(max_n)]
    for i in range(max_n):
        for j in range(max_n):
            if j == 0:
                C[i][j] = 1
            elif i == 0:
                C[i][j] = 0
            else:
                C[i][j] = C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]
    
    # Initialize best with a large value
    best = float('inf')
    
    # First pass to compute initial best
    v1 = r + c
    v2 = r + c
    x = 0
    y = 0
    while v1 > 0 and v2 > 0:
        if x > y:
            c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1-1][r]
            s2 = C[v2][r]
            y += c1 * s2
            v1 -= 1
        else:
            s1 = C[v1][r]
            c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r]
            x += s1 * c2
            v2 -= 1
    
    best = abs(x - y)
    
    # DFS function to find better solutions
    def dfs(x, y, v1, v2):
        nonlocal best
        d = abs(x - y)
        if best <= 1 or d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= best:
            return
        if v1 == 0 and v2 == 0:
            if d < best:
                best = d
            return
        if v1 > 0:
            c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1-1][r]
            s2 = C[v2][r]
            dfs(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 > 0:
            s1 = C[v1][r]
            c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r]
            dfs(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1)
    
    dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c)
    
    # Count A and B characters
    cntA = [0] * (2 * (r + c) + 1)
    cntB = [0] * (2 * (r + c) + 1)
    for i in range(len(cs)):
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (1 if cs[i] == 'A' else 0)
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (1 if cs[i] == 'B' else 0)
    
    # Memoized solve function
    cache = {}
    
    def solve(x, y, v1, v2):
        k = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2
        if k in cache:
            return cache[k]
        
        d = abs(x - y)
        if d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > best:
            cache[k] = 0
            return 0
        
        if v1 == 0 and v2 == 0:
            return 1
        
        c_char = cs[v1 + v2 - 1]
        v = 0
        if v1 > 0 and c_char != 'B':
            c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1-1][r]
            s2 = C[v2][r]
            v += solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 > 0 and c_char != 'A':
            s1 = C[v1][r]
            c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r]
            v += solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        
        cache[k] = v
        return v
    
    ans = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        self.cntB = [0] * 64
        self.cache = {}

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

import sys

basePowers = []
subsetTotals = []

def enumerateSubsets(depth, runningSum):
    if depth == len(basePowers):
        subsetTotals.append(runningSum)
        return
    enumerateSubsets(depth + 1, runningSum + basePowers[depth])
    enumerateSubsets(depth + 1, runningSum)

def satisfiesCondition(M, W, trial):
    if trial == M:
        return True
    temp = trial + M
    while temp > 0:
        if temp % W > 1:
            return False
        temp //= W
    return True

def main():
    global basePowers, subsetTotals
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    W = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    
    if W == 2:
        print("YES")
        return
    
    basePowers = []
    basePowers.append(1)
    basePowers.append(W)
    power = W
    ceiling = 10**10
    
    while True:
        power *= W
        if power <= 0 or power > ceiling:
            break
        basePowers.append(power)
    
    subsetTotals = []
    enumerateSubsets(0, 0)
    
    matchFound = False
    for t in subsetTotals:
        if satisfiesCondition(M, W, t):
            matchFound = True
            break
    
    print("YES" if matchFound else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys

exponentials = []
combinationSums = []

def produceCombinations(position, accumulated):
    if position == len(exponentials):
        combinationSums.append(accumulated)
        return
    produceCombinations(position + 1, accumulated + exponentials[position])
    produceCombinations(position + 1, accumulated)

def fulfillsRequirement(M, W, testValue):
    if testValue == M:
        return True
    x = testValue + M
    while x > 0:
        if x % W > 1:
            return False
        x //= W
    return True

def main():
    global exponentials, combinationSums
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    W = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    
    if W == 2:
        print("YES")
        return
    
    exponentials = [1, W]
    power = W
    maxLimit = 10**10
    
    while True:
        power *= W
        if power <= 0 or power > maxLimit:
            break
        exponentials.append(power)
    
    combinationSums = []
    produceCombinations(0, 0)
    
    solutionFound = False
    for val in combinationSums:
        if fulfillsRequirement(M, W, val):
            solutionFound = True
            break
    
    print("YES" if solutionFound else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    flag = True
    digits = [0] * 40
    idx = 0
    
    while m != 0:
        digits[idx] = m % w
        idx += 1
        m //= w
    
    for i in range(idx + 1):
        d = digits[i]
        if d != 0 and d != 1 and d != w and d != w - 1:
            flag = False
            break
        if d == w or d == w - 1:
            digits[i + 1] += 1
    
    print("YES" if flag else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

import sys

def main():
    sc = sys.stdin
    w = int(sc.readline().strip())
    m = int(sc.readline().strip())
    if w < 4:
        print("YES")
        return
    while m > 0:
        remainder = m % w
        next_val = m + 1
        if remainder > 1 and remainder != w - 1:
            print("NO")
            return
        m = next_val // w
    print("YES")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys

def main():
    sc = sys.stdin
    w = int(sc.readline().strip())
    m = int(sc.readline().strip())
    
    current = m
    possible = True
    
    if w >= 4:
        while current > 0:
            r = current % w
            if r > 1 and r != w - 1:
                possible = False
                break
            current = (current + 1) // w
    
    print("YES" if possible else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    private static class FastReader {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public FastReader(InputStream inputStream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream), 1 << 16);
            tokenizer = null;
        }

        public String next() {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                }
                catch (IOException ex) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(ex);
                }
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public String nextLine() {
            try {
                return reader.readLine();
            }
            catch (IOException ex) {
                throw new RuntimeException(ex);
            }
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastReader in = new FastReader(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int w = in.nextInt(), m = in.nextInt();
        boolean res = true;
        while (m > 0) {
            int remainder = m % w;
            if (remainder == 0) {
                m /= w;
            } else if (remainder == 1) {
                m = (m - 1) / w;
            } else if (remainder == w - 1) {
                m = (m + 1) / w;
            } else {
                res = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        out.println(res ? "YES" : "NO");

        out.flush();
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    private static class FastReader {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public FastReader(InputStream inputStream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream), 1 << 16);
            tokenizer = null;
        }

        public String next() {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                }
                catch (IOException ex) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(ex);
                }
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public String nextLine() {
            try {
                return reader.readLine();
            }
            catch (IOException ex) {
                throw new RuntimeException(ex);
            }
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastReader in = new FastReader(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int w = in.nextInt(), m = in.nextInt();
        boolean res = true;
        while (m > 0) {
            int mod = m % w;
            if (mod == 0) {
                m /= w;
            } else if (mod == 1) {
                m -= 1;
                m /= w;
            } else if (mod == w - 1) {
                m += 1;
                m /= w;
            } else {
                res = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        out.println(res ? "YES" : "NO");

        out.flush();
    }
}

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    a = [0] * 101
    
    for i in range(101):
        a[i] = m % w
        m //= w
    
    c = 0
    s = True
    for i in range(101):
        a[i] += c
        c = a[i] // w
        a[i] = a[i] % w
        
        if a[i] == 1 or a[i] == 0:
            continue
        elif a[i] == w - 1:
            c = 1
        else:
            s = False
            break
    
    print("YES" if s and c != 1 else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FastReader {
        private final BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        public FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        double nextDouble() throws IOException {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }
    }

    static boolean canBalance(int w, int m) {
        if (m == 0) return true;
        if (m == 1) return true;
        if (w == 1) return m >= 0;
        if (w == 0) return m == 0;
        
        int r = Math.floorMod(m, w);
        if (r == 0) {
            return canBalance(w, m / w);
        } else if (r == 1) {
            return canBalance(w, (m - 1) / w);
        } else if (r == w - 1) {
            return canBalance(w, (m + 1) / w);
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastReader fr = new FastReader();
        int w = fr.nextInt();
        int m = fr.nextInt();
        
        boolean result = canBalance(w, m) || 
                         canBalance(w, m - 1) || 
                         canBalance(w, m + 1);
        
        System.out.println(result ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class InputReader {
        private final InputStream is;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
        private int ptr = 0, len = 0;

        InputReader(InputStream is) {
            this.is = is;
        }

        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (ptr >= len) {
                len = is.read(buffer);
                ptr = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[ptr++];
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int c, sign = 1, val = 0;
            do { c = read(); } while (c <= ' ');
            if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = read(); }
            while (c > ' ') {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return val * sign;
        }
    }

    static boolean check(int w, int m) {
        if (m == 0) return true;
        if (m < 0) m = -m;
        if (w <= 1) return m == 0 || m == 1;
        
        while (m > 1) {
            int rem = m % w;
            if (rem == 0) {
                m /= w;
            } else if (rem == 1) {
                m = (m - 1) / w;
            } else if (rem == w - 1) {
                m = (m + 1) / w;
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        InputReader ir = new InputReader(System.in);
        int w = ir.nextInt();
        int m = ir.nextInt();
        
        boolean possible = check(w, m) || check(w, m - 1) || check(w, m + 1);
        System.out.println(possible ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Scanner {
        private BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        private StringTokenizer st;

        String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }

    static boolean solve(int w, int m) {
        if (m == 0) return true;
        if (m == 1) return true;
        if (w == 1) return m >= 0;
        if (w == 0) return m == 0;
        
        int remainder = Math.floorMod(m, w);
        if (remainder == 0) {
            return solve(w, m / w);
        } else if (remainder == 1) {
            return solve(w, (m - 1) / w);
        } else if (remainder == w - 1) {
            return solve(w, (m + 1) / w);
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner();
        int w = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        
        boolean result = solve(w, m) || solve(w, m - 1) || solve(w, m + 1);
        System.out.println(result ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class OptimizedReader {
        private final InputStream in;
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
        private int ptr = 0, len = 0;

        OptimizedReader(InputStream is) { in = is; }

        private int getByte() throws IOException {
            if (ptr >= len) {
                len = in.read(buf);
                ptr = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[ptr++];
        }

        int readInt() throws IOException {
            int c, n = 0, s = 1;
            while ((c = getByte()) <= 32 && c != -1);
            if (c == '-') { s = -1; c = getByte(); }
            for (; c > 32; c = getByte()) n = n * 10 + c - '0';
            return n * s;
        }
    }

    static boolean isPossible(int base, int mass) {
        if (mass == 0) return true;
        if (mass == 1) return true;
        if (base <= 1) return mass == 0 || mass == 1;
        
        int mod = Math.floorMod(mass, base);
        if (mod == 0) return isPossible(base, mass / base);
        if (mod == 1) return isPossible(base, (mass - 1) / base);
        if (mod == base - 1) return isPossible(base, (mass + 1) / base);
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        OptimizedReader reader = new OptimizedReader(System.in);
        int w = reader.readInt();
        int m = reader.readInt();
        
        boolean ok = isPossible(w, m) || 
                     isPossible(w, m - 1) || 
                     isPossible(w, m + 1);
        System.out.println(ok ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Reader {
        private final BufferedReader reader;

        Reader() {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(reader.readLine().trim());
        }
    }

    static boolean check(int w, int m) {
        if (m == 0) return true;
        if (m < 0) m = -m;
        if (w == 1) return true;
        if (w == 0) return m == 0;
        
        while (m > 1) {
            int r = m % w;
            if (r == 0) {
                m /= w;
            } else if (r == 1) {
                m = (m - 1) / w;
            } else if (r == w - 1) {
                m = (m + 1) / w;
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Reader rd = new Reader();
        int w = rd.nextInt();
        int m = rd.nextInt();
        
        boolean res = check(w, m) || check(w, m - 1) || check(w, m + 1);
        System.out.println(res ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

import math

weight = 0
itemMass = 0
used = [False] * 100

def get_weight_for(target):
    global weight, used
    if target <= 0:
        return 0
    
    k = int(math.log(target) / math.log(weight)) if weight > 1 else 0
    # Calculate sum = (weight^(k+1) - 1) / (weight - 1)
    w = weight
    sum_val = (w ** (k + 1) - 1) // (w - 1) if w > 1 else k + 1
    
    if target > sum_val and not used[k + 1]:
        used[k + 1] = True
        return w ** (k + 1)
    elif target <= sum_val and not used[k]:
        used[k] = True
        return w ** k
    return 0

def is_balanced():
    global weight, itemMass, used
    left = itemMass
    right = 0
    
    for _ in range(200):
        if left == right:
            return True
        if left > right:
            diff = left - right
            candidate = get_weight_for(diff)
            if candidate == 0:
                break
            right += candidate
        else:
            diff = right - left
            candidate = get_weight_for(diff)
            if candidate == 0:
                break
            left += candidate
    return False

def main():
    global weight, itemMass, used
    weight = int(input().strip())
    itemMass = int(input().strip())
    # Reset used array for each run
    used = [False] * 100
    result = is_balanced()
    print("YES" if result else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import math

weight = 0
itemMass = 0
used = [False] * 100

def find_next_weight(target):
    global weight, used
    if target <= 0:
        return 0
    
    k = int(math.log(target) / math.log(weight)) if weight > 1 else 0
    # Calculate total = (weight^(k+1) - 1) / (weight - 1)
    w = weight
    total_val = (w ** (k + 1) - 1) // (w - 1) if w > 1 else k + 1
    
    if target > total_val and not used[k + 1]:
        used[k + 1] = True
        return w ** (k + 1)
    elif not used[k]:
        used[k] = True
        return w ** k
    return 0

def is_balanced():
    global weight, itemMass, used
    left = itemMass
    right = 0
    
    while True:
        if left == right:
            return True
        diff = abs(left - right)
        candidate = find_next_weight(diff)
        if candidate == 0:
            return False
        if left > right:
            right += candidate
        else:
            left += candidate

def main():
    global weight, itemMass, used
    weight = int(input().strip())
    itemMass = int(input().strip())
    # Reset used array for each run
    used = [False] * 100
    result = is_balanced()
    print("YES" if result else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class Main implements Runnable {
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MI = (int) 1e9;
    static final long ML = (long) 1e18;
    static final Reader in = new Reader();
    static final PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
    static final StringBuilder answer = new StringBuilder();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Thread(null, new Main(), "persefone", 1 << 32).start();
    }

    @Override
    public void run() {
        solve();
        flush();
    }

    void solve() {
        int w = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        if (w <= 3) {
            answer.append("YES\n");
            return;
        }

        List<Long> powers = new ArrayList<>();
        long x = 1;
        long limit = (long) 1e10;
        while (x <= limit) {
            powers.add(x);
            x *= w;
        }

        int n = powers.size();
        long[] arr = powers.stream().mapToLong(Long::longValue).toArray();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            long val = m;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) val += arr[i];
            }
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 0 && val >= arr[i]) {
                    val -= arr[i];
                }
            }
            if (val == 0) {
                answer.append("YES\n");
                return;
            }
        }
        answer.append("NO\n");
    }

    void flush() {
        out.print(answer);
        out.flush();
    }

    static class Reader {
        private BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        Reader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }
