import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class Main implements Runnable {
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MI = (int) 1e9;
    static final long ML = (long) 1e18;
    static final Reader in = new Reader();
    static final PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
    static final StringBuilder answer = new StringBuilder();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Thread(null, new Main(), "persefone", 1 << 32).start();
    }

    @Override
    public void run() {
        solve();
        flush();
    }

    void solve() {
        int w = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        if (w <= 3) {
            answer.append("YES\n");
            return;
        }

        List<Long> powers = new ArrayList<>();
        long x = 1;
        long limit = (long) 1e10;
        while (x <= limit) {
            powers.add(x);
            x *= w;
        }

        int n = powers.size();
        long[] arr = powers.stream().mapToLong(Long::longValue).toArray();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            long val = m;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) val += arr[i];
            }
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 0 && val >= arr[i]) {
                    val -= arr[i];
                }
            }
            if (val == 0) {
                answer.append("YES\n");
                return;
            }
        }
        answer.append("NO\n");
    }

    void flush() {
        out.print(answer);
        out.flush();
    }

    static class Reader {
        private BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        Reader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            try {
                while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                }
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class Main implements Runnable {
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MI = (int) 1e9;
    static final long ML = (long) 1e18;
    static final Reader in = new Reader();
    static final PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
    static final StringBuilder answer = new StringBuilder();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Thread(null, new Main(), "persefone", 1 << 32).start();
    }

    @Override
    public void run() {
        solve();
        flush();
    }

    void solve() {
        int w = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        if (w <= 3) {
            answer.append("YES\n");
            return;
        }

        List<Long> powers = new ArrayList<>();
        long x = 1;
        long limit = (long) 1e10;
        while (x <= limit) {
            powers.add(x);
            x *= w;
        }

        int n = powers.size();
        long[] arr = powers.stream().mapToLong(Long::longValue).toArray();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            long val = m;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) val += arr[i];
            }
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 0 && val >= arr[i]) {
                    val -= arr[i];
                }
            }
            if (val == 0) {
                answer.append("YES\n");
                return;
            }
        }
        answer.append("NO\n");
    }

    void flush() {
        out.print(answer);
        out.flush();
    }

    static class Reader {
        private BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        Reader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            try {
                while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                }
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class Main implements Runnable {
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MI = (int) 1e9;
    static final long ML = (long) 1e18;
    static final Reader in = new Reader();
    static final PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
    static final StringBuilder answer = new StringBuilder();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Thread(null, new Main(), "persefone", 1 << 32).start();
    }

    @Override
    public void run() {
        solve();
        flush();
    }

    void solve() {
        int w = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        if (w <= 3) {
            answer.append("YES\n");
            return;
        }

        List<Long> powers = new ArrayList<>();
        long x = 1;
        long limit = (long) 1e10;
        while (x <= limit) {
            powers.add(x);
            x *= w;
        }

        int n = powers.size();
        long[] arr = powers.stream().mapToLong(Long::longValue).toArray();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            long val = m;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) val += arr[i];
            }
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 0 && val >= arr[i]) {
                    val -= arr[i];
                }
            }
            if (val == 0) {
                answer.append("YES\n");
                return;
            }
        }
        answer.append("NO\n");
    }

    void flush() {
        out.print(answer);
        out.flush();
    }

    static class Reader {
        private BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        Reader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            try {
                while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                }
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

problem_description.description: Vanya has a scales for weighing loads and weights of masses w0, w1, w2, ..., w100 grams where w is some integer not less than 2 (exactly one weight of each nominal value). Vanya wonders whether he can weight an item with mass m using the given weights, if the weights can be put on both pans of the scales. Formally speaking, your task is to determine whether it is possible to place an item of mass m and some weights on the left pan of the scales, and some weights on the right pan of the scales so that the pans of the scales were in balance.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers w, m (2 ≤ w ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109) — the number defining the masses of the weights and the mass of the item.
problem_description.output_spec: Print word 'YES' if the item can be weighted and 'NO' if it cannot.
problem_description.notes: NoteNote to the first sample test. One pan can have an item of mass 7 and a weight of mass 3, and the second pan can have two weights of masses 9 and 1, correspondingly. Then 7 + 3 = 9 + 1.Note to the second sample test. One pan of the scales can have an item of mass 99 and the weight of mass 1, and the second pan can have the weight of mass 100.Note to the third sample test. It is impossible to measure the weight of the item in the manner described in the input.

import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    c = [0] * 35
    tmp = m
    ind = 0
    f = True
    
    while tmp > 0:
        c[ind] += tmp % w
        if c[ind] == w:
            c[ind] = 0
            c[ind + 1] += 1
        if c[ind] > 1:
            if c[ind] == w - 1:
                c[ind + 1] += 1
            else:
                f = False
                break
        tmp //= w
        ind += 1
    
    print("YES" if f else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.description: Calculate the number of ways to place $$$n$$$ rooks on $$$n \times n$$$ chessboard so that both following conditions are met:  each empty cell is under attack;  exactly $$$k$$$ pairs of rooks attack each other. An empty cell is under attack if there is at least one rook in the same row or at least one rook in the same column. Two rooks attack each other if they share the same row or column, and there are no other rooks between them. For example, there are only two pairs of rooks that attack each other in the following picture:  One of the ways to place the rooks for $$$n = 3$$$ and $$$k = 2$$$ Two ways to place the rooks are considered different if there exists at least one cell which is empty in one of the ways but contains a rook in another way.The answer might be large, so print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The only line of the input contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 200000$$$; $$$0 \le k \le \frac{n(n - 1)}{2}$$$).
problem_description.output_spec: Print one integer — the number of ways to place the rooks, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.

translation.translated_code:
import sys

MD = 998244353

def power(a, k):
    if k == 0:
        return 1
    p = power(a, k >> 1)
    p = p * p % MD
    if (k & 1) == 1:
        p = p * a % MD
    return p

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(input_data[idx]); idx += 1
    k_ = int(input_data[idx]); idx += 1
    
    if k_ >= n:
        print(0)
        return
    
    c = n - int(k_)
    
    ff = [0] * (n + n)
    gg = [0] * (n + n)
    
    f = 1
    for i in range(n + n):
        ff[i] = f
        gg[i] = int(power(f, MD - 2))
        f = int(f * (i + 1) % MD)
    
    def ch(n_val, k_val):
        return ff[n_val] * gg[k_val] % MD * gg[n_val - k_val] % MD
    
    ans = 0
    for a in range(1, c + 1):
        x = power(a, n) * ch(c, a) % MD
        if (c - a) % 2 == 0:
            ans = (ans + x) % MD
        else:
            ans = (ans - x) % MD
    
    ans %= MD
    if ans < 0:
        ans += MD
    
    ans = ans * ch(n, c) % MD
    
    if k_ > 0:
        ans = ans * 2 % MD
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def mod_pow(base, exp, mod):
    """Compute base^exp % mod using Python's built-in pow with three arguments"""
    return pow(base, exp, mod)

    k = int(data[1])

    r = n - k
    fact = [0] * (n + 1)
    inv_fact = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    fact[0] = 1
    inv_fact[0] = mod_pow(fact[0], MOD - 2, MOD)
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):

import sys

MOD = 998244353

def mod_pow(base, exponent):
    base %= MOD
    result = 1
    while exponent > 0:
        if (exponent & 1) == 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exponent >>= 1
    return result

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    if k >= n:
        print(0)
        return
    
    r = n - k
    factorial = [0] * (n + 1)
    inv_factorial = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    factorial[0] = 1
    inv_factorial[0] = mod_pow(factorial[0], MOD - 2)
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        factorial[i] = (i * factorial[i - 1]) % MOD
        inv_factorial[i] = mod_pow(factorial[i], MOD - 2)
    
    accumulated = 0
    for i in range(1, r + 1):
        binomial = factorial[r]
        binomial = (binomial * inv_factorial[i]) % MOD
        binomial = (binomial * inv_factorial[r - i]) % MOD
        power_term = mod_pow(i, n)
        current_term = (binomial * power_term) % MOD
        if (r - i) % 2 == 1:
            current_term = (MOD - current_term) % MOD
        accumulated = (accumulated + current_term) % MOD
    
    final_result = (accumulated * factorial[n]) % MOD
    final_result = (final_result * inv_factorial[r]) % MOD
    final_result = (final_result * inv_factorial[n - r]) % MOD
    
    if k == 0:
        print(final_result)
    else:
        print((2 * final_result) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":

problem_description.description: Calculate the number of ways to place $$$n$$$ rooks on $$$n \times n$$$ chessboard so that both following conditions are met:  each empty cell is under attack;  exactly $$$k$$$ pairs of rooks attack each other. An empty cell is under attack if there is at least one rook in the same row or at least one rook in the same column. Two rooks attack each other if they share the same row or column, and there are no other rooks between them. For example, there are only two pairs of rooks that attack each other in the following picture:  One of the ways to place the rooks for $$$n = 3$$$ and $$$k = 2$$$ Two ways to place the rooks are considered different if there exists at least one cell which is empty in one of the ways but contains a rook in another way.The answer might be large, so print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The only line of the input contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 200000$$$; $$$0 \le k \le \frac{n(n - 1)}{2}$$$).
problem_description.output_spec: Print one integer — the number of ways to place the rooks, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.

import sys
import math

MOD = 998244353
INF = 3000000000000000000

class utkarsh_v2:
    def __init__(self):
        self.reader = sys.stdin
        self.writer = sys.stdout
        self.fact = None
        self.invFact = None
    
    def comb(self, n, r):
        if r < 0 or r > n:
            return 0
        return self.fact[n] * self.invFact[r] % MOD * self.invFact[n-r] % MOD
    
    def compute(self):
        n = int(self.reader.readline().strip())
        k = int(self.reader.readline().strip())
        
        if k >= n:
            self.writer.write("0\n")
            return
        
        self.fact = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.invFact = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.fact[0] = 1
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            self.fact[i] = self.fact[i-1] * i % MOD
        
        self.invFact[n] = pow(self.fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD)
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            self.invFact[i] = self.invFact[i+1] * (i + 1) % MOD
        
        if k == 0:
            self.writer.write(f"{self.fact[n]}\n")
        else:
            r = n - int(k)
            total = 0
            sign = 1
            for i in range(r):
                term = sign * self.comb(r, i) % MOD * pow(r - i, n, MOD) % MOD
                total = (total + term) % MOD
                sign = -sign
            
            result = 2 * self.comb(n, r) % MOD * ((total % MOD + MOD) % MOD) % MOD
            self.writer.write(f"{(result % MOD + MOD) % MOD}\n")
    
    def run(self):
        self.compute()
        self.writer.flush()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    utkarsh_v2().run()

problem_description.description: Calculate the number of ways to place $$$n$$$ rooks on $$$n \times n$$$ chessboard so that both following conditions are met:  each empty cell is under attack;  exactly $$$k$$$ pairs of rooks attack each other. An empty cell is under attack if there is at least one rook in the same row or at least one rook in the same column. Two rooks attack each other if they share the same row or column, and there are no other rooks between them. For example, there are only two pairs of rooks that attack each other in the following picture:  One of the ways to place the rooks for $$$n = 3$$$ and $$$k = 2$$$ Two ways to place the rooks are considered different if there exists at least one cell which is empty in one of the ways but contains a rook in another way.The answer might be large, so print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The only line of the input contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 200000$$$; $$$0 \le k \le \frac{n(n - 1)}{2}$$$).
problem_description.output_spec: Print one integer — the number of ways to place the rooks, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.

import sys
import math

mod = 998244353

def mod_pow(a, e):
    a %= mod
    res = 1
    while e > 0:
        if e & 1:
            res = (res * a) % mod
        a = (a * a) % mod
        e >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(input_data[idx])
    idx += 1
    k = int(input_data[idx])
    idx += 1
    
    if k >= n:
        print(0)
        return
    
    fac = [1] * (n + 1)
    invfac = [1] * (n + 1)
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fac[i] = (i * fac[i - 1]) % mod
    
    invfac[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        invfac[i] = (invfac[i - 1] * mod_pow(i, mod - 2)) % mod
    
    def nck(n_val, k_val):
        return fac[n_val] * invfac[k_val] % mod * invfac[n_val - k_val] % mod
    
    m = n - k
    posans = 0
    negans = 0
    
    for i in range(0, m + 1):
        term = mod_pow(m - i, n) * nck(m, i) % mod
        if i % 2 == 0:
            posans = (posans + term) % mod
        else:
            negans = (negans + term) % mod
    
    ans = (posans - negans + 2 * mod) % mod
    ans = ans * nck(n, m) % mod
    
    if m != n:
        ans = (ans * 2) % mod
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    base %= MOD
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

        m >>= 1

    if m == 0 or m == n:

        return 0

def mod_exp(base, exp):

    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if (exp & 1) == 1:
            res = (res * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    import sys
    tokens = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    n = int(tokens[0])
    k_val = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    
    if k_val >= n:
        print(0)
        return
    k = int(k_val)

    inv_factorial = [0] * (n + 1)

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        factorial[i] = (factorial[i - 1] * i) % MOD

    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        inv_factorial[i - 1] = (inv_factorial[i] * i) % MOD
    
    total = 0
    alternating = 1
    for i in range(0, n - k + 1):
        binomial = (factorial[n - k] * inv_factorial[i] % MOD) * inv_factorial[n - k - i] % MOD
        power_term = mod_exp(n - k - i, n)
        addend = (alternating * binomial % MOD) * power_term % MOD
        total = (total + addend) % MOD
        alternating = -alternating
    
    total = (total * factorial[n] % MOD) * inv_factorial[k] % MOD * inv_factorial[n - k] % MOD
    if total < 0:
        total += MOD
    
    if k == 0:
        print(total)
    else:

Two rooks attack each other if they share the same row or column, and there are no other rooks between them. def powMod(a, b):
    ans = 1
    d = a % mod
    while b > 0:
        if b % 2 == 1:

        b >>= 1
        d = (d * d) % mod
    return ans

        fac[i] = (fac[i-1] * i) % mod
        inv[i] = (inv[i-1] * powMod(i, mod - 2)) % mod

    if exp < 0:

    base %= mod
    while exp > 0:

        base = (base * base) % mod

    return res

def fast_pow(base, exp, modulus):
    if exp < 0:
        return 0
    result = 1
    base %= modulus
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % modulus
        base = (base * base) % modulus
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def precompute_factorials(max_n):
    factorial = [1] * (max_n + 1)
    for i in range(1, max_n + 1):
        factorial[i] = (i * factorial[i-1]) % MOD
    return factorial

def n_choose_k(n, k, factorial):
    if k < 0 or k > n:
        return 0
    denom = (factorial[k] * factorial[n - k]) % MOD
    inv_denom = fast_pow(denom, MOD - 2, MOD)
    return (factorial[n] * inv_denom) % MOD

import sys
import math

def pow_mod(a, n, mod):
    a %= mod
    ret = 1
    while n > 0:
        if n & 1:
            ret = ret * a % mod
        a = a * a % mod
        n >>= 1
    return ret

def modinv(a, mod):
    # Extended Euclidean Algorithm
    g, x, _ = extended_gcd(a, mod)
    if g != 1:
        raise ValueError('Modular inverse does not exist')
    return x % mod

def extended_gcd(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        return a, 1, 0
    g, x1, y1 = extended_gcd(b, a % b)
    return g, y1, x1 - (a // b) * y1

def enumFIF(n, mod):
    f = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        f[i] = f[i-1] * i % mod
    
    invf = [1] * (n + 1)
    invf[n] = pow_mod(f[n], mod - 2, mod)  # Using Fermat's little theorem
    
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        invf[i] = invf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod
    
    return [f, invf]

def C(n, r, mod, fif):
    if n < 0 or r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % mod * fif[1][n - r] % mod

def solve():
    mod = 998244353
    n = int(input())
    K = int(input())
    
    if K >= n:
        print(0)
        return
    
    fif = enumFIF(250000, mod)
    
    if K == 0:
        print(fif[0][n])
        return
    
    ans = 0
    s = 1
    for i in range(n - K, 0, -1):
        term = C(n, i, mod, fif) * pow_mod(i, n, mod) % mod
        term = term * s % mod
        term = term * C(n - i, int(K), mod, fif) % mod
        ans = (ans + term) % mod
        s = mod - s  # alternate sign
    
    ans = ans * 2 % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

import sys
import math

MOD = 998244353

def mod_pow(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1
    base %= mod
    while exp > 0:
        if (exp & 1) == 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def mod_inverse(a, mod):
    return mod_pow(a, mod - 2, mod)

def enum_fif(n, mod):
    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv_fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fact[i] = (fact[i-1] * i) % mod
    inv_fact[n] = mod_inverse(fact[n], mod)
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        inv_fact[i-1] = (inv_fact[i] * i) % mod
    return [fact, inv_fact]

def comb(n, r, mod, fif):
    if n < 0 or r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return (fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % mod) * fif[1][n - r] % mod

def solve():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    
    if K >= n:
        print(0)
        return
    
    fif = enum_fif(250000, MOD)
    
    if K == 0:
        print(fif[0][n])
        return
    
    ans = 0
    sign = 1
    i = n - K
    while i >= 1:
        term = comb(n, i, MOD, fif)
        term = (term * pow(i, n, MOD)) % MOD
        term = (term * sign) % MOD
        term = (term * comb(n - i, K, MOD, fif)) % MOD
        ans = (ans + term) % MOD
        sign = MOD - sign
        i -= 1
    
    ans = (ans * 2) % MOD
    print(ans)

def main():
    solve()

    main()

problem_description.description: Calculate the number of ways to place $$$n$$$ rooks on $$$n \times n$$$ chessboard so that both following conditions are met:  each empty cell is under attack;  exactly $$$k$$$ pairs of rooks attack each other. An empty cell is under attack if there is at least one rook in the same row or at least one rook in the same column. Two rooks attack each other if they share the same row or column, and there are no other rooks between them. For example, there are only two pairs of rooks that attack each other in the following picture:  One of the ways to place the rooks for $$$n = 3$$$ and $$$k = 2$$$ Two ways to place the rooks are considered different if there exists at least one cell which is empty in one of the ways but contains a rook in another way.The answer might be large, so print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The only line of the input contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 200000$$$; $$$0 \le k \le \frac{n(n - 1)}{2}$$$).
problem_description.output_spec: Print one integer — the number of ways to place the rooks, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.

import sys

mod = 998244353

def power(x, y):
    res = 1
    x = x % mod
    while y > 0:
        if y % 2 == 1:
            res = (res * x) % mod
        y = y >> 1
        x = (x * x) % mod
    return res

def choose(n, k):
    num = 1
    denom = 1
    for i in range(int(n - k + 1), int(n) + 1):
        num = (num * i) % mod
    for i in range(1, int(k) + 1):
        denom = (denom * i) % mod
    denom = power(denom, mod - 2) % mod
    return (num * denom) % mod

        denomChoose = 1

            denomChoose = (denomChoose * i) % mod
            rChoose[i] = (numChoose * power(denomChoose, mod - 2)) % mod

            ans = ans * 2

            ans += mod

problem_description.description: Little Petya loves training spiders. Petya has a board n × m in size. Each cell of the board initially has a spider sitting on it. After one second Petya chooses a certain action for each spider, and all of them humbly perform its commands. There are 5 possible commands: to stay idle or to move from current cell to some of the four side-neighboring cells (that is, one command for each of the four possible directions). Petya gives the commands so that no spider leaves the field. It is allowed for spiders to pass through each other when they crawl towards each other in opposite directions. All spiders crawl simultaneously and several spiders may end up in one cell. Petya wants to know the maximum possible number of spider-free cells after one second.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two space-separated integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 40, n·m ≤ 40) — the board sizes.
problem_description.output_spec: In the first line print the maximum number of cells without spiders.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first sample the only possible answer is:sIn the second sample one of the possible solutions is: rdlruls denotes command "stay idle", l, r, d, u denote commands "crawl left", "crawl right", "crawl down", "crawl up", correspondingly.

All spiders crawl simultaneously and several spiders may end up in one cell. Petya wants to know the maximum possible number of spider-free cells after one second.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two space-separated integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 40, n·m ≤ 40) — the board sizes.
problem_description.output_spec: In the first line print the maximum number of cells without spiders.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first sample the only possible answer is:sIn the second sample one of the possible solutions is: rdlruls denotes command "stay idle", l, r, d, u denote commands "crawl left", "crawl right", "crawl down", "crawl up", correspondingly.

import sys

class TaskC:
    def __init__(self):
        self.n = 0
        self.m = 0
        self.dx = [-1, 0, 1, 0, 0]
        self.dy = [0, 1, 0, -1, 0]
        self.step = 0
        self.numFree = 0
        self.cur = 0
        self.res = float('inf')
        self.f = []

    def solve(self, n, m):
        if n > m:
            n, m = m, n
        
        self.n = n
        self.m = m
        self.f = [[0] * m for _ in range(n)]
        self.res = float('inf')
        self.cur = 0
        self.step = 1
        self.numFree = n * m
        self.rec(0, 0)
        return self.res

    def rec(self, x, y):
        if self.numFree == 0:
            self.res = min(self.res, self.cur)
            return
        if x >= self.n:
            return
        if y >= self.m:
            self.rec(x + 1, 0)
            return
        if self.f[x][y] != 0:
            self.rec(x, y + 1)
            return

        self.put(x, y)
        self.rec(x, y + 1)
        self.remove(x, y)

        if self.isValid(x + 1, y):
            self.put(x + 1, y)
            self.rec(x, y + 1)
            self.remove(x + 1, y)

        if self.isValid(x, y + 1):
            self.put(x, y + 1)
            self.rec(x, y + 1)
            self.remove(x, y + 1)

    def put(self, x, y):
        for i in range(5):
            nx = x + self.dx[i]
            ny = y + self.dy[i]
            if self.isValid(nx, ny):
                if self.f[nx][ny] == 0:
                    self.numFree -= 1
                    self.f[nx][ny] = self.step
        self.step += 1
        self.cur += 1

    def remove(self, x, y):
        self.step -= 1
        for i in range(5):
            nx = x + self.dx[i]
            ny = y + self.dy[i]
            if self.isValid(nx, ny):
                if self.f[nx][ny] == self.step:
                    self.numFree += 1
                    self.f[nx][ny] = 0
        self.cur -= 1

    def isValid(self, x, y):
        return x >= 0 and y >= 0 and x < self.n and y < self.m


def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    n = int(input_data[0])
    m = int(input_data[1])
    
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    
    solver = TaskC()
    result = solver.solve(n, m)
    print(n * m - result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys

class TaskC:
    def __init__(self):
        self.n = 0
        self.m = 0
        self.dx = [-1, 0, 1, 0, 0]
        self.dy = [0, 1, 0, -1, 0]
        self.step = 0
        self.numFree = 0
        self.cur = 0
        self.res = float('inf')
        self.f = []

    def process(self, rows, cols):
        self.n = rows
        self.m = cols
        self.f = [[0] * self.m for _ in range(self.n)]
        self.res = float('inf')
        self.cur = 0
        self.step = 1
        self.numFree = self.n * self.m
        self.rec(0, 0)
        return self.res

    def rec(self, x, y):
        if self.numFree == 0:
            self.res = min(self.res, self.cur)
            return
        if x >= self.n:
            return
        if y >= self.m:
            self.rec(x + 1, 0)
            return
        if self.f[x][y] != 0:
            self.rec(x, y + 1)
            return

        self.put(x, y)
        self.rec(x, y + 1)
        self.remove(x, y)

        if self.isValid(x + 1, y):
            self.put(x + 1, y)
            self.rec(x, y + 1)
            self.remove(x + 1, y)

        if self.isValid(x, y + 1):
            self.put(x, y + 1)
            self.rec(x, y + 1)
            self.remove(x, y + 1)

    def put(self, x, y):
        for i in range(5):
            nx = x + self.dx[i]
            ny = y + self.dy[i]
            if self.isValid(nx, ny):
                if self.f[nx][ny] == 0:
                    self.numFree -= 1
                    self.f[nx][ny] = self.step
        self.step += 1
        self.cur += 1

    def remove(self, x, y):
        self.step -= 1
        for i in range(5):
            nx = x + self.dx[i]
            ny = y + self.dy[i]
            if self.isValid(nx, ny):
                if self.f[nx][ny] == self.step:
                    self.numFree += 1
                    self.f[nx][ny] = 0
        self.cur -= 1

    def isValid(self, x, y):
        return x >= 0 and y >= 0 and x < self.n and y < self.m


def main():
    try:
        input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        input_parts = input_line.split()
        n = int(input_parts[0])
        m = int(input_parts[1])
        
        if n > m:
            n, m = m, n
        
        solver = TaskC()
        answer = solver.process(n, m)
        print(n * m - answer)
    except Exception as e:
        print("Error: " + str(e), file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.description: Little Petya loves training spiders. Petya has a board n × m in size. Each cell of the board initially has a spider sitting on it. After one second Petya chooses a certain action for each spider, and all of them humbly perform its commands. There are 5 possible commands: to stay idle or to move from current cell to some of the four side-neighboring cells (that is, one command for each of the four possible directions). Petya gives the commands so that no spider leaves the field. It is allowed for spiders to pass through each other when they crawl towards each other in opposite directions. All spiders crawl simultaneously and several spiders may end up in one cell. Petya wants to know the maximum possible number of spider-free cells after one second.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two space-separated integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 40, n·m ≤ 40) — the board sizes.
problem_description.output_spec: In the first line print the maximum number of cells without spiders.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first sample the only possible answer is:sIn the second sample one of the possible solutions is: rdlruls denotes command "stay idle", l, r, d, u denote commands "crawl left", "crawl right", "crawl down", "crawl up", correspondingly.

problem_description.description: This is the easy version of the problem. The only difference between the easy version and the hard version is the constraints on $$$n$$$. You can only make hacks if both versions are solved.A permutation of $$$1, 2, \ldots, n$$$ is a sequence of $$$n$$$ integers, where each integer from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ appears exactly once. For example, $$$[2,3,1,4]$$$ is a permutation of $$$1, 2, 3, 4$$$, but $$$[1,4,2,2]$$$ isn't because $$$2$$$ appears twice in it.Recall that the number of inversions in a permutation $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ is the number of pairs of indices $$$(i, j)$$$ such that $$$i < j$$$ and $$$a_i > a_j$$$.Let $$$p$$$ and $$$q$$$ be two permutations of $$$1, 2, \ldots, n$$$. Find the number of permutation pairs $$$(p,q)$$$ that satisfy the following conditions:  $$$p$$$ is lexicographically smaller than $$$q$$$.  the number of inversions in $$$p$$$ is greater than the number of inversions in $$$q$$$. Print the number of such pairs modulo $$$mod$$$. Note that $$$mod$$$ may not be a prime.
problem_description.input_spec: The only line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$mod$$$ ($$$1\le n\le 50$$$, $$$1\le mod\le 10^9$$$).
problem_description.output_spec: Print one integer, which is the answer modulo $$$mod$$$.

problem_description.description: Firecrackers scare Nian the monster, but they're wayyyyy too noisy! Maybe fireworks make a nice complement.Little Tommy is watching a firework show. As circular shapes spread across the sky, a splendid view unfolds on the night of Lunar New Year's eve.A wonder strikes Tommy. How many regions are formed by the circles on the sky? We consider the sky as a flat plane. A region is a connected part of the plane with positive area, whose bound consists of parts of bounds of the circles and is a curve or several curves without self-intersections, and that does not contain any curve other than its boundaries. Note that exactly one of the regions extends infinitely.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input contains one integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 3), denoting the number of circles. The following n lines each contains three space-separated integers x, y and r ( - 10 ≤ x, y ≤ 10, 1 ≤ r ≤ 10), describing a circle whose center is (x, y) and the radius is r. No two circles have the same x, y and r at the same time.
problem_description.output_spec: Print a single integer — the number of regions on the plane.

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }

    private void run() {
        try (InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
             OutputWriter out = new OutputWriter(System.out)) {
            int n = in.readInt();
            int[] x = new int[n];
            int[] y = new int[n];
            int[] r = new int[n];
            in.readIntArrays(x, y, r);
            
            Circle[] circles = new Circle[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                circles[i] = new Circle(new Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
            }
            
            List<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    Point[] intersect = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
                    if (intersect != null) {
                        points.addAll(Arrays.asList(intersect));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            boolean[] bad = new boolean[points.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    if (points.get(i).equals(points.get(j))) {
                        bad[i] = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int nVertices = 0;
            for (boolean b : bad) {
                if (!b) nVertices++;
            }
            
            int nEdges = 0;
            UnionFind setSystem = new UnionFind(points.size());
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Integer> onThis = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < points.size(); j++) {
                    if (!bad[j] && Math.abs(circles[i].center.distance(points.get(j)) - r[i]) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) {
                        onThis.add(j);
                    }
                }
                for (int j = 1; j < onThis.size(); j++) {
                    setSystem.union(onThis.get(j), onThis.get(0));
                }
                nEdges += Math.max(1, onThis.size());
            }
            
            int nComponents = setSystem.components;
            for (int i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
                if (bad[i]) nComponents--;
            }
            nComponents = Math.max(1, nComponents);
            
            out.printLine(1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents);
        }
    }

    static class Circle {
        final Point center;
        final double radius;

        Circle(Point center, double radius) {
            this.center = center;
            this.radius = radius;
        }

        Point[] intersect(Circle other) {
            double dist = center.distance(other.center);
            if (dist < GeometryUtils.epsilon) return null;
            
            double dx = other.center.x - center.x;
            double dy = other.center.y - center.y;
            double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius +
                      center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
                      center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
            
            Line line = new Line(2 * dx, 2 * dy, c);
            return line.intersect(this);
        }
    }

    static class Line {
        final double a, b, c;

        Line(double a, double b, double c) {
            double h = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(a, b);
            this.a = a / h;
            this.b = b / h;
            this.c = c / h;
        }

        Point intersect(Line other) {
            if (Math.abs(a * other.b - b * other.a) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) return null;
            
            double det = b * other.a - a * other.b;
            double x = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / det;
            double y = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / det;
            return new Point(x, y);
        }

        Point[] intersect(Circle circle) {
            double dist = Math.abs(a * circle.center.x + b * circle.center.y + c);
            if (dist > circle.radius + GeometryUtils.epsilon) return new Point[0];
            
            double perpX = -b;
            double perpY = a;
            double denom = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(perpX, perpY);
            perpX /= denom;
            perpY /= denom;
            
            double projX = circle.center.x - a * dist * Math.signum(a * circle.center.x + b * circle.center.y + c);
            double projY = circle.center.y - b * dist * Math.signum(a * circle.center.x + b * circle.center.y + c);
            Point proj = new Point(projX, projY);
            
            if (Math.abs(dist - circle.radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) {
                return new Point[]{proj};
            }
            
            double shift = Math.sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist);
            Point p1 = new Point(proj.x + shift * perpX, proj.y + shift * perpY);
            Point p2 = new Point(proj.x - shift * perpX, proj.y - shift * perpY);
            return new Point[]{p1, p2};
        }
    }

    static class Point {
        final double x, y;

        Point(double x, double y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        double distance(Point other) {
            double dx = x - other.x;
            double dy = y - other.y;
            return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Point point = (Point) o;
            return Math.abs(x - point.x) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon &&
                   Math.abs(y - point.y) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            long xBits = Double.doubleToLongBits(x);
            long yBits = Double.doubleToLongBits(y);
            return 31 * (int)(xBits ^ (xBits >>> 32)) + (int)(yBits ^ (yBits >>> 32));
        }
    }

    static class GeometryUtils {
        static final double epsilon = 1e-8;
        static double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
            return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        }
    }

    static class UnionFind {
        int[] parent;
        int[] rank;
        int components;

        UnionFind(int n) {
            parent = new int[n];
            rank = new int[n];
            components = n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;
        }

        int find(int x) {
            if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
            return parent[x];
        }

        void union(int x, int y) {
            int rx = find(x), ry = find(y);
            if (rx == ry) return;
            if (rank[rx] < rank[ry]) {
                parent[rx] = ry;
            } else if (rank[rx] > rank[ry]) {
                parent[ry] = rx;
            } else {
                parent[ry] = rx;
                rank[rx]++;
            }
            components--;
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private final InputStream stream;
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int curChar, numChars;

        InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        int read() {
            if (numChars == -1) throw new RuntimeException();
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try { numChars = stream.read(buf); } catch (IOException e) { throw new RuntimeException(); }
                if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        int readInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isSpace(c)) c = read();
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = read(); }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw new RuntimeException();
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpace(c));
            return res * sign;
        }

        boolean isSpace(int c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1; }

        void readIntArrays(int[]... arrays) {
            for (int i = 0; i < arrays[0].length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < arrays.length; j++) {
                    arrays[j][i] = readInt();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class OutputWriter {
        private final PrintWriter writer;

        OutputWriter(OutputStream os) {
            writer = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(os)));
        }

        void printLine(int i) { writer.println(i); }

        void close() { writer.close(); }
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().execute();
    }

    private void execute() {
        try (InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
             OutputWriter out = new OutputWriter(System.out)) {
            int n = in.readInt();
            int[][] coords = new int[3][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                coords[0][i] = in.readInt();
                coords[1][i] = in.readInt();
                coords[2][i] = in.readInt();
            }
            
            Circle[] circles = new Circle[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                circles[i] = new Circle(new Point(coords[0][i], coords[1][i]), coords[2][i]);
            }
            
            List<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    Point[] intersect = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
                    if (intersect != null) {
                        Collections.addAll(points, intersect);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            boolean[] bad = new boolean[points.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    if (points.get(i).equals(points.get(j))) {
                        bad[i] = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int nVertices = (int) Arrays.stream(bad).filter(b -> !b).count();
            
            UnionFind setSystem = new UnionFind(points.size());
            int nEdges = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Integer> onThis = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < points.size(); j++) {
                    if (!bad[j] && Math.abs(circles[i].center.distance(points.get(j)) - circles[i].radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) {
                        onThis.add(j);
                    }
                }
                for (int j = 1; j < onThis.size(); j++) {
                    setSystem.union(onThis.get(j), onThis.get(0));
                }
                nEdges += Math.max(1, onThis.size());
            }
            
            int nComponents = setSystem.components;
            for (boolean b : bad) if (b) nComponents--;
            nComponents = Math.max(1, nComponents);
            
            out.printLine(1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents);
        }
    }

    static class Circle {
        final Point center;
        final double radius;

        Circle(Point center, double radius) {
            this.center = center;
            this.radius = radius;
        }

        Point[] intersect(Circle other) {
            double dist = center.distance(other.center);
            if (dist < GeometryUtils.epsilon) return null;
            
            double dx = other.center.x - center.x;
            double dy = other.center.y - center.y;
            double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius +
                      center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
                      center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
            
            Line line = new Line(2 * dx, 2 * dy, c);
            return line.intersect(this);
        }
    }

    static class Line {
        final double a, b, c;

        Line(double a, double b, double c) {
            double h = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(a, b);
            this.a = a / h;
            this.b = b / h;
            this.c = c / h;
        }

        Point intersect(Line other) {
            if (Math.abs(a * other.b - b * other.a) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) return null;
            
            double det = b * other.a - a * other.b;
            double x = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / det;
            double y = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / det;
            return new Point(x, y);
        }

        Point[] intersect(Circle circle) {
            double dist = Math.abs(a * circle.center.x + b * circle.center.y + c);
            if (dist > circle.radius + GeometryUtils.epsilon) return new Point[0];
            
            double perpX = -b;
            double perpY = a;
            double denom = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(perpX, perpY);
            perpX /= denom;
            perpY /= denom;
            
            double sign = Math.signum(a * circle.center.x + b * circle.center.y + c);
            double projX = circle.center.x - a * dist * sign;
            double projY = circle.center.y - b * dist * sign;
            Point proj = new Point(projX, projY);

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().process();
    }

    private void process() {
        try (InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
             OutputWriter out = new OutputWriter(System.out)) {
            int n = in.readInt();
            int[] x = new int[n];
            int[] y = new int[n];
            int[] r = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                x[i] = in.readInt();
                y[i] = in.readInt();
                r[i] = in.readInt();
            }
            
            Circle[] circles = new Circle[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                circles[i] = new Circle(new Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
            }
            
            List<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    Point[] intersect = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
                    if (intersect != null) {
                        for (Point p : intersect) points.add(p);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            boolean[] bad = new boolean[points.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    if (points.get(i).equals(points.get(j))) {
                        bad[i] = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int nVertices = 0;
            for (boolean b : bad) if (!b) nVertices++;
            
            UnionFind setSystem = new UnionFind(points.size());
            int nEdges = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Integer> onThis = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < points.size(); j++) {
                    if (!bad[j] && Math.abs(circles[i].center.distance(points.get(j)) - circles[i].radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) {
                        onThis.add(j);
                    }
                }
                for (int j = 1; j < onThis.size(); j++) {
                    setSystem.union(onThis.get(j), onThis.get(0));
                }
                nEdges += Math.max(1, onThis.size());
            }
            
            int nComponents = setSystem.components;
            for (boolean b : bad) if (b) nComponents--;
            nComponents = Math.max(1, nComponents);
            
            out.printLine(1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents);
        }
    }

    static class Circle {
        final Point center;
        final double radius;

        Circle(Point center, double radius) {
            this.center = center;
            this.radius = radius;
        }

        Point[] intersect(Circle other) {
            double dist = center.distance(other.center);
            if (dist < GeometryUtils.epsilon) return null;
            
            double dx = other.center.x - center.x;
            double dy = other.center.y - center.y;
            double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius +
                      center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
                      center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
            
            Line line = new Line(2 * dx, 2 * dy, c);
            return line.intersect(this);
        }
    }

    static class Line {
        final double a, b, c;

        Line(double a, double b, double c) {
            double h = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(a, b);
            this.a = a / h;
            this.b = b / h;
            this.c = c / h;
        }

        Point intersect(Line other) {
            if (Math.abs(a * other.b - b * other.a) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) return null;
            
            double det = b * other.a - a * other.b;
            double x = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / det;
            double y = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / det;
            return new Point(x, y);
        }

        Point[] intersect(Circle circle) {
            double dist = Math.abs(a * circle.center.x + b * circle.center.y + c);
            if (dist > circle.radius + GeometryUtils.epsilon) return new Point[0];
            
            double perpX = -b;
            double perpY = a;
            double denom = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(perpX, perpY);
            perpX /= denom;
            perpY /= denom;
            
            double sign = Math.signum(a * circle.center.x + b * circle.center.y + c);
            double projX = circle.center.x - a * dist * sign;
            double projY = circle.center.y - b * dist * sign;
            Point proj = new Point(projX, projY);
            
            if (Math.abs(dist - circle.radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) {
                return new Point[]{proj};
            }
            
            double shift = Math.sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist);
            Point p1 = new Point(proj.x + shift * perpX, proj.y + shift * perpY);
            Point p2 = new Point(proj.x - shift * perpX, proj.y - shift * perpY);
            return new Point[]{p1, p2};
        }
    }

    static class Point {
        final double x, y;

        Point(double x, double y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        double distance(Point other) {
            double dx = x - other.x;
            double dy = y - other.y;
            return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Point point = (Point) o;
            return Math.abs(x - point.x) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon &&
                   Math.abs(y - point.y) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            long xBits = Double.doubleToLongBits(x);
            long yBits = Double.doubleToLongBits(y);
            return 31 * (int)(xBits ^ (xBits >>> 32)) + (int)(yBits ^ (yBits >>> 32));
        }
    }

    static class GeometryUtils {
        static final double epsilon = 1e-8;
        static double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
            return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        }
    }

    static class UnionFind {
        int[] parent;
        int[] rank;
        int components;

        UnionFind(int n) {
            parent = new int[n];
            rank = new int[n];
            components = n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;
        }

        int find(int x) {
            if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
            return parent[x];
        }

        void union(int x, int y) {
            int rx = find(x), ry = find(y);
            if (rx == ry) return;
            if (rank[rx] < rank[ry]) {
                parent[rx] = ry;
            } else if (rank[rx] > rank[ry]) {
                parent[ry] = rx;
            } else {
                parent[ry] = rx;
                rank[rx]++;
            }
            components--;
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private final InputStream stream;
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int curChar, numChars;

        InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        int read() {
            if (numChars == -1) throw new RuntimeException();
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try { numChars = stream.read(buf); } catch (IOException e) { throw new RuntimeException(); }
                if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        int readInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isSpace(c)) c = read();
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = read(); }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw new RuntimeException();
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpace(c));
            return res * sign;
        }

        boolean isSpace(int c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1; }
    }

    static class OutputWriter {
        private final PrintWriter writer;

        OutputWriter(OutputStream os) {
            writer = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(os)));
        }

        void printLine(int i) { writer.println(i); }

        void close() { writer.close(); }
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }

    private void run() {
        try (InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
             OutputWriter out = new OutputWriter(System.out)) {
            int n = in.readInt();
            int[] x = new int[n];
            int[] y = new int[n];
            int[] r = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                x[i] = in.readInt();
                y[i] = in.readInt();
                r[i] = in.readInt();
            }
            
            Circle[] circles = new Circle[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                circles[i] = new Circle(new Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
            }
            
            List<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    Point[] intersect = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
                    if (intersect != null) {
                        for (Point p : intersect) points.add(p);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            boolean[] bad = new boolean[points.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    if (points.get(i).equals(points.get(j))) {
                        bad[i] = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int nVertices = 0;
            for (boolean b : bad) if (!b) nVertices++;
            
            UnionFind setSystem = new UnionFind(points.size());
            int nEdges = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Integer> onThis = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < points.size(); j++) {
                    if (!bad[j] && Math.abs(circles[i].center.distance(points.get(j)) - circles[i].radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) {
                        onThis.add(j);
                    }
                }
                for (int j = 1; j < onThis.size(); j++) {
                    setSystem.union(onThis.get(j), onThis.get(0));
                }
                nEdges += Math.max(1, onThis.size());
            }
            
            int nComponents = setSystem.components;
            for (boolean b : bad) if (b) nComponents--;
            nComponents = Math.max(1, nComponents);
            
            out.printLine(1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents);
        }
    }

    static class Circle {
        final Point center;
        final double radius;

        Circle(Point center, double radius) {
            this.center = center;
            this.radius = radius;
        }

        Point[] intersect(Circle other) {
            double dist = center.distance(other.center);
            if (dist < GeometryUtils.epsilon) return null;
            
            double dx = other.center.x - center.x;
            double dy = other.center.y - center.y;
            double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius +
                      center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
                      center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
            
            Line line = new Line(2 * dx, 2 * dy, c);
            return line.intersect(this);
        }
    }

    static class Line {
        final double a, b, c;

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }

    private void run() {
        try (InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
             OutputWriter out = new OutputWriter(System.out)) {
            int n = in.readInt();
            int[] x = new int[n];
            int[] y = new int[n];
            int[] r = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                x[i] = in.readInt();
                y[i] = in.readInt();
                r[i] = in.readInt();
            }
            
            Circle[] circles = new Circle[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                circles[i] = new Circle(new Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
            }
            
            List<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    Point[] intersect = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
                    if (intersect != null) {
                        for (Point p : intersect) points.add(p);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            boolean[] bad = new boolean[points.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    if (points.get(i).equals(points.get(j))) {
                        bad[i] = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int nVertices = 0;
            for (boolean b : bad) if (!b) nVertices++;
            
            UnionFind setSystem = new UnionFind(points.size());
            int nEdges = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Integer> onThis = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < points.size(); j++) {
                    if (!bad[j] && Math.abs(circles[i].center.distance(points.get(j)) - circles[i].radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) {
                        onThis.add(j);
                    }
                }
                for (int j = 1; j < onThis.size(); j++) {
                    setSystem.union(onThis.get(j), onThis.get(0));
                }
                nEdges += Math.max(1, onThis.size());
            }
            
            int nComponents = setSystem.components;
            for (boolean b : bad) if (b) nComponents--;
            nComponents = Math.max(1, nComponents);
            
            out.printLine(1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents);
        }
    }

    static class Circle {
        final Point center;
        final double radius;

        Circle(Point center, double radius) {
            this.center = center;
            this.radius = radius;
        }

        Point[] intersect(Circle other) {
            double dist = center.distance(other.center);
            if (dist < GeometryUtils.epsilon) return null;
            
            double dx = other.center.x - center.x;
            double dy = other.center.y - center.y;
            double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius +
                      center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
                      center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
            
            Line line = new Line(2 * dx, 2 * dy, c);
            return line.intersect(this);
        }
    }

    static class Line {
        final double a, b, c;

        Line(double a, double b, double c) {
            double h = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(a, b);
            this.a = a / h;
            this.b = b / h;
            this.c = c / h;
        }

        Point intersect(Line other) {
            if (Math.abs(a * other.b - b * other.a) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) return null;
            
            double det = b * other.a - a * other.b;
            double x = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / det;
            double y = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / det;
            return new Point(x, y);
        }

        Point[] intersect(Circle circle) {
            double dist = Math.abs(a * circle.center.x + b * circle.center.y + c);
            if (dist > circle.radius + GeometryUtils.epsilon) return new Point[0];
            
            double perpX = -b;
            double perpY = a;
            double denom = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(perpX, perpY);
            perpX /= denom;
            perpY /= denom;
            
            double sign = Math.signum(a * circle.center.x + b * circle.center.y + c);
            double projX = circle.center.x - a * dist * sign;
            double projY = circle.center.y - b * dist * sign;
            Point proj = new Point(projX, projY);
            
            if (Math.abs(dist - circle.radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon) {
                return new Point[]{proj};
            }
            
            double shift = Math.sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist);
            Point p1 = new Point(proj.x + shift * perpX, proj.y + shift * perpY);
            Point p2 = new Point(proj.x - shift * perpX, proj.y - shift * perpY);
            return new Point[]{p1, p2};
        }
    }

    static class Point {
        final double x, y;

        Point(double x, double y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        double distance(Point other) {
            double dx = x - other.x;
            double dy = y - other.y;
            return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Point point = (Point) o;
            return Math.abs(x - point.x) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon &&
                   Math.abs(y - point.y) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            long xBits = Double.doubleToLongBits(x);
            long yBits = Double.doubleToLongBits(y);
            return 31 * (int)(xBits ^ (xBits >>> 32)) + (int)(yBits ^ (yBits >>> 32));
        }
    }

    static class GeometryUtils {
        static final double epsilon = 1e-8;
        static double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
            return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        }
    }

    static class UnionFind {
        int[] parent;
        int[] rank;
        int components;

        UnionFind(int n) {
            parent = new int[n];
            rank = new int[n];
            components = n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;
        }

        int find(int x) {
            if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
            return parent[x];
        }

        void union(int x, int y) {
            int rx = find(x), ry = find(y);
            if (rx == ry) return;
            if (rank[rx] < rank[ry]) {
                parent[rx] = ry;
            } else if (rank[rx] > rank[ry]) {
                parent[ry] = rx;
            } else {
                parent[ry] = rx;
                rank[rx]++;
            }
            components--;
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private final InputStream stream;
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int curChar, numChars;

        InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        int read() {
            if (numChars == -1) throw new RuntimeException();
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try { numChars = stream.read(buf); } catch (IOException e) { throw new RuntimeException(); }
                if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        int readInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isSpace(c)) c = read();
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = read(); }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw new RuntimeException();
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpace(c));
            return res * sign;
        }

        boolean isSpace(int c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1; }
    }

    static class OutputWriter {
        private final PrintWriter writer;

        OutputWriter(OutputStream os) {
            writer = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(os)));
        }

        void printLine(int i) { writer.println(i); }

        void close() { writer.close(); }
    }
}

                int rootJ = find(parent, j);
                parent[rootI] = rootJ;

            double dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);

problem_description.description: Firecrackers scare Nian the monster, but they're wayyyyy too noisy! Maybe fireworks make a nice complement.Little Tommy is watching a firework show. As circular shapes spread across the sky, a splendid view unfolds on the night of Lunar New Year's eve.A wonder strikes Tommy. How many regions are formed by the circles on the sky? We consider the sky as a flat plane. A region is a connected part of the plane with positive area, whose bound consists of parts of bounds of the circles and is a curve or several curves without self-intersections, and that does not contain any curve other than its boundaries. Note that exactly one of the regions extends infinitely.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input contains one integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 3), denoting the number of circles. The following n lines each contains three space-separated integers x, y and r ( - 10 ≤ x, y ≤ 10, 1 ≤ r ≤ 10), describing a circle whose center is (x, y) and the radius is r. No two circles have the same x, y and r at the same time.
problem_description.output_spec: Print a single integer — the number of regions on the plane.

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class C4_Variant1 {
    private InputStream is;
    private PrintWriter out;
    private String INPUT = "";

    void solve() {
        int n = ni();
        long[][] circles = new long[n][3];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            circles[i][0] = ni();
            circles[i][1] = ni();
            circles[i][2] = ni();
        }

        List<double[]> points = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                double[] angles = computeIntersectionAngles(
                    circles[i][0], circles[i][1], circles[i][2],
                    circles[j][0], circles[j][1], circles[j][2]
                );
                for (double angle : angles) {
                    double x = circles[i][0] + circles[i][2] * Math.cos(angle);
                    double y = circles[i][1] + circles[i][2] * Math.sin(angle);
                    points.add(new double[]{x, y});
                }
            }
        }

        List<double[]> uniquePoints = new ArrayList<>();
        outer:
        for (int i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
            double[] p1 = points.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < uniquePoints.size(); j++) {
                double[] p2 = uniquePoints.get(j);
                if (distanceSquared(p1[0], p1[1], p2[0], p2[1]) < 1e-12) {
                    continue outer;
                }
            }
            uniquePoints.add(p1);
        }

        int numPoints = uniquePoints.size();
        int numEdges = 0;
        int components = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int count = 0;
            for (double[] pt : uniquePoints) {
                double distSq = distanceSquared(pt[0], pt[1], circles[i][0], circles[i][1]);
                if (Math.abs(distSq - circles[i][2] * circles[i][2]) < 1e-12) {
                    count++;
                }
            }
            if (count == 0) components++;
            numEdges += count;
        }

        if (components > n) components = n;
        out.println(numEdges - numPoints + components + 1);
    }

    public static double distanceSquared(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2) {
        double dx = x2 - x1;
        double dy = y2 - y1;
        return dx * dx + dy * dy;
    }

    private static final double EPS = 1e-10;

    public static double[] computeIntersectionAngles(long x1, long y1, long r1,
                                                     long x2, long y2, long r2) {
        long d2 = distanceSquared(x1, y1, x2, y2);
        long diff = r1 - r2;
        long sum = r1 + r2;

        if (d2 < diff * diff || d2 > sum * sum) {
            return new double[0];
        }

        double baseAngle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
        double dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
        double angleOffset = Math.acos((d2 + r1 * r1 - r2 * r2) / (2 * dist * r1));

        double lower = baseAngle - angleOffset;
        double upper = baseAngle + angleOffset;

        return new double[]{lower, upper};
    }

    void run() throws Exception {
        is = oj ? System.in : new ByteArrayInputStream(INPUT.getBytes());
        out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
        solve();
        out.flush();
        if (!oj) System.out.println(System.currentTimeMillis() - start + "ms");
    }

        new C4_Variant1().run();
    }

        if (bufferLen == -1) throw new InputMismatchException();
        if (bufferPtr >= bufferLen) {
            bufferPtr = 0;

                bufferLen = is.read(buffer);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new InputMismatchException();
            }
            if (bufferLen <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[bufferPtr++];
    }

    private int skip() { int b; while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && isSpaceChar(b)); return b; }

    private double nd() { return Double.parseDouble(ns()); }
    private char nc() { return (char) skip(); }

    private String ns() {
        int b = skip();
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        while (!isSpaceChar(b)) {
            sb.appendCodePoint(b);
            b = readByte();
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private char[] ns(int n) {
        char[] buf = new char[n];
        int b = skip(), p = 0;
        while (p < n && !isSpaceChar(b)) {
            buf[p++] = (char) b;
            b = readByte();
        }
        return p == n ? buf : Arrays.copyOf(buf, p);
    }

    private char[][] nm(int n, int m) {
        char[][] map = new char[n][];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) map[i] = ns(m);
        return map;
    }

    private int[] na(int n) {
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = ni();
        return a;
    }

    private int ni() {
        int num = 0, b;

            if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
                num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
            } else {
                return minus ? -num : num;
            }
            b = readByte();
        }
    }

    private long nl() {
        long num = 0;
        int b;
        boolean minus = false;
        while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && !((b >= '0' && b <= '9') || b == '-'));
        if (b == '-') {
            minus = true;
            b = readByte();
        }

                num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
            } else {
                return minus ? -num : num;
            }
            b = readByte();
        }
    }

    private boolean oj = System.getProperty("ONLINE_JUDGE") != null;
