def main():
    MOD = 998244353
    
    class FFT:
        maxk = 21
        maxn = (1 << maxk) + 1
        
        wR = [0.0] * maxn
        wI = [0.0] * maxn
        rR = [0.0] * maxn
        rI = [0.0] * maxn
        aR = [0.0] * maxn
        aI = [0.0] * maxn
        
        n = 0
        k = 0
        lastk = -1
        dp = [0] * maxn

        @staticmethod
        def fft(inv):
            if FFT.lastk != FFT.k:
                FFT.lastk = FFT.k
                FFT.dp[0] = 0
                for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                    if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                        g = -1
                    g = (i.bit_length() - 1) if (i & (i - 1)) == 0 else g
                    FFT.dp[i] = FFT.dp[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - g))
                
                FFT.wR[1] = 1.0
                FFT.wI[1] = 0.0
                for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                    a = 3.141592653589793 / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                    curR = math.cos(a)
                    curI = math.sin(a)
                    p2 = 1 << t
                    p3 = p2 * 2
                    j = p2
                    k = j * 2
                    while j < p3:
                        FFT.wR[k] = FFT.wR[j]
                        FFT.wI[k] = FFT.wI[j]
                        FFT.wR[k + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * curR - FFT.wI[j] * curI
                        FFT.wI[k + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * curI + FFT.wI[j] * curR
                        j += 1
                        k += 2
            
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                d = FFT.dp[i]
                if i < d:
                    tmp = FFT.aR[i]
                    FFT.aR[i] = FFT.aR[d]
                    FFT.aR[d] = tmp
                    tmp = FFT.aI[i]
                    FFT.aI[i] = FFT.aI[d]
                    FFT.aI[d] = tmp
            
            if inv:
                for i in range(FFT.n):
                    FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
            
            len_val = 1
            while len_val < FFT.n:
                for i in range(0, FFT.n, len_val):
                    wit = len_val
                    j = i + len_val
                    it = 0
                    while it < len_val:
                        tmpR = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wR[wit] - FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wI[wit]
                        tmpI = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wI[wit] + FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wR[wit]
                        wit += 1
                        FFT.aR[j] = FFT.aR[i] - tmpR
                        FFT.aI[j] = FFT.aI[i] - tmpI
                        FFT.aR[i] += tmpR
                        FFT.aI[i] += tmpI
                        j += 1
                        it += 1
                len_val <<= 1

        @staticmethod
        def multiply(a, b):
            na = len(a)
            nb = len(b)
            FFT.k = 0
            FFT.n = 1
            while FFT.n < na + nb - 1:
                FFT.n <<= 1
                FFT.k += 1
            
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aR[i] = a[i] if i < na else 0
                FFT.aI[i] = b[i] if i < nb else 0
            
            FFT.fft(False)
            FFT.aR[FFT.n] = FFT.aR[0]
            FFT.aI[FFT.n] = FFT.aI[0]
            q = -1.0 / FFT.n / 4.0
            
            for i in range(FFT.n - i + 1):
                tmpR = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
                tmpI = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i] * 2
                tmpR -= FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] - FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
                tmpI -= FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * -2
                FFT.aR[i] = -tmpI * q
                FFT.aI[i] = tmpR * q
                FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] = FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] = -FFT.aI[i]
            
            FFT.fft(True)
            ans = [0] * (na + nb - 1)
            for i in range(na + nb - 1):
                ans[i] = round(FFT.aR[i]) % MOD
            return ans

        @staticmethod
        def multiplyPrecise(a, b):
            k_val = int(math.sqrt(MOD))
            a1 = [0] * len(a)
            a2 = [0] * len(a)
            b1 = [0] * len(b)
            b2 = [0] * len(b)
            
            for i in range(len(a)):
                a1[i] = a[i] % k_val
                a2[i] = a[i] // k_val
            
            for i in range(len(b)):
                b1[i] = b[i] % k_val
                b2[i] = b[i] // k_val
            
            r11 = FFT.multiply(a1, b1)
            r12 = FFT.multiply(a1, b2)
            r21 = FFT.multiply(a2, b1)
            r22 = FFT.multiply(a2, b2)
            
            res = [0] * len(r11)
            for i in range(len(res)):
                res[i] = (k_val * k_val * r22[i] + k_val * (r12[i] + r21[i]) + r11[i]) % MOD
            return res

    import math
    
    in_stream = sys.stdin
    n = int(in_stream.readline().strip())
    k = int(in_stream.readline().strip())
    base = [0] * 10
    for i in range(k):
        idx = int(in_stream.readline().strip())
        base[idx] = 1

        if pow_val == 1:

import math
import sys

MOD = 998244353

class FFT:
    MAX_K = 21
    MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K
    wR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    wI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    rR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    rI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    n = 0
    k = 0
    lastK = -1
    bitReverse = [0] * MAX_N

    @staticmethod
    def performFFT(inverse):
        if FFT.lastK != FFT.k:
            FFT.lastK = FFT.k
            FFT.bitReverse[0] = 0
            group = -1
            for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                    group += 1
                FFT.bitReverse[i] = FFT.bitReverse[i ^ (1 << group)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - group))
            
            FFT.wR[1] = 1.0
            FFT.wI[1] = 0.0
            for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                angle = math.pi / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                cosVal = math.cos(angle)
                sinVal = math.sin(angle)
                p2 = 1 << t
                p3 = p2 << 1
                j = p2
                idx = j * 2
                while j < p3:
                    FFT.wR[idx] = FFT.wR[j]
                    FFT.wI[idx] = FFT.wI[j]
                    FFT.wR[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * cosVal - FFT.wI[j] * sinVal
                    FFT.wI[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * sinVal + FFT.wI[j] * cosVal
                    j += 1
                    idx += 2
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            rev = FFT.bitReverse[i]
            if i < rev:
                temp = FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aR[i] = FFT.aR[rev]
                FFT.aR[rev] = temp
                temp = FFT.aI[i]
                FFT.aI[i] = FFT.aI[rev]
                FFT.aI[rev] = temp
        
        if inverse:
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        len_val = 1
        while len_val < FFT.n:
            for i in range(0, FFT.n, len_val):
                wIndex = len_val
                j = i + len_val
                it = 0
                while it < len_val:
                    realPart = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wR[wIndex] - FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wI[wIndex]
                    imagPart = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wI[wIndex] + FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wR[wIndex]
                    wIndex += 1
                    FFT.aR[j] = FFT.aR[i] - realPart
                    FFT.aI[j] = FFT.aI[i] - imagPart
                    FFT.aR[i] += realPart
                    FFT.aI[i] += imagPart
                    it += 1
                    i += 1
                    j += 1
            len_val <<= 1

    @staticmethod
    def multiply(first, second):
        len1 = len(first)
        len2 = len(second)
        FFT.k = 0
        FFT.n = 1
        while FFT.n < len1 + len2 - 1:
            FFT.n <<= 1
            FFT.k += 1
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            FFT.aR[i] = first[i] if i < len1 else 0.0
            FFT.aI[i] = second[i] if i < len2 else 0.0
        
        FFT.performFFT(False)
        FFT.aR.append(FFT.aR[0])
        FFT.aI.append(FFT.aI[0])
        factor = -1.0 / FFT.n / 4.0
        
        for i in range(FFT.n - i + 1):
            real1 = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            imag1 = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i] * 2
            real2 = FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] - FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            imag2 = FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * -2
            newReal = -imag1 + imag2
            newImag = real1 - real2
            FFT.aR[i] = newReal * factor
            FFT.aI[i] = newImag * factor
            FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] = FFT.aR[i]
            FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        FFT.performFFT(True)
        result = [0] * (len1 + len2 - 1)
        for i in range(len(result)):
            result[i] = round(FFT.aR[i]) % MOD
        
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def multiplyPrecise(first, second):
        sqrtMod = int(math.isqrt(MOD))
        aLow = [0] * len(first)
        aHigh = [0] * len(first)
        bLow = [0] * len(second)
        bHigh = [0] * len(second)
        
        for i in range(len(first)):
            aLow[i] = first[i] % sqrtMod
            aHigh[i] = first[i] // sqrtMod
        
        for i in range(len(second)):
            bLow[i] = second[i] % sqrtMod
            bHigh[i] = second[i] // sqrtMod
        
        r11 = FFT.multiply(aLow, bLow)
        r12 = FFT.multiply(aLow, bHigh)
        r21 = FFT.multiply(aHigh, bLow)
        r22 = FFT.multiply(aHigh, bHigh)
        
        result = [0] * len(r11)
        sqrtMod_sq = (sqrtMod * sqrtMod) % MOD
        
        for i in range(len(result)):
            result[i] = (sqrtMod_sq * r22[i] % MOD +
                        (sqrtMod * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD)) % MOD +
                        r11[i]) % MOD
        
        return result

def exponentiate(base, exp):
    if exp == 1:
        return base[:]
    if exp & 1:
        return FFT.multiplyPrecise(base, exponentiate(base, exp - 1))
    half = exponentiate(base, exp >> 1)
    return FFT.multiplyPrecise(half, half)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    base = [0] * 10
    idx = 2
    for i in range(k):
        base[int(data[idx])] = 1
        idx += 1
    
    res = exponentiate(base, n // 2)
    total = 0
    for val in res:
        total = (total + (val * val) % MOD) % MOD
    
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
import math

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    base = [0] * 10
    idx = 2
    for i in range(k):
        base[int(data[idx])] = 1
        idx += 1
    
    result = power(base, n // 2)
    
    total = 0
    for x in result:
        total = (total + x * x % MOD) % MOD
    
    print(total)

def power(base, exponent):
    if exponent == 1:
        return base[:]
    if exponent & 1:
        return FFT.multiplyPrecise(base, power(base, exponent - 1))
    half = power(base, exponent >> 1)
    return FFT.multiplyPrecise(half, half)

class FFT:
    MAX_K = 21
    MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.wR = [0.0] * self.MAX_N
        self.wI = [0.0] * self.MAX_N
        self.aR = [0.0] * self.MAX_N
        self.aI = [0.0] * self.MAX_N
        self.rev = [0] * self.MAX_N
        self.n = 0
        self.k = 0
        self.lastK = -1
    
    def transform(self, inverse):
        if self.lastK != self.k:
            self.lastK = self.k
            self.rev[0] = 0
            g = 0
            for i in range(1, self.n):

import sys
import math

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    base = [0] * 10
    idx = 2
    for i in range(k):
        base[int(data[idx])] = 1
        idx += 1
    
    res = fast_pow(base, n // 2)
    ans = 0
    for x in res:
        ans = (ans + x * x) % MOD
    print(ans)

def fast_pow(base, exp):
    if exp == 1:
        return base[:]
    if exp & 1:
        return multiply_precise(base, fast_pow(base, exp - 1))
    half = fast_pow(base, exp >> 1)
    return multiply_precise(half, half)

class FFT:
    MAX_K = 21
    MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K
    wR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    wI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    n = 0
    k = 0
    lastK = -1
    rev = [0] * MAX_N

    @staticmethod
    def transform(inv):
        if FFT.lastK != FFT.k:
            FFT.lastK = FFT.k
            FFT.rev[0] = 0
            for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                g = 0
                if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                    g = (i.bit_length() - 1)
                FFT.rev[i] = FFT.rev[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - g))
            
            FFT.wR[1] = 1.0
            FFT.wI[1] = 0.0
            for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                angle = math.pi / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                c = math.cos(angle)
                s = math.sin(angle)
                p2 = 1 << t
                p3 = p2 << 1
                for j in range(p2, p3):
                    idx = p3 + (j - p2) * 2
                    FFT.wR[idx] = FFT.wR[j]
                    FFT.wI[idx] = FFT.wI[j]
                    FFT.wR[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * c - FFT.wI[j] * s
                    FFT.wI[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * s + FFT.wI[j] * c

        for i in range(FFT.n):
            r = FFT.rev[i]
            if i < r:
                FFT.aR[i], FFT.aR[r] = FFT.aR[r], FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aI[i], FFT.aI[r] = FFT.aI[r], FFT.aI[i]
        
        if inv:
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        len_val = 1
        while len_val < FFT.n:
            for i in range(0, FFT.n, len_val):
                wIdx = len_val
                for j in range(i + len_val, i + 2 * len_val):
                    tr = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wR[wIdx] - FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wI[wIdx]

                    FFT.aR[j] = FFT.aR[i] - tr
                    FFT.aI[j] = FFT.aI[i] - ti
                    FFT.aR[i] += tr
                    FFT.aI[i] += ti
            len_val <<= 1

    @staticmethod
    def multiply(a, b):
        la = len(a)
        lb = len(b)
        FFT.k = 0
        FFT.n = 1
        while FFT.n < la + lb - 1:
            FFT.n <<= 1
            FFT.k += 1
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            FFT.aR[i] = a[i] if i < la else 0.0
            FFT.aI[i] = b[i] if i < lb else 0.0
        
        FFT.transform(False)
        FFT.aR[FFT.n] = FFT.aR[0]
        FFT.aI[FFT.n] = FFT.aI[0]
        scale = -1.0 / FFT.n / 4.0
        
        for i in range(FFT.n // 2 + 1):
            r1 = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            i1 = 2 * FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            r2 = FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] - FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            i2 = -2 * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            nr = -i1 + i2
            ni = r1 - r2
            FFT.aR[i] = nr * scale
            FFT.aI[i] = ni * scale
            FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] = FFT.aR[i]
            FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        FFT.transform(True)
        
        res = [0] * (la + lb - 1)
        for i in range(len(res)):
            res[i] = round(FFT.aR[i]) % MOD
        return res

    @staticmethod
    def multiply_precise(a, b):
        sqrt_mod = int(math.isqrt(MOD))
        al = [x % sqrt_mod for x in a]
        ah = [x // sqrt_mod for x in a]
        bl = [x % sqrt_mod for x in b]
        bh = [x // sqrt_mod for x in b]
        
        r11 = FFT.multiply(al, bl)
        r12 = FFT.multiply(al, bh)
        r21 = FFT.multiply(ah, bl)
        r22 = FFT.multiply(ah, bh)
        
        res = [0] * len(r11)
        sqrt_mod_sq = (sqrt_mod * sqrt_mod) % MOD
        for i in range(len(res)):
            t1 = sqrt_mod_sq * r22[i] % MOD
            t2 = sqrt_mod * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD) % MOD
            res[i] = (t1 + t2 + r11[i]) % MOD
        return res

import math
import sys

MOD = 998244353

class FFT:
    MAX_K = 21
    MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K
    wR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    wI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    n = 0
    k = 0
    lastK = -1
    bitReverse = [0] * MAX_N

    @staticmethod
    def performTransform(inverse):
        if FFT.lastK != FFT.k:
            FFT.lastK = FFT.k
            FFT.bitReverse[0] = 0
            group = 0
            for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                    group += 1
                FFT.bitReverse[i] = FFT.bitReverse[i ^ (1 << group)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - group))
            
            FFT.wR[1] = 1.0
            FFT.wI[1] = 0.0
            for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                angle = math.pi / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                cosVal = math.cos(angle)
                sinVal = math.sin(angle)
                p2 = 1 << t
                p3 = p2 << 1
                for j in range(p2, p3):
                    idx = p3 + (j - p2) * 2
                    FFT.wR[idx] = FFT.wR[j]
                    FFT.wI[idx] = FFT.wI[j]
                    FFT.wR[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * cosVal - FFT.wI[j] * sinVal
                    FFT.wI[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * sinVal + FFT.wI[j] * cosVal
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            rev = FFT.bitReverse[i]
            if i < rev:
                temp = FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aR[i] = FFT.aR[rev]
                FFT.aR[rev] = temp
                temp = FFT.aI[i]
                FFT.aI[i] = FFT.aI[rev]
                FFT.aI[rev] = temp
        
        if inverse:
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        len_val = 1
        while len_val < FFT.n:
            for i in range(0, FFT.n, len_val):
                wIndex = len_val
                for j in range(i + len_val, i + len_val * 2):
                    tr = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wR[wIndex] - FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wI[wIndex]
                    ti = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wI[wIndex] + FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wR[wIndex]
                    wIndex += 1
                    FFT.aR[j] = FFT.aR[i] - tr
                    FFT.aI[j] = FFT.aI[i] - ti
                    FFT.aR[i] += tr
                    FFT.aI[i] += ti
            len_val <<= 1

    @staticmethod
    def multiply(first, second):
        len1 = len(first)
        len2 = len(second)
        FFT.k = 0
        FFT.n = 1
        while FFT.n < len1 + len2 - 1:
            FFT.n <<= 1
            FFT.k += 1
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            FFT.aR[i] = first[i] if i < len1 else 0.0
            FFT.aI[i] = second[i] if i < len2 else 0.0
        
        FFT.performTransform(False)
        FFT.aR[FFT.n] = FFT.aR[0]
        FFT.aI[FFT.n] = FFT.aI[0]
        scaleFactor = -1.0 / FFT.n / 4.0
        
        for i in range(FFT.n - i + 1):
            r1 = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            i1 = 2 * FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            r2 = FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] - FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            i2 = -2 * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            nr = -i1 + i2
            ni = r1 - r2
            FFT.aR[i] = nr * scaleFactor
            FFT.aI[i] = ni * scaleFactor
            FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] = FFT.aR[i]
            FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        FFT.performTransform(True)
        result = [0] * (len1 + len2 - 1)
        for i in range(len(result)):
            result[i] = round(FFT.aR[i]) % MOD
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def multiplyPrecise(first, second):
        sqrtMod = int(math.isqrt(MOD))
        low1 = [x % sqrtMod for x in first]
        high1 = [x // sqrtMod for x in first]
        low2 = [x % sqrtMod for x in second]
        high2 = [x // sqrtMod for x in second]
        
        r11 = FFT.multiply(low1, low2)
        r12 = FFT.multiply(low1, high2)
        r21 = FFT.multiply(high1, low2)
        r22 = FFT.multiply(high1, high2)
        
        result = [0] * len(r11)
        for i in range(len(result)):
            term1 = (sqrtMod * sqrtMod % MOD) * r22[i] % MOD
            term2 = sqrtMod * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD) % MOD
            result[i] = (term1 + term2 + r11[i]) % MOD
        return result

def recursivePower(base, exponent):
    if exponent == 1:
        return base
    if exponent & 1:
        return FFT.multiplyPrecise(base, recursivePower(base, exponent - 1))
    half = recursivePower(base, exponent >> 1)
    return FFT.multiplyPrecise(half, half)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    base = [0] * 10
    idx = 2
    for i in range(k):
        base[int(data[idx])] = 1
        idx += 1
    
    res = recursivePower(base, n // 2)
    total = 0
    for val in res:
        total = (total + val * val) % MOD
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
import math

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    base = [0] * 10
    idx = 2
    for i in range(k):
        base[int(data[idx])] = 1
        idx += 1
    
    res = power_iterative(base, n // 2)
    total = 0
    for val in res:
        total = (total + val * val) % MOD
    print(total)

def power_iterative(base, exponent):
    if exponent == 1:
        return base[:]
    if exponent & 1:
        return FFT.multiply_precise(base, power_iterative(base, exponent - 1))
    half = power_iterative(base, exponent >> 1)
    return FFT.multiply_precise(half, half)

class FFT:
    MAX_K = 21
    MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K
    wR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    wI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    n = 0
    k = 0
    lastK = -1
    rev = [0] * MAX_N

    @staticmethod
    def do_fft(inverse):
        if FFT.lastK != FFT.k:
            FFT.lastK = FFT.k
            FFT.rev[0] = 0
            g = 0
            for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                    g += 1
                FFT.rev[i] = FFT.rev[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - g))
            
            FFT.wR[1] = 1.0
            FFT.wI[1] = 0.0
            for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                angle = math.pi / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                c = math.cos(angle)
                s = math.sin(angle)
                p2 = 1 << t
                p3 = p2 << 1
                for j in range(p2, p3):
                    idx = p3 + (j - p2) * 2
                    FFT.wR[idx] = FFT.wR[j]
                    FFT.wI[idx] = FFT.wI[j]
                    FFT.wR[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * c - FFT.wI[j] * s
                    FFT.wI[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * s + FFT.wI[j] * c
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            r = FFT.rev[i]
            if i < r:
                tmp = FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aR[i] = FFT.aR[r]
                FFT.aR[r] = tmp
                tmp = FFT.aI[i]
                FFT.aI[i] = FFT.aI[r]
                FFT.aI[r] = tmp
        
        if inverse:
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        len_val = 1
        while len_val < FFT.n:
            for i in range(0, FFT.n, len_val):
                w_idx = len_val
                for j in range(i + len_val, i + len_val * 2):
                    tr = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wR[w_idx] - FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wI[w_idx]
                    ti = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wI[w_idx] + FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wR[w_idx]
                    w_idx += 1
                    FFT.aR[j] = FFT.aR[i] - tr
                    FFT.aI[j] = FFT.aI[i] - ti
                    FFT.aR[i] += tr
                    FFT.aI[i] += ti
            len_val <<= 1

    @staticmethod
    def multiply(a, b):
        la = len(a)
        lb = len(b)
        FFT.k = 0
        FFT.n = 1
        while FFT.n < la + lb - 1:
            FFT.n <<= 1
            FFT.k += 1
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            FFT.aR[i] = a[i] if i < la else 0
            FFT.aI[i] = b[i] if i < lb else 0
        
        FFT.do_fft(False)
        
        FFT.aR[FFT.n] = FFT.aR[0]
        FFT.aI[FFT.n] = FFT.aI[0]
        scale = -1.0 / FFT.n / 4.0
        
        for i in range(FFT.n // 2 + 1):
            r1 = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            i1 = 2 * FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            r2 = FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] - FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            i2 = -2 * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            nr = -i1 + i2
            ni = r1 - r2
            FFT.aR[i] = nr * scale
            FFT.aI[i] = ni * scale
            FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] = FFT.aR[i]
            FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        FFT.do_fft(True)
        
        res = [0] * (la + lb - 1)
        for i in range(len(res)):
            res[i] = round(FFT.aR[i]) % MOD
        return res

    @staticmethod
    def multiply_precise(a, b):
        sqrt_mod = int(math.isqrt(MOD))
        al = [x % sqrt_mod for x in a]
        ah = [x // sqrt_mod for x in a]
        bl = [x % sqrt_mod for x in b]
        bh = [x // sqrt_mod for x in b]
        
        r11 = FFT.multiply(al, bl)
        r12 = FFT.multiply(al, bh)
        r21 = FFT.multiply(ah, bl)
        r22 = FFT.multiply(ah, bh)
        
        res = [0] * len(r11)
        sqrt_mod_sq = (sqrt_mod * sqrt_mod) % MOD
        for i in range(len(res)):
            t1 = sqrt_mod_sq * r22[i] % MOD
            t2 = sqrt_mod * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD) % MOD
            res[i] = (t1 + t2 + r11[i]) % MOD
        return res

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.description: All bus tickets in Berland have their numbers. A number consists of $$$n$$$ digits ($$$n$$$ is even). Only $$$k$$$ decimal digits $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ can be used to form ticket numbers. If $$$0$$$ is among these digits, then numbers may have leading zeroes. For example, if $$$n = 4$$$ and only digits $$$0$$$ and $$$4$$$ can be used, then $$$0000$$$, $$$4004$$$, $$$4440$$$ are valid ticket numbers, and $$$0002$$$, $$$00$$$, $$$44443$$$ are not.A ticket is lucky if the sum of first $$$n / 2$$$ digits is equal to the sum of remaining $$$n / 2$$$ digits. Calculate the number of different lucky tickets in Berland. Since the answer may be big, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ $$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le k \le 10)$$$ — the number of digits in each ticket number, and the number of different decimal digits that may be used. $$$n$$$ is even. The second line contains a sequence of pairwise distinct integers $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ $$$(0 \le d_i \le 9)$$$ — the digits that may be used in ticket numbers. The digits are given in arbitrary order.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of lucky ticket numbers, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example there are $$$6$$$ lucky ticket numbers: $$$1111$$$, $$$1818$$$, $$$1881$$$, $$$8118$$$, $$$8181$$$ and $$$8888$$$.There is only one ticket number in the second example, it consists of $$$20$$$ digits $$$6$$$. This ticket number is lucky, so the answer is $$$1$$$.

    private void run() {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
             PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out)) {
            
            String[] line = br.readLine().split("\\s+");
            int N = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
            int k = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
            
            long[] dig = new long[11];
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                line = br.readLine().split("\\s+");
                dig[10 - Integer.parseInt(line[0])] = 1;
            }
            
            int power = N / 2;
            long[] res = new long[]{1};
            long MOD = 998244353L;
            
            while (power > 0) {
                if ((power & 1) == 1) {
                    res = multiplyPolynomials(res, dig, MOD);
                }
                dig = multiplyPolynomials(dig, dig, MOD);
                power >>= 1;
            }
            
            long output = 0;
            for (long val : res) {
                output = (output + val * val) % MOD;
            }
            pw.println(output);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    private long[] multiplyPolynomials(long[] a, long[] b, long mod) {
        int lenA = a.length;
        int lenB = b.length;
        int resultLen = lenA + lenB - 1;
        long[] result = new long[resultLen];

            for (int j = 0; j < lenB; j++) {
                result[i + j] = (result[i + j] + a[i] * b[j]) % mod;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int N = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        long[] digitCounts = new long[11];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int digit = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
            digitCounts[10 - digit] = 1;
        }
        
        int half = N / 2;
        long[] current = {1};
        long MOD = 998244353L;
        
        while (half > 0) {
            if (half % 2 == 1) {
                current = polyMult(current, digitCounts, MOD);
            }
            digitCounts = polyMult(digitCounts, digitCounts, MOD);
            half /= 2;
        }
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (long x : current) {
            ans = (ans + x * x) % MOD;
        }
        pw.println(ans);
        
        pw.close();
        br.close();
    }
    
    private static long[] polyMult(long[] p1, long[] p2, long mod) {

import sys

def multiply(a, b, mod):
    size = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    product = [0] * size
    for i in range(len(a)):
        for j in range(len(b)):
            product[i + j] = (product[i + j] + a[i] * b[j]) % mod
    return product

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().splitlines()
    
    tokens = data[0].split()
    N = int(tokens[0])
    k = int(tokens[1])
    
    digitMask = [0] * 11
    for i in range(k):
        d = int(data[1 + i])
        digitMask[10 - d] = 1

        if half & 1:
            poly = multiply(poly, digitMask, MOD)
        digitMask = multiply(digitMask, digitMask, MOD)
        half >>= 1
    
    result = 0
    for coeff in poly:
        result = (result + coeff * coeff) % MOD
    
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        String[] input = reader.readLine().split(" ");
        int N = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);
        
        long[] availableDigits = new long[11];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int digit = Integer.parseInt(reader.readLine());
            availableDigits[10 - digit] = 1;
        }
        
        int halfLength = N / 2;
        long[] polynomial = {1};
        final long MOD = 998244353L;
        
        while (halfLength > 0) {
            if (halfLength % 2 == 1) {
                polynomial = multiplyPolynomials(polynomial, availableDigits, MOD);
            }
            availableDigits = multiplyPolynomials(availableDigits, availableDigits, MOD);
            halfLength /= 2;
        }
        
        long answer = 0;
        for (long coefficient : polynomial) {
            answer = (answer + coefficient * coefficient) % MOD;
        }
        writer.println(answer);
        
        writer.flush();
        writer.close();
        reader.close();
    }
    
    private static long[] multiplyPolynomials(long[] p1, long[] p2, long mod) {
        int resultSize = p1.length + p2.length - 1;
        long[] result = new long[resultSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < p1.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < p2.length; j++) {
                result[i + j] = (result[i + j] + p1[i] * p2[j]) % mod;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
}

        while (half > 0) {

            }
            digitFlags = multiply(digitFlags, digitFlags, MOD);
            half >>= 1;
        }
        
        long sum = 0;
        for (long c : poly) {
            sum = (sum + c * c) % MOD;
        }
        pw.println(sum);
        
        pw.close();
        br.close();
    }
    
    private static long[] multiply(long[] x, long[] y, long mod) {
        int len = x.length + y.length - 1;
        long[] z = new long[len];
        for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < y.length; j++) {
                z[i + j] = (z[i + j] + x[i] * y[j]) % mod;
            }
        }
        return z;
    }
}

import sys

def multiply(x, y, mod):
    len_z = len(x) + len(y) - 1
    z = [0] * len_z
    for i in range(len(x)):
        for j in range(len(y)):
            z[i + j] = (z[i + j] + x[i] * y[j]) % mod
    return z

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    first = data[0].split()
    N = int(first[0])
    k = int(first[1])
    
    digitFlags = [0] * 11
    idx = 1
    for i in range(k):
        d = int(data[idx])
        idx += 1
        digitFlags[10 - d] = 1
    
    half = N // 2
    poly = [1]
    MOD = 998244353
    
    while half > 0:
        if half & 1:
            poly = multiply(poly, digitFlags, MOD)
        digitFlags = multiply(digitFlags, digitFlags, MOD)
        half >>= 1
    
    total_sum = 0
    for c in poly:
        total_sum = (total_sum + c * c) % MOD
    
    print(total_sum)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Only $$$k$$$ decimal digits $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ can be used to form ticket numbers. If $$$0$$$ is among these digits, then numbers may have leading zeroes. This ticket number is lucky, so the answer is $$$1$$$.

import sys
import math

def fft(a_real, a_imaginary, inverse):
    n = len(a_real)
    if n == 0:
        return
    
    # Bit-reversal permutation
    bits = (n - 1).bit_length()
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(bits)[::-1], 2)
        if i < j:
            a_real[i], a_real[j] = a_real[j], a_real[i]
            a_imaginary[i], a_imaginary[j] = a_imaginary[j], a_imaginary[i]
    
    # Cooley-Tukey FFT
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half_len = length >> 1
        cs = [math.cos(2 * math.pi * i / length * (-1 if inverse else 1)) for i in range(half_len)]
        sn = [math.sin(2 * math.pi * i / length * (-1 if inverse else 1)) for i in range(half_len)]
        
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half_len):
                w_a = cs[j]
                w_b = sn[j]
                u_a = a_real[i + j]
                u_b = a_imaginary[i + j]
                v_a = a_real[i + j + half_len] * w_a - a_imaginary[i + j + half_len] * w_b
                v_b = a_real[i + j + half_len] * w_b + a_imaginary[i + j + half_len] * w_a
                
                a_real[i + j] = u_a + v_a
                a_imaginary[i + j] = u_b + v_b
                a_real[i + j + half_len] = u_a - v_a
                a_imaginary[i + j + half_len] = u_b - v_b
        
        length <<= 1
    
    if inverse:
        for i in range(n):
            a_real[i] /= n
            a_imaginary[i] /= n

def multiply_mod(a, b, mod):
    need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    n = max(2, 1 << (need - 1).bit_length())
    
    a_real = [0.0] * n
    a_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = a[i] % mod
        a_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        a_imaginary[i] = x >> 15
    
    fft(a_real, a_imaginary, False)
    
    b_real = [0.0] * n
    b_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(b)):
        x = b[i] % mod
        b_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        b_imaginary[i] = x >> 15
    
    fft(b_real, b_imaginary, False)
    
    fa_real = [0.0] * n
    fa_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    fb_real = [0.0] * n
    fb_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        
        a1r = (a_real[i] + a_real[j]) / 2
        a1i = (a_imaginary[i] - a_imaginary[j]) / 2
        a2r = (a_imaginary[i] + a_imaginary[j]) / 2
        a2i = (a_real[j] - a_real[i]) / 2
        
        b1r = (b_real[i] + b_real[j]) / 2
        b1i = (b_imaginary[i] - b_imaginary[j]) / 2
        b2r = (b_imaginary[i] + b_imaginary[j]) / 2
        b2i = (b_real[j] - b_real[i]) / 2
        
        fa_real[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        fa_imaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        
        fb_real[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        fb_imaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    
    fft(fa_real, fa_imaginary, True)
    fft(fb_real, fb_imaginary, True)
    
    res = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        aa = round(fa_real[i])
        bb = round(fb_real[i])
        cc = round(fa_imaginary[i])
        res[i] = int((aa + (bb % mod) * (1 << 15) + (cc % mod) * (1 << 30)) % mod)
    
    return res

def solve():
    mod = 998244353
    n, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    v = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        x = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        v[x] = 1
    
    ans = [1]
    p = n // 2
    while True:
        if p % 2 != 0:
            ans = multiply_mod(ans, v, mod)
        p //= 2
        if p == 0:
            break
        v = multiply_mod(v, v, mod)
    
    res = 0
    for x in ans:
        res = (res + x * x) % mod
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

    required = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    size = 1
    while size < required:
        size <<= 1

    ra = [0.0] * size
    ia = [0.0] * size
    rb = [0.0] * size
    ib = [0.0] * size

    for i in range(len(a)):
        val = a[i] % mod
        if val < 0:
            val += mod
        ra[i] = val & 0x7fff
        ia[i] = val >> 15

    for i in range(len(b)):
        val = b[i] % mod
        if val < 0:
            val += mod
        rb[i] = val & 0x7fff
        ib[i] = val >> 15

    fft(ra, ia, False)
    fft(rb, ib, False)

    resR = [0.0] * size
    resI = [0.0] * size

    for i in range(size):
        j = (size - i) & (size - 1)
        a1r = (ra[i] + ra[j]) * 0.5
        a1i = (ia[i] - ia[j]) * 0.5
        a2r = (ia[i] + ia[j]) * 0.5
        a2i = (ra[j] - ra[i]) * 0.5

        b1r = (rb[i] + rb[j]) * 0.5
        b1i = (ib[i] - ib[j]) * 0.5
        b2r = (ib[i] + ib[j]) * 0.5
        b2i = (rb[j] - rb[i]) * 0.5

        resR[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        resI[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i

    fft(resR, resI, True)

    result = [0] * required
    for i in range(required):
        val = round(resR[i])
        val2 = round(resI[i])
        combined = (val + (val2 << 15)) % mod
        result[i] = int(combined)
    return result

def fft(re, im, inv):
    n = len(re)
    bits = 31 - (n - 1).bit_length() + 1 if n > 1 else 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        rev = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(bits)[::-1], 2)
        if i < rev:
            re[i], re[rev] = re[rev], re[i]
            im[i], im[rev] = im[rev], im[i]

    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length >> 1
        ang = 2 * math.pi / length * (-1 if inv else 1)
        wlenRe = math.cos(ang)
        wlenIm = math.sin(ang)

        i = 0
        while i < n:
            wRe, wIm = 1.0, 0.0
            for j in range(half):
                uRe = re[i + j]
                uIm = im[i + j]
                vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm
                vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe

                re[i + j] = uRe + vRe
                im[i + j] = uIm + vIm
                re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe
                im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm

                tmp = wRe * wlenRe - wIm * wlenIm
                wIm = wRe * wlenIm + wIm * wlenRe
                wRe = tmp
            i += length
        length <<= 1

    if inv:
        for i in range(n):
            re[i] /= n
            im[i] /= n

def main():
    in_reader = InputReader(sys.stdin)
    out_writer = OutputWriter(sys.stdout)

    n = in_reader.readInt()
    k = in_reader.readInt()
    poly = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        poly[in_reader.readInt()] = 1

    res = [1]
    exp = n // 2

    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = multiply(res, poly, MOD)
        poly = multiply(poly, poly, MOD)
        exp >>= 1

    total_sum = 0
    for c in res:
        total_sum = (total_sum + c * c) % MOD
    out_writer.printLine(total_sum)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        a1r = (pr1[i] + pr1[j]) * 0.5
        a1i = (pi1[i] - pi1[j]) * 0.5
        a2r = (pi1[i] + pi1[j]) * 0.5
        a2i = (pr1[j] - pr1[i]) * 0.5

        b1r = (pr2[i] + pr2[j]) * 0.5
        b1i = (pi2[i] - pi2[j]) * 0.5
        b2r = (pi2[i] + pi2[j]) * 0.5
        b2i = (pr2[j] - pr2[i]) * 0.5

        res_re[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        res_im[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i

    perform_fft(res_re, res_im, True)

    result = [0] * required_length
    for i in range(required_length):
        real_part = round(res_re[i])
        imag_part = round(res_im[i])
        combined = (real_part + (imag_part << 15)) % mod
        result[i] = int(combined)
    return result

def perform_fft(real, imag, inverse):
    n = len(real)
    log_n = 31 - (n - 1).bit_length() + 1 if n > 1 else 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        rev = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(log_n)[::-1], 2) if log_n > 0 else 0
        if i < rev:
            real[i], real[rev] = real[rev], real[i]
            imag[i], imag[rev] = imag[rev], imag[i]

    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length >> 1
        angle = 2 * math.pi / length * (-1 if inverse else 1)
        cos_step = math.cos(angle)
        sin_step = math.sin(angle)

        for i in range(0, n, length):
            cos_val = 1.0
            sin_val = 0.0

            for j in range(half):
                u_real = real[i + j]
                u_imag = imag[i + j]
                v_real = real[i + j + half] * cos_val - imag[i + j + half] * sin_val
                v_imag = real[i + j + half] * sin_val + imag[i + j + half] * cos_val

                real[i + j] = u_real + v_real
                imag[i + j] = u_imag + v_imag
                real[i + j + half] = u_real - v_real
                imag[i + j + half] = u_imag - v_imag

                new_cos = cos_val * cos_step - sin_val * sin_step
                sin_val = cos_val * sin_step + sin_val * cos_step
                cos_val = new_cos

        length <<= 1

    if inverse:
        for i in range(n):
            real[i] /= n
            imag[i] /= n

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self, stream):
        self.stream = stream
        self.buffer = bytearray(1024)
        self.cur_char = 0
        self.num_chars = 0

    def read(self):
        if self.num_chars == -1:
            raise RuntimeError()
        if self.cur_char >= self.num_chars:
            self.cur_char = 0
            try:
                self.num_chars = self.stream.readinto(self.buffer)
            except:
                raise RuntimeError()
            if self.num_chars <= 0:
                return -1
        result = self.buffer[self.cur_char]
        self.cur_char += 1
        return result

    def read_int(self):
        c = self.read()
        while c <= 32:
            c = self.read()
        sgn = 1
        if c == ord('-'):
            sgn = -1
            c = self.read()
        res = 0
        while c > 32:
            if c < ord('0') or c > ord('9'):
                raise ValueError()
            res = res * 10 + (c - ord('0'))
            c = self.read()
        return res * sgn

class OutputWriter:
    def __init__(self, stream):
        self.writer = sys.stdout

    def print_line(self, obj):
        print(obj)

    def close(self):
        pass

def main():
    in_reader = InputReader(sys.stdin)
    out_writer = OutputWriter(sys.stdout)

    n = in_reader.read_int()
    k = in_reader.read_int()
    base_poly = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        idx = in_reader.read_int()
        base_poly[idx] = 1

    result = [1]
    exp = n // 2

    while True:
        if exp & 1:
            result = multiply_polynomials(result, base_poly, MOD)
        exp >>= 1
        if exp == 0:
            break
        base_poly = multiply_polynomials(base_poly, base_poly, MOD)

    answer = 0
    for coef in result:
        answer = (answer + coef * coef) % MOD
    out_writer.print_line(answer)
    out_writer.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.description: All bus tickets in Berland have their numbers. A number consists of $$$n$$$ digits ($$$n$$$ is even). Only $$$k$$$ decimal digits $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ can be used to form ticket numbers. If $$$0$$$ is among these digits, then numbers may have leading zeroes. For example, if $$$n = 4$$$ and only digits $$$0$$$ and $$$4$$$ can be used, then $$$0000$$$, $$$4004$$$, $$$4440$$$ are valid ticket numbers, and $$$0002$$$, $$$00$$$, $$$44443$$$ are not.A ticket is lucky if the sum of first $$$n / 2$$$ digits is equal to the sum of remaining $$$n / 2$$$ digits. Calculate the number of different lucky tickets in Berland. Since the answer may be big, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ $$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le k \le 10)$$$ — the number of digits in each ticket number, and the number of different decimal digits that may be used. $$$n$$$ is even. The second line contains a sequence of pairwise distinct integers $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ $$$(0 \le d_i \le 9)$$$ — the digits that may be used in ticket numbers. The digits are given in arbitrary order.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of lucky ticket numbers, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example there are $$$6$$$ lucky ticket numbers: $$$1111$$$, $$$1818$$$, $$$1881$$$, $$$8118$$$, $$$8181$$$ and $$$8888$$$.There is only one ticket number in the second example, it consists of $$$20$$$ digits $$$6$$$. This ticket number is lucky, so the answer is $$$1$$$.

import sys
import math

MOD = 998244353
G = 3

def modPow(base, exp):
    base %= MOD
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if (exp & 1) == 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def bitReverse(arr, n):
    arr = arr[:]
    j = n >> 1
    for i in range(1, n - 1):
        if i < j:
            arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]
        k = n >> 1
        while j >= k:
            j -= k
            k >>= 1
        if j < k:
            j += k
    return arr

def ntt(arr, n, sign):
    arr = bitReverse(arr, n)
    h = 2
    while h <= n:
        wn = modPow(G, (MOD - 1) // h)
        if sign == -1:
            wn = modPow(wn, MOD - 2)
        j = 0
        while j < n:
            w = 1
            for k in range(j, j + h // 2):
                u = arr[k]
                t = (w * arr[k + h // 2]) % MOD
                arr[k] = (u + t) % MOD
                arr[k + h // 2] = ((u - t) % MOD + MOD) % MOD
                w = (w * wn) % MOD
            j += h
        h <<= 1
    if sign == -1:
        invN = modPow(n, MOD - 2)
        for i in range(n):
            arr[i] = (arr[i] * invN) % MOD
    return arr

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    len_val = 1
    nn = n // 2
    while len_val < 9 * nn + 1:
        len_val <<= 1
    
    a = [0] * len_val
    b = [0] * len_val
    a[0] = 1
    
    idx = 2
    for i in range(m):
        x = int(data[idx])
        idx += 1
        b[x] = 1
    
    a = ntt(a, len_val, 1)
    b = ntt(b, len_val, 1)
    
    for i in range(len_val):
        if a[i] != 0 and b[i] != 0:
            a[i] = (a[i] * modPow(b[i], nn)) % MOD
        else:
            a[i] = 0
    
    a = ntt(a, len_val, -1)
    
    ans = 0
    for i in range(len_val):
        ans = (ans + a[i] * a[i]) % MOD
    print((ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

problem_description.description: All bus tickets in Berland have their numbers. A number consists of $$$n$$$ digits ($$$n$$$ is even). Only $$$k$$$ decimal digits $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ can be used to form ticket numbers. If $$$0$$$ is among these digits, then numbers may have leading zeroes. For example, if $$$n = 4$$$ and only digits $$$0$$$ and $$$4$$$ can be used, then $$$0000$$$, $$$4004$$$, $$$4440$$$ are valid ticket numbers, and $$$0002$$$, $$$00$$$, $$$44443$$$ are not.A ticket is lucky if the sum of first $$$n / 2$$$ digits is equal to the sum of remaining $$$n / 2$$$ digits. Calculate the number of different lucky tickets in Berland. Since the answer may be big, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ $$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le k \le 10)$$$ — the number of digits in each ticket number, and the number of different decimal digits that may be used. $$$n$$$ is even. The second line contains a sequence of pairwise distinct integers $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ $$$(0 \le d_i \le 9)$$$ — the digits that may be used in ticket numbers. The digits are given in arbitrary order.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of lucky ticket numbers, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example there are $$$6$$$ lucky ticket numbers: $$$1111$$$, $$$1818$$$, $$$1881$$$, $$$8118$$$, $$$8181$$$ and $$$8888$$$.There is only one ticket number in the second example, it consists of $$$20$$$ digits $$$6$$$. This ticket number is lucky, so the answer is $$$1$$$.

import sys
import math

def fft(a_real, a_imaginary, inverse):
    n = len(a_real)
    if n == 0:
        return
    shift = 32 - (n & -n).bit_length() + 1
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int('{:032b}'.format(i)[::-1], 2) >> shift
        if i < j:
            a_real[i], a_real[j] = a_real[j], a_real[i]
            a_imaginary[i], a_imaginary[j] = a_imaginary[j], a_imaginary[i]
    
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half_len = length >> 1
        cs = [math.cos(2 * math.pi * i / length * (-1 if inverse else 1)) for i in range(half_len)]
        sn = [math.sin(2 * math.pi * i / length * (-1 if inverse else 1)) for i in range(half_len)]
        
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half_len):
                wA = cs[j]
                wB = sn[j]
                uA = a_real[i + j]
                uB = a_imaginary[i + j]
                vA = a_real[i + j + half_len] * wA - a_imaginary[i + j + half_len] * wB
                vB = a_real[i + j + half_len] * wB + a_imaginary[i + j + half_len] * wA
                a_real[i + j] = uA + vA
                a_imaginary[i + j] = uB + vB
                a_real[i + j + half_len] = uA - vA
                a_imaginary[i + j + half_len] = uB - vB
        
        length <<= 1

def multiply_mod(a, b, mod):
    need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    n = max(2, 1 << (need - 1).bit_length())
    
    a_real = [0.0] * n
    a_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = a[i] % mod
        a_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        a_imaginary[i] = x >> 15
    
    fft(a_real, a_imaginary, False)
    
    b_real = [0.0] * n
    b_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(b)):
        x = b[i] % mod
        b_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        b_imaginary[i] = x >> 15
    
    fft(b_real, b_imaginary, False)
    
    fa_real = [0.0] * n
    fa_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    fb_real = [0.0] * n
    fb_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    
    cf = 0.25 / n
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        
        a1r = (a_real[i] + a_real[j])
        a1i = (a_imaginary[i] - a_imaginary[j])
        a2r = (a_imaginary[i] + a_imaginary[j])
        a2i = (a_real[j] - a_real[i])
        
        b1r = (b_real[i] + b_real[j]) * cf
        b1i = (b_imaginary[i] - b_imaginary[j]) * cf
        b2r = (b_imaginary[i] + b_imaginary[j]) * cf
        b2i = (b_real[j] - b_real[i]) * cf
        
        fa_real[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        fa_imaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        
        fb_real[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        fb_imaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    
    fft(fa_real, fa_imaginary, True)
    fft(fb_real, fb_imaginary, True)
    
    res = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        aa = int(fa_real[i] + 0.5)
        bb = int(fb_real[i] + 0.5)
        cc = int(fa_imaginary[i] + 0.5)
        res[i] = int((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    
    return res

def solve():
    mod = 998244353
    n, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    v = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        x = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        v[x] = 1
    
    ans = [1]
    p = n // 2
    while True:
        if p % 2 != 0:
            ans = multiply_mod(ans, v, mod)
        p //= 2
        if p == 0:
            break
        v = multiply_mod(v, v, mod)
    
    res = 0
    for x in ans:
        res = (res + x * x) % mod
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }

    void run() {
        InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int mod = 998244353;
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();
        int[] v = new int[10];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            v[in.nextInt()] = 1;
        }
        int[] ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        while (true) {
            if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                ans = multiplyPolynomials(ans, v, mod);
            }
            p >>= 1;
            if (p == 0) break;
            v = multiplyPolynomials(v, v, mod);
        }
        long res = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            res = (res + (long)x * x) % mod;
        }
        out.println(res);
        out.close();
    }

    int[] multiplyPolynomials(int[] a, int[] b, int mod) {
        int need = a.length + b.length - 1;
        int n = 1;
        while (n < need) n <<= 1;
        
        double[] aReal = new double[n];
        double[] aImag = new double[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            long x = ((long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            aImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        
        fft(aReal, aImag, false);
        
        double[] bReal = new double[n];
        double[] bImag = new double[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < b.length; i++) {
            long x = ((long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            bImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        if (a != b) {
            fft(bReal, bImag, false);
        } else {
            System.arraycopy(aReal, 0, bReal, 0, n);
            System.arraycopy(aImag, 0, bImag, 0, n);
        }
        
        double[] resReal = new double[n];
        double[] resImag = new double[n];
        double cf = 0.25 / n;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
            
            double a1r = aReal[i] + aReal[j];
            double a1i = aImag[i] - aImag[j];
            double a2r = aImag[i] + aImag[j];
            double a2i = aReal[j] - aReal[i];
            
            double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * cf;
            double b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) * cf;
            double b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) * cf;
            double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * cf;
            
            resReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            resImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        }
        
        fft(resReal, resImag, true);
        
        int[] result = new int[need];
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long aa = Math.round(resReal[i]);
            long bb = Math.round(resImag[i]);
            result[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15)) % mod);
        }
        return result;
    }

    void fft(double[] real, double[] imag, boolean inverse) {
        int n = real.length;
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            while ((j & bit) != 0) {
                j ^= bit;
                bit >>= 1;
            }
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                double t = real[i]; real[i] = real[j]; real[j] = t;
                t = imag[i]; imag[i] = imag[j]; imag[j] = t;
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            double[] cos = new double[half];
            double[] sin = new double[half];
            double angle = 2 * Math.PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                cos[i] = Math.cos(i * angle);
                sin[i] = Math.sin(i * angle);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double uR = real[i + j];
                    double uI = imag[i + j];
                    double vR = real[i + j + half] * cos[j] - imag[i + j + half] * sin[j];
                    double vI = real[i + j + half] * sin[j] + imag[i + j + half] * cos[j];
                    
                    real[i + j] = uR + vR;
                    imag[i + j] = uI + vI;
                    real[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                    imag[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                real[i] /= n;
                imag[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private final InputStream is;
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int pos, size;

        public InputReader(InputStream is) {
            this.is = is;
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isWhitespace(c)) c = read();
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = read(); }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw new InputMismatchException();
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isWhitespace(c));
            return res * sign;
        }

        private int read() {
            if (size == -1) throw new InputMismatchException();
            if (pos >= size) {
                pos = 0;
                try { size = is.read(buf); } catch (IOException e) { throw new InputMismatchException(); }
                if (size <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[pos++] & 255;
        }

        private static boolean isWhitespace(int c) {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
        }
    }
}

problem_description.description: All bus tickets in Berland have their numbers. A number consists of $$$n$$$ digits ($$$n$$$ is even). Only $$$k$$$ decimal digits $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ can be used to form ticket numbers. If $$$0$$$ is among these digits, then numbers may have leading zeroes. For example, if $$$n = 4$$$ and only digits $$$0$$$ and $$$4$$$ can be used, then $$$0000$$$, $$$4004$$$, $$$4440$$$ are valid ticket numbers, and $$$0002$$$, $$$00$$$, $$$44443$$$ are not.A ticket is lucky if the sum of first $$$n / 2$$$ digits is equal to the sum of remaining $$$n / 2$$$ digits. Calculate the number of different lucky tickets in Berland. Since the answer may be big, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ $$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le k \le 10)$$$ — the number of digits in each ticket number, and the number of different decimal digits that may be used. $$$n$$$ is even. The second line contains a sequence of pairwise distinct integers $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ $$$(0 \le d_i \le 9)$$$ — the digits that may be used in ticket numbers. The digits are given in arbitrary order.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of lucky ticket numbers, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example there are $$$6$$$ lucky ticket numbers: $$$1111$$$, $$$1818$$$, $$$1881$$$, $$$8118$$$, $$$8181$$$ and $$$8888$$$.There is only one ticket number in the second example, it consists of $$$20$$$ digits $$$6$$$. This ticket number is lucky, so the answer is $$$1$$$.

problem_description.description: All bus tickets in Berland have their numbers. A number consists of $$$n$$$ digits ($$$n$$$ is even). Only $$$k$$$ decimal digits $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ can be used to form ticket numbers. If $$$0$$$ is among these digits, then numbers may have leading zeroes. For example, if $$$n = 4$$$ and only digits $$$0$$$ and $$$4$$$ can be used, then $$$0000$$$, $$$4004$$$, $$$4440$$$ are valid ticket numbers, and $$$0002$$$, $$$00$$$, $$$44443$$$ are not.A ticket is lucky if the sum of first $$$n / 2$$$ digits is equal to the sum of remaining $$$n / 2$$$ digits. Calculate the number of different lucky tickets in Berland. Since the answer may be big, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ $$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le k \le 10)$$$ — the number of digits in each ticket number, and the number of different decimal digits that may be used. $$$n$$$ is even. The second line contains a sequence of pairwise distinct integers $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ $$$(0 \le d_i \le 9)$$$ — the digits that may be used in ticket numbers. The digits are given in arbitrary order.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of lucky ticket numbers, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example there are $$$6$$$ lucky ticket numbers: $$$1111$$$, $$$1818$$$, $$$1881$$$, $$$8118$$$, $$$8181$$$ and $$$8888$$$.There is only one ticket number in the second example, it consists of $$$20$$$ digits $$$6$$$. This ticket number is lucky, so the answer is $$$1$$$.

import sys
import math

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self, is_stream):
        self.is_stream = is_stream
        self.buf = bytearray(1024)
        self.pos = 0
        self.size = 0

    def next_int(self):
        c = self.read()
        while self.is_whitespace(c):
            c = self.read()
        sign = 1
        if c == ord('-'):
            sign = -1
            c = self.read()
        res = 0
        while not self.is_whitespace(c):
            if c < ord('0') or c > ord('9'):
                raise Exception("InputMismatchException")
            res = res * 10 + c - ord('0')
            c = self.read()
        return res * sign

    def read(self):
        if self.size == -1:
            raise Exception("InputMismatchException")
        if self.pos >= self.size:
            self.pos = 0
            try:
                self.size = self.is_stream.readinto(self.buf)
            except Exception:
                raise Exception("InputMismatchException")
            if self.size <= 0:
                return -1
        result = self.buf[self.pos]
        self.pos += 1
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def is_whitespace(c):
        return c == ord(' ') or c == ord('\n') or c == ord('\r') or c == ord('\t') or c == -1


class TaskG:
    def __init__(self):
        self.cs = [0.0] * (1 << 21)
        self.sn = [0.0] * (1 << 21)
        self.csi = [0.0] * (1 << 21)
        self.sni = [0.0] * (1 << 21)
        
        for length in range(1, len(self.cs) + 1, 1):
            if length > len(self.cs):
                break
            for i in range(length // 2, length):
                angle = 2 * math.pi * (i - length // 2) / length
                self.cs[i] = math.cos(angle)
                self.sn[i] = math.sin(angle)
                self.csi[i] = math.cos(-angle)
                self.sni[i] = math.sin(-angle)
            if length >= len(self.cs) // 2:
                break

    def solve(self, test_number, in_reader, out_writer):
        mod = 998244353
        n = in_reader.next_int()
        k = in_reader.next_int()
        v = [0] * 10
        for _ in range(k):
            x = in_reader.next_int()
            v[x] = 1
        
        ans = [1]
        p = n // 2
        while True:
            if p % 2 != 0:
                ans = self.multiply_mod(ans, v, mod)
            p //= 2
            if p == 0:
                break
            v = self.multiply_mod(v, v, mod)
        
        res = 0
        for x in ans:
            res = (res + x * x) % mod
        out_writer.println(res)

    def multiply_mod(self, a, b, mod):
        need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
        n = max(2, 1 << (need - 1).bit_length())
        
        a_real = [0.0] * n
        a_imaginary = [0.0] * n
        for i in range(len(a)):
            x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod
            a_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            a_imaginary[i] = x >> 15
        
        self.fft(a_real, a_imaginary, False)

        b_imaginary = [0.0] * n
        for i in range(len(b)):
            x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod
            b_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            b_imaginary[i] = x >> 15
        
        self.fft(b_real, b_imaginary, False)
        
        fa_real = [0.0] * n
        fa_imaginary = [0.0] * n
        fb_real = [0.0] * n
        fb_imaginary = [0.0] * n

            b2i = (b_real[j] - b_real[i]) / 2

            fa_imaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
            
            fb_real[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
            fb_imaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
        
        self.fft(fa_real, fa_imaginary, True)
        self.fft(fb_real, fb_imaginary, True)
        
        res = [0] * need
        for i in range(need):

            bb = int(fb_real[i] + 0.5)
            cc = int(fa_imaginary[i] + 0.5)
            res[i] = int((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)

                b[i] /= n

    def reverse_bits(self, x, shift):
        return int(bin(x)[2:].zfill(shift)[::-1], 2)

                TaskG.cs[i] = math.cos(angle)
                TaskG.sn[i] = math.sin(angle)
                TaskG.csi[i] = math.cos(-angle)
                TaskG.sni[i] = math.sin(-angle)

        n = in_reader.nextInt()
        k = in_reader.nextInt()
        v = [0] * 10
        for _ in range(k):
            v[in_reader.nextInt()] = 1

        p = n // 2
        while True:

                ans = self.multiplyPolynomial(ans, v, MOD)
            p >>= 1
            if p == 0:

            v = self.multiplyPolynomial(v, v, MOD)
        
        result = 0
        for val in ans:

        aImag = [0.0] * n
        for i in range(len(a)):

        for i in range(len(b)):

            bImag[i] = x >> 15
        
        self.performFFT(bReal, bImag, False)
        
        resReal1 = [0.0] * n
        resImag1 = [0.0] * n
        resReal2 = [0.0] * n
        resImag2 = [0.0] * n
        
        for i in range(n):
            j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
            
            a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) * 0.5
            a1i = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) * 0.5
            a2r = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) * 0.5
            a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) * 0.5
            
            b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * 0.5
            b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) * 0.5
            b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) * 0.5
            b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * 0.5
            
            resReal1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
            resImag1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
            resReal2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
            resImag2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
        
        self.performFFT(resReal1, resImag1, True)

        for i in range(1, n):

import sys
import math

def main():
    execute()

def execute():
    try:
        input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        if not input_line:
            return
        parts = input_line.split()
        n = int(parts[0])
        k = int(parts[1])
        
        v = [0] * 10
        input_line2 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        if input_line2:
            parts2 = input_line2.split()
            for i in range(k):
                idx = int(parts2[i])
                v[idx] = 1
        
        ans = [1]
        p = n // 2
        while True:
            if (p & 1) == 1:
                ans = multiply(ans, v, 998244353)
            p >>= 1
            if p == 0:
                break
            v = multiply(v, v, 998244353)
        
        res = 0
        for x in ans:
            res = (res + x * x) % 998244353
        print(res)
    except Exception as e:
        print(e)

def multiply(a, b, mod):
    need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    n = max(2, 1 << (need - 1).bit_length())
    
    ar = [0.0] * n
    ai = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF
        ai[i] = x >> 15
    
    fft(ar, ai, False)
    
    br = [0.0] * n
    bi = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(b)):
        x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        br[i] = x & 0x7FFF
        bi[i] = x >> 15
    
    fft(br, bi, False)
    
    cr1 = [0.0] * n
    ci1 = [0.0] * n
    cr2 = [0.0] * n
    ci2 = [0.0] * n
    
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5
        a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5
        
        b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5
        b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5
        
        cr1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        ci1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        cr2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        ci2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    
    fft(cr1, ci1, True)
    fft(cr2, ci2, True)
    
    res = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        aa = round(cr1[i])
        bb = round(cr2[i])
        cc = round(ci1[i])
        res[i] = int((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    return res

def fft(re, im, inv):
    n = len(re)
    if n == 0:
        return
    shift = 32 - (n & -n).bit_length() if n > 0 else 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(shift)[::-1], 2) if shift > 0 else i
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]
    
    cosTable = [0.0] * n
    sinTable = [0.0] * n
    length = 1
    while length < n:
        for i in range(length, min(length << 1, n)):
            angle = 2 * math.pi * (i - length) / (length << 1)
            cosTable[i] = math.cos(angle)
            sinTable[i] = math.sin(angle)
        length <<= 1
    
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length >> 1
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half):
                wRe = cosTable[half + j] if not inv else cosTable[half + j]
                wIm = -sinTable[half + j] if inv else sinTable[half + j]
                
                uRe = re[i + j]
                uIm = im[i + j]
                vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm
                vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe
                
                re[i + j] = uRe + vRe
                im[i + j] = uIm + vIm
                re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe
                im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm
        length <<= 1
    
    if inv:
        for i in range(n):
            re[i] /= n
            im[i] /= n

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5

        b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5
        b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5

        cr1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        ci1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        cr2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        ci2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r

    transform(cr1, ci1, True)
    transform(cr2, ci2, True)

    res = [0] * result_len
    for i in range(result_len):
        aa = round(cr1[i])
        bb = round(cr2[i])
        cc = round(ci1[i])
        res[i] = int((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    return res


def transform(re, im, inverse):
    n = len(re)
    bits = 32 - (n - 1).bit_length()
    
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(bits)[::-1], 2)
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]

    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length >> 1
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half):
                angle = 2 * math.pi * j / length
                wRe = math.cos(angle)
                wIm = -math.sin(angle) if inverse else math.sin(angle)

                uRe = re[i + j]
                uIm = im[i + j]
                vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm
                vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe

                re[i + j] = uRe + vRe
                im[i + j] = uIm + vIm
                re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe
                im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm
        length <<= 1

    if inverse:
        for i in range(n):
            re[i] /= n
            im[i] /= n


def main():
    in_reader = InputReader(sys.stdin.buffer)
    out = sys.stdout
    n = in_reader.nextInt()
    k = in_reader.nextInt()
    v = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        v[in_reader.nextInt()] = 1
    
    result = [1]
    exponent = n // 2
    while exponent > 0:
        if exponent & 1:
            result = convolve(result, v, 998244353)
        v = convolve(v, v, 998244353)
        exponent >>= 1
    
    total = 0
    for val in result:
        total = (total + val * val) % 998244353
    out.write(str(total) + '\n')
    out.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
import math

def fft(re, im, inv):
    n = len(re)
    bits = 32 - (n & -n).bit_length() + 1 if n > 0 else 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int('{:032b}'.format(i)[::-1], 2) >> (32 - bits) if bits > 0 else 0
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]
    
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length >> 1
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half):
                angle = 2 * math.pi * j / length
                w_re = math.cos(angle)
                w_im = -math.sin(angle) if inv else math.sin(angle)
                
                u_re = re[i + j]
                u_im = im[i + j]
                v_re = re[i + j + half] * w_re - im[i + j + half] * w_im
                v_im = re[i + j + half] * w_im + im[i + j + half] * w_re
                
                re[i + j] = u_re + v_re
                im[i + j] = u_im + v_im
                re[i + j + half] = u_re - v_re
                im[i + j + half] = u_im - v_im
        length <<= 1
    
    if inv:
        for i in range(n):
            re[i] /= n
            im[i] /= n

def multiply(a, b, mod):
    need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    n = 1
    while n < need:
        n <<= 1
    
    ar = [0.0] * n
    ai = [0.0] * n
    br = [0.0] * n
    bi = [0.0] * n
    
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF
        ai[i] = x >> 15
    
    for i in range(len(b)):
        x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        br[i] = x & 0x7FFF
        bi[i] = x >> 15
    
    fft(ar, ai, False)
    fft(br, bi, False)
    
    res1r = [0.0] * n
    res1i = [0.0] * n
    res2r = [0.0] * n
    res2i = [0.0] * n
    
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5
        a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5
        
        b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5
        b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5
        
        res1r[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        res1i[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        res2r[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        res2i[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    
    fft(res1r, res1i, True)
    fft(res2r, res2i, True)
    
    result = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        aa = round(res1r[i])
        bb = round(res2r[i])
        cc = round(res1i[i])
        result[i] = int((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    
    return result

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()

        v = multiply(v, v, 998244353)
        exp >>= 1
    
    total = 0
    for x in ans:
        total = (total + x * x) % 998244353
    
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":

problem_description.description: All bus tickets in Berland have their numbers. A number consists of $$$n$$$ digits ($$$n$$$ is even). Only $$$k$$$ decimal digits $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ can be used to form ticket numbers. If $$$0$$$ is among these digits, then numbers may have leading zeroes. For example, if $$$n = 4$$$ and only digits $$$0$$$ and $$$4$$$ can be used, then $$$0000$$$, $$$4004$$$, $$$4440$$$ are valid ticket numbers, and $$$0002$$$, $$$00$$$, $$$44443$$$ are not.A ticket is lucky if the sum of first $$$n / 2$$$ digits is equal to the sum of remaining $$$n / 2$$$ digits. Calculate the number of different lucky tickets in Berland. Since the answer may be big, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ $$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le k \le 10)$$$ — the number of digits in each ticket number, and the number of different decimal digits that may be used. $$$n$$$ is even. The second line contains a sequence of pairwise distinct integers $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ $$$(0 \le d_i \le 9)$$$ — the digits that may be used in ticket numbers. The digits are given in arbitrary order.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of lucky ticket numbers, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first example there are $$$6$$$ lucky ticket numbers: $$$1111$$$, $$$1818$$$, $$$1881$$$, $$$8118$$$, $$$8181$$$ and $$$8888$$$.There is only one ticket number in the second example, it consists of $$$20$$$ digits $$$6$$$. This ticket number is lucky, so the answer is $$$1$$$.
